articleTitle: Secure and Collaborative Breast Cancer Detection Using Federated Learning
abstract: To attain the urgent need for diagnosis of breast cancer as expected in early periods, this research reviews the application of a federated learning model for breast cancer detection. The model consolidates disconnected data from numerous sources using a rich set of mammography pictures without compromising the patient's confidentiality. Manufactured with an accuracy rating of 95. 3% and this is how the federated learning strategy surpassed the conventional centralized ideal models by 3%.7%. Some prominent parameters prove that there are substantial improvements in terms of improvement of detection and, therefore, this approach can be considered as a possible instrument in practical applications of medicine. The capabilities of using the federated learning model that referred to heterogeneous data while preserving privacy in the prospective of overturning breast cancer detection.

articleTitle: A Hybrid ANN-SVM Framework for Ransomware Detection with Imbalanced Class Consideration
abstract: Ransomware puts businesses at danger of financial, reputational, and data loss. Strong crisis response processes and cybersecurity infrastructure are necessary to halt these types of assaults. Integrating ML and DL technology may fortify your viral defenses. Combining an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) with a Support Vector Machine (SVM) was a novel approach to infection detection in this study. While ANN excels in identifying complex data structures, SVM excels at dealing with multi-dimensional data. Together, we can improve malware detection, which strengthens our defenses against emerging threats. During the testing phase, a dataset from the CIC institute was utilized along with hyperparameters such as loss, accuracy, val-accuracy, and val-loss. Finding out how well the machine learning model can detect malware relies on these signals. You can see how well the model performed on the data from the training set by looking at the loss and accuracy metrics. Metrics like val-accuracy and val-loss reveal how much the system has improved at being consistent and reliable in actual use. There is hope that businesses may increase their security by implementing ML and DL. To better protect against ever-changing cyber threats, it might be useful to implement a thorough method for detecting ransomware that considers file attributes and activity patterns. Businesses may lessen their susceptibility to ransomware attacks, keep operations running, and safeguard vital information by using this unified approach. To aid companies in safeguarding their digital assets and remaining vigilant against new threats, effective cybersecurity plans utilize modern technology. By exploring and using new technology, a company may show that it is dedicated to keeping up with cybersecurity improvements and responding to a constantly evolving threat landscape.

articleTitle: Impact of Federated Learning in Agriculture 4.0: Collaborative Analysis of Distributed Agricultural Data
abstract: Agriculture 4.0 integrates traditional farming methods with advanced technologies, yet its adoption faces significant challenges. This article identifies these obstacles and proposes leveraging Federated Learning (FL) to overcome them. However, the application of federating machine learning algorithms within the agricultural domain is still in its infancy. We introduce the Federated Learning Assisted Agriculture 4.0 (AgriFL 4.0) framework, designed to ensure privacy while collaboratively analyzing distributed agricultural data. Within AgriFL 4.0, a common Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) model is trained locally to analyze decentralized agricultural data. Additionally, a consolidated model is formed at the server using the Federated Average aggregation technique. For this study, we employ the Dry Bean Dataset from Kaggle, assembled in 2020, consisting of 13,611 instances with 16 attributes, including dimensions and shape forms crucial for seed classification. To evaluate AgriFL 4.0's performance on horizontally distributed agricultural data, we categorize the dataset into two types: lID and non-lID. In our simulation involving 10 clients, we explored scenarios featuring 0%, 40%, and 80% stragglers-nodes encountering delays. Moreover, we compare the federated and non-federated model performances. The results indicate that the framework works well with lID data, and the federated model outperforms the non-federated model in terms of classification accuracy and other performance metrics. However, with non-lID data, the framework's performance degrades as the count of stragglers increases. This underscores the critical role of federated learning in advancing Agriculture 4.0.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis Of Deep Learning Approaches Used For Stock Price Prediction
abstract: Stock market analysis is nonlinear, highly volatile and complex. Predicting the stock price is a highly challenging task. The change in stock price is affected by certain factors such as economic situation, political circumstances, sentiments, global pandemic like Covid-19 and global impact of Russo-Ukrainian War. Forecasting the stock market presents a significant difficulty to investors to build a profitable portfolio or to reduce stock risk in the stock market. “Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL”) have been abundantly used for stock trend and price prediction considering time series data and sentiments. In this paper we consider the stocks of 5 companies (Tata Steel, Tata Motors, Sun Pharmacy, Infosys and HDFC Bank) from National Stock Exchange (NIFTY 50). “Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM)” methods were used for data set of duration 01 January 2014 - 01 February 2024, was evaluated the prediction model using “Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE)”. The Bi-LSTM model achieved an RMSE of 6.6 for TATA Steel stock and a MAPE of 0.010 for Sun Pharma stock. The study proves the Bi-LSTM is an effective deep learning algorithm for predicting the future closing price of a stock as compared to CNN, RNN and LSTM.

articleTitle: Micro Expression Recognition Using ML Based XGBoost Classifier
abstract: Micro-expressions, brief involuntary facial expressions lasting less than a second, are crucial for understanding human emotions and intentions. Accurate recognition of these expressions is essential in fields such as psychology, law enforcement, and human-computer interaction. Facial expression recognition is an emerging research area focusing on enhancing the accuracy of detection. This technology impacts various applications, including education, gaming, healthcare, and safety. To improve the performance of XGBoost, an algorithm leveraging genetic and hybrid optimization techniques, this work addresses the limitations of stochastic gradient descent (SGD). We evaluate our proposed method on benchmark micro-expression datasets like CASME, leveraging the power of XGBoost and demonstrating high accuracy and robustness. Implemented using Python, this approach provides an efficient solution for micro-expression recognition, with potential for further optimization in future work.

articleTitle: Automatic Smart Shopping Basket Based on IoT Applications
abstract: The project “Automatic smart shopping Basket based in IoT Applications” is primarily focused on embedded systems, utilizing technologies such as barcode scanners and Arduino. When consumer visits grocery stores or supermarkets, a significant amount of time is lost scanning every product at the billing/cash counter. Furthermore, there is no way to figure out the entire bill before billing. In order to address these issues, the suggested smart basket uses an Arduino and an LCD display to continuously show the entire cart bill and when the customer is done shopping, they may pay the bill directly over the Centralized network using UPI, NET BANKING, or even cash. Steps were taken to prevent product theft. The existing systems were based on RFID cards, High resolution cameras which are less cost-effective, less precise and offer less protection against goods theft. These issues are solved by the suggested model. The Arduino in the basket and the store's centralized network are the crucial components of the solution. As a result, the suggested system guarantees a hassle-free experience for the use while saving time.

articleTitle: Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR)-Based Load Frequency Control in Power Systems
abstract: This study evaluates linear quadratic regulator (LQR) use in two-area load frequency control (LFC) systems. The purpose of this study is to analyze linear quadratic regulator (LQR) in rotor angle and pitch operations. Two connections connect the LFC to loads, generators, and controllers in distinct grid segments. LQR controllers dynamically vary generator output to control system frequency. This study compares LQR and PI controllers on environmental control, time, and safety. A comparison of LQR and PI management systems shows their pros and cons in both LFC locations.

articleTitle: Classification of Red Lady Papaya and Native Papaya Sweetness Using CNN Method
abstract: The Philippines, an archipelagic nation renowned for its tropical fruits, boasts two primary papayas (Carica papaya L.) varieties: the commercially popular Red Lady papaya and the indigenous Native papaya based on UP Diliman Journal publication. Accurately classifying and predicting their sweetness[1], [2], [5], [11], a crucial quality parameter for consumer acceptance and market value, poses a challenge due to destructive and subjective traditional methods. This study presents a novel, non-destructive approach for the sweetness classification of Red Lady and Native papayas using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)[6], [7], [12], [23]. A dataset of papaya images paired Lady with corresponding Brix (°Bx) values, a measure of soluble solids content and sweetness indicator, was acquired Lady from farms across the Philippines [20], [21]. CNN models were trained and optimized on this dataset to differentiate between Red Lady and Native papayas and further classify their sweetness levels (low, medium, high) based on visual cues. The proposed CNN method achieved an accuracy of 94.5% for variety classification and 88.2% for sweetness level ion, significantly exceeding the performance of traditional methods. This research paves the way for rapid, objective, and non-destructive sweetness assessment in the Philippine papaya industry, empowering farmers, distributors, and consumers to make informed decisions and optimize fruit quality throughout the value chain. References were taken from the giant sources of reliable references, namely the MDPI, Scopus, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Depth Estimation and Disparity Map Generation in Stereoscopic Images Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: This paper provides a singular approach to depth estimation and disparity map technology in stereoscopic snap shots using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Stereoscopic pictures are pairs brand new two or more photographs taken from barely extraordinary points in space., commonly utilized in 3-D film manufacturing. A good way to extract depth information from the 2 photographs., a stereo-disparity map can be generated by way of comparing the similarities among the two. The undertaking latest estimating the disparity map traditionally calls for tedious and computational heavy feature matching algorithms. This paper introduces a CNN-based disparity estimation technique that is both light-weight and quicker than traditional feature-matching algorithms. In particular., a completely-convolutional neural community (FCN) model is employed to regress the disparity map from an input stereoscopic photograph pair. To train this community., a large-scale artificial dataset is generated using simulation software program., presenting the essential ground fact. An extensive list state-of-the-art experiments and comparisons with approaches were conducted to evaluate its performance. Outcomes display that the proposed approach is capable of estimating displacement maps in stereo snap shots speedy and as it should be.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of Energy- Efficient Routing Protocols for Sensor Ad Hoc Networks
abstract: Using sensor advert hoc networks (SAN) in sensor-based applications has led to an elevated need for the design of strength-green direction procedures. This paper provides the layout and overall presentation evaluation of such strength-green SAN direction procedures: a distance-vector protocol (DV) and a fully allotted protocol (FDP). The layout of these procedures becomes guided with the aid of the subsequent targets: to minimize strength consumption, to preserve excessive reliability, and to lessen the manipulation overhead. The DV protocol makes use of a “flood-primarily based” distance vector algorithm to set up precise routes between nodes without using flooding packets. The FDP uses a hierarchical -hop algorithm to path packets from the supply to the vacation spot. Power-efficient direction metrics, along with hop remember, packet loss ratio, and link utilization thing had been used to assess the presentation of the 2 procedures. The effects of the simulations show that the FDP protocol outperforms the DV protocol in terms of energy presentation, reliability, and decreased managed overhead. In conclusion, this paper affords electricity-green SAN direction procedures and offers an empirical assessment of their overall presentation. The consequences propose that the FDP protocol is a viable alternative for accomplishing power presentation and high reliability in SAN.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Binary Classification on Imbalanced Data Using Automated Methodology
abstract: Addressing the issue of class imbalance in binary classification tasks remains a significant concern in machine learning. In this study, we propose an automated methodology utilizing a range of classifiers, including K Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest, and Decision Tree, aimed at mitigating the challenges posed by imbalanced datasets. Through thorough experimentation across a variety of datasets, we assess the effectiveness of these algorithms in terms of primary performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Suprisingly, our findings reveal that the Random Forest classifier is the most promising solution, demonstrating superior predictive accuracy and resilience in handling imbalanced data distributions. Furthermore, a comprehensive analysis of feature importance sheds light on the underlying factors influencing the classification outcomes. Our study highlights the effectiveness of the of the Random Forest algorithm in addressing class imbalance issues and underscores its potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: Leveraging Sequential CNNs for Tuberculosis Detection in Chest X-Rays: Employing Convolutional Neural Networks to Spot Tuberculosis in Radiographs
abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) is a substantial global health concern, with millions of new cases reported each. Timely identification is essential for effective handling and containment of the disease's transmission. Our research is centered on developing and evaluating a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for automatically classifying tuberculosis using chest X-ray pictures. The dataset includes 700 TB pictures and 3,500 normal images, as well as 2,800 TB images obtained from the NIAID TB site. The CNN that was recommended was trained and validated, showing strong performance on both datasets. The results showed high precision (98.90%) and recall (97.83%) on the validation set, indicating the model's ability to accurately identify TB-positive cases. Additional testing on a separate dataset confirms the reliability of the model, achieving an overall accuracy of 99.52%. The results emphasize the capacity of deep learning to assist healthcare professionals in diagnosing TB, leading to prompt intervention and enhanced patient results. Our research emphasizes the need of using machine learning to improve TB detection, providing a vital tool for healthcare professionals and public health efforts globally.

articleTitle: Oral Lesions Classification Using EfficientNet Transfer Learning Model
abstract: Oral lesions are a significant diagnostic challenge due to their diverse range of pathologies. This research paper presents a study on automated classification of oral lesions using deep learning techniques, specifically the EfficientNetB7 model. The study uses the Oral Lesions: Cancer Detection Dataset, which comprises 2270 high-resolution images, to classify lesions into benign and malignant. The EfficientNetB7 architecture, known for its efficiency in handling large-scale image datasets, is used in the study. The model achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 99.12%, demonstrating its proficiency in distinguishing between benign and malignant lesions. The study also analyzes the model's performance, including sensitivity, specificity, and precision metrics, to emphasize its diagnostic reliability. The study also explores the interpretability of the model's predictions, highlighting key features contributing to its decision-making process. The research has implications beyond computer-aided diagnosis, enhancing the efficiency of oral lesion screening programs. The automated classification system holds promise as a supplementary tool for health workers, aiding in early and accurate identification of potentially malignant lesions, facilitating prompt intervention and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Enabling Real-Time Multilingual Communication: Web Architecture for Cross-Language Chatting
abstract: In an era marked by unprecedented connectivity and cultural immersion, proficient language communication has become a crucial obstacle in digital engagement. In response, this study presents a novel and ingenious architectural framework tailored to promote seamless multilingual communication within chat-based application ecosystems. Our proposed architecture combines cutting-edge methodologies and best industrial practices, intricately intertwining web sockets, machine learning translation models, and refined database management strategies finely tuned together to perform the task with the utmost fluidity. Among its key features are user preference storage, real-time message translation, and robust data security protocols. Moreover, the paper engages in prospective areas for future exploration, including scaling mechanisms and advanced encryption techniques, to consolidate the system's resilience and confidentiality. Laying Out these convoluted components, the proposed architecture promises a transformative solution to redefine cross-language communication dynamics across diverse platforms. This study endeavours to direct the progression of multilingual messaging applications, fostering profound connectivity and collaboration in the ever-expanding digital landscape through the means of presenting sustainable and efficient architecture.

articleTitle: AlertWrist-An Effective Emergency Communication Wrist Band
abstract: In the modern world, fast and effective communication has already been established and has become an integral part of each and everyone's life and by keeping this in mind our proposed system states that this communication can be put to good use and applied to emergency situations. This will exacerbate and mitigate the damage and danger in such emergency situations by establishing a low complexity and fast acting communication system. By making it simple, This will allow the user to skip multiple steps and alert their family, the police and an ambulance immediately. A survey that was conducted on the same suggested that people would prefer such a band over current ways of emergency contact. Proposed system includes a feature allowing users to send messages with precise locations, thereby expediting the rescue process.

articleTitle: Harnessing CNN and SVM for Lung Cancer Prediction: A Binary Classification Approach
abstract: This research analyzes the efficacy of a classification model aimed at diagnosing lung illnesses, notably focused on differentiating between “Healthy” as well as “Infected Lung” classes. Through extensive examination, the model's features such as precision, recall, F1-score, support percentage, as well as accuracy are studied. Results demonstrate amazing performance metrics for all classes, with “Healthy” achieving 95.53% accuracy, 94.69% recall, and a comparable F1-score of 95.11 %, but “Infected Lung” exceeds 99% in all categories. The model exhibits an average accuracy of 98%, underscoring its significance in accurately diagnosing lung ailments. Particularly, the support % demonstrates a higher frequency of “Infected Lung” occurrences in the sample, showing the model's potential to handle skewed data. In addition, the global, weighted, and also micro averages give subtle insights into the framework's efficacy across numerous assessment approaches, indicating its resilience. These results imply intriguing possibilities for medical use, where reliable diagnosis of lung ailments is vital for prompt intervention and treatment. Overall, this study adds to the advancement of machine learning approaches in medical diagnostics, presenting future potential for boosting the outcomes of healthcare as well as patient care.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Electrical Stimuli Generator for Structural Measurement System
abstract: The Electrical Stimuli Generator is a low-cost, compact, configurable test system developed for Spacecraft Structural Measurement Unit (SMU). The SMU acquires and processes signals from acoustic, vibration, and shock sensors, placed at different locations on the spacecraft body. This test system generates electrical signals(voltage) that simulate the actual sensor outputs. The stimuli range from simple classical signals like sine, half-sine, terminal ramp, etc. to real-time pyrotechnic acceleration-time data, as an analog signal. The frequencies and amplitudes of these stimuli are configurable. The structural events are a one-time occurrence in real scenarios. This calls for a simulator in a design laboratory environment, wherein SMU needs to be tested for full frequency and dynamic range. Vibration machines are not viable in the lab, and ‘commercially off-the-shelf’ stimulator equipment is expensive and not customizable to our needs. This paper presents the design, implementation, and real-time testing of an FPGA-based Electrical stimuli generator for satellite structural measurement unit design.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Potential of Data Mining in Breast Cancer Prediction
abstract: Though breast cancer is prevalent, one in eight women are diagnosed, early detection offers a powerful chance for successful treatment. Regular self-exams and mammograms are your allies in catching any abnormalities early. Diagnosis goes beyond a simple test - advanced scans like ultrasounds and MRIs provide a detailed picture, while biopsies pinpoint the exact type. Risk factors like age, family history, and lifestyle habits influence treatment plans. Remember, breast cancer isn't a one-size-fits-all disease. Different sub types respond best to specific therapies. Genetic testing helps unlock personalized treatment options. While the emotional impact is undeniable, it highlights the importance of strong support systems and mental health resources. The future of breast cancer care is bright - ongoing research paves the way for less invasive and more effective treatments and prevention methods.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Densenet Deep Neural Network Model for Tuberculosis Prediction
abstract: Introducing CBAMWDNet, a specialized deep learning architecture for tuberculosis diagnosis, achieving superior performance with minimal computational overhead. Comparative evaluations demonstrate its outperformance in accuracy, sensi-tivity, and specificity, while also exhibiting efficient convergence to reduce training time and improve detection capabilities.

articleTitle: An Innovative Deep Learning Method for Enhancing Image Resolution
abstract: This paper presents a unique, deep, modern-day method for picture great resolution. The proposed approach, dubbed as a more advantageous first-rate resolution community (ESRN), consists of an architecture with a global-local Residual Fusion (GLRF) module. The GLRF module introduces branches that fuse feature maps from a resblock movement and a pass-connection circulate. The global department modernizes the GLRF module and plays feature aggregation through aggregating lengthy range function maps. In contrast, the local department directly adapts the quick variety of function maps from the bypass-connection flow. By way of fusing these branches, the GLRF module can obtain more unique feature maps at the same time as retaining any existing photograph details. Moreover, by way of the use of the characteristic Stacking (FS) era, the proposed network can ‘stack’ deeper layers onto shallower layers to form a very last augmented photo. Experimental outcomes display that the proposed method has advanced overall performance over strategies on numerous benchmark datasets. Similarly, the paper additionally explores the effect of today's parameter choice, batch size, and data augmentation on overall performance.

articleTitle: Joint User Clustering and Resource Allocation for UWB Multi-User MIMO Systems
abstract: The Joint consumer Clustering and aid Allocation for UWB Multi-consumer MIMO structures consists of additives, consumer clustering, and useful resource allocation, which paintings collectively to successfully utilize the sources of a UWB (extremely huge-band) MIMO (Multi-input Multi-Output) system. The person clustering is based totally on channeling information to organization users into clusters as a way to maximize system capacity. Aid allocation is then utilized to assign resources to each cluster within the gadget. This paper proposes a brand-new joint person clustering and resource allocation set of rules that combine the 2 components to offer greater green resource utilization. The proposed algorithm operates iteratively, grouping customers and allocating assets in an alternating style till it converges to a pleasant solution. It enables the system to maximize resource utilization and decrease interference among customers. Simulation results display that the proposed algorithm can correctly lessen the average interferences among users while growing the device capability.

articleTitle: Classification of Indian Broccoli Varieties: Comparative Analysis of CNN and AdaBoost Models
abstract: An entirely correct sorting of the crop varieties is the basis for improved agricultural operations and higher yields. The current study not only proposes a new methodology based on the combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost) but also classifies three indigenous broccoli varieties Pusa KTS-1., Green Magic., and Calabrese. Designed to overcome the concerns of causal classification., and enhance the capabilities of separate machine learning (ML) models., this study examines the combinative effect of the deep learning feature extraction of CNN and AdaBoost's ensemble learning classification strength. By using a dataset of the broccoli images that was thoroughly searched for and processed., the study develops as well as trains a model that combines the CNN and AdaBoost. This model is examined thoroughly against the completely unlikely CNN and AdaBoost models. Evaluation metrics consist of accuracy., precision., recall., and Fl score., which are the benchmarks. The results show a significant how improvement in classification accuracy., with the hybrid model attaining a 93 % accuracy rate., being better than standalone models. The data imply that the hybrid model can solve the problem of misclassification and improve the sort of discrimination. These studies would not just benefit agricultural technology but also illustrate the far-reaching implications of ML to precision agriculture., showing that the tools are revolutionary for crop management and sustainability. This study shows the increased efficiency of combining a CNN and Adaboost for agricultural classification purposes; and could be taken further in future studies., for instance., generalizability for different crops or other agricultural challenges.

articleTitle: Utilizing Recurrent Neural Networks for Predicting UNIQLO Stock Prices: An Analysis of Long-Term Patterns and Trends
abstract: This research attempts to investigate the utilization of recurrent neural networks (RNN) with particular interest in long short-term memory (LSTM) Networks in modeling stock price data from UNIQLO, a popular global retail company. Being the financial markets characteristically chaotic and nonlinear, the forecasting models confined usually tend to be not so reliable in charging the stock price trends. The goal of this research is therefore to investigate the extent to which LSTM networks can learn the inter-temporal connections that concur with the ups and downs of share prices, using both past stock data and external economic indicators. Utilizing a complete approach that covers data collection, preprocessing, training, and modeling evaluation, the study confirms the super visionary predictions of an LSTM model. The outcomes show that the LSTM technique contributes to higher precision of the prevision of volatile trends in stock market investments. Besides, researchers have highlighted the significant role of such factors as external ones in those models, which ensures a more generalized model of stock market behavior. This particular study is a participant in a research area of AI and financial analytics which is rapidly progressing. The study is a new addition to research works for academicians, investors, and financial analysts.

articleTitle: Forecasting Different Types of Convective Weather: A Deep Learning Based ClimaNet Model
abstract: Machine learning (ML) integration with regular weather forecasting techniques has observed a significant rise in the accuracy and efficiency of weather predictions. This paper is devoted to the opportunities of ClimaN et which is the name given to the complex machine learning system that can enhance the accuracy of weather predictions. The accuracy of ClimaN et was established during the training and was proved to meet the weather forecasting threshold using a unique dataset that comprised many years' worth of meteorological measurements, such as temperature, precipitation, and atmospheric pressure. The research result demonstrated the mean absolute error was reduced by as much as 20% when compared with the baseline method. Besides, the model was assumed to have had a robust performance in a wide range of weather scenarios shown by the very significant improvements in its accuracy, recall, and the Fl score.

articleTitle: A Quadruplex Boost Switched Capacitor Multilevel Inverter Fed Autoclave Load with Proper Material Selection
abstract: In many applications, the cascaded multilevel inverter (C-MLI) architecture is used. However, the primary disadvantage of this kind of inverter is that the C-MLI requires numerous switches and segregated dc sources. As a result, the size, cost, and complexity of C-MLI rises and its efficiency declines. This paper proposes quadruplex boost switched capacitor Half Bridge Cascaded Single Source Multilevel Inverter (SC-HBCMLI) fed induction heated load. In comparison to conventional cascaded bridge inverter the proposed topology utilizes less number of components with boosting capability. Moreover this topology offers lower harmonic distortion and higher efficiency. To provide the gate signals to the switches level shifted pulse width modulation technique (LSPWM) is adopted. To validate the performance of developed topology, MATLAB simulation and laboratory results are provided.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance for Manufacturing Using Data Mining Techniques
abstract: This study places a strong emphasis on manufacturing's use of predictive maintenance, particularly regarding equipment and tools. By avoiding equipment breakdowns and operational hiccups, the goal is to improve production quality. Unplanned downtime can cause serious financial consequences and reputational harm in today's industry. We gain useful insights from production data through data analytics, emphasizing the critical part that equipment maintenance plays in raising operational effectiveness. In addition to preventing failures, this study creates a foundation for a tool wear monitoring system that enhances human-machine interaction and manufacturing process optimization. The industrial sector will ultimately gain from this study's advancement of predictive maintenance, which will improve the quality and dependability of production systems.

articleTitle: A Real-Time News App in Salesforce: Leveraging Omni-Channel Chatbots in Salesforce for Enhanced User Engagement
abstract: In today's digital age, the availability and reliability of news sources has become increasingly important for users seeking reliable information. This paper presents the development and implementation of the NEWS APP using Apex REST Callouts and Lightning Web Components (LWC) within the Salesforce ecosystem. The primary goal of the NEWS APP is to provide users with real-time access to a variety of news sources from a trusted NEWS API. In addition, the app features an omni-channel chatbot integrated into the Salesforce environment, allowing users to chat in real-time and receive personalized news updates. The chatbot acts as a communication platform, providing a seamless experience for receiving news. Users can interact with the chatbot to select their favorite news group, get top ten highlights and assistance for navigating through the app page. This innovation addresses the challenge of finding a credible source of information by providing a personalized and interactive platform for media consumption. The paper discusses the integration of omnichannel chatbots, their functionality and benefits for the user experience. Initial results show promise of user engagement and satisfaction with the app's features, highlighting the potential of integrating chatbots into news applications types to enhance user interaction and content accessibility.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Reconstruction: Convolutional Neural Network Based Approach to Improve Fingerprint Recognition
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in fingerprint reconstruction is a crucial aspect of biometric authentication systems. Traditional methods, such as minutiae extraction and matching techniques, struggle with noisy and distorted fingerprint images. The advent of CNN s offers a promising avenue for improving the accuracy and robustness of fingerprint recognition systems. CNNs, which can automatically learn hierarchical features, have demonstrated remarkable success in various image recognition tasks, making them an attractive choice for fingerprint recognition. This paper discusses the application of CNN s in fingerprint recognition, exploring the methodology, results and analysis of the proposed model. The contributions of this research include building a CNN model for fingerprint reconstruction, evaluating the performance of the proposed system compared to traditional methods, and analyzing the robustness of the CNN-based system under varying conditions. Deep learning methods are proved ideal for reconstructing damaged fingerprint images due to poor skin condition, large cuts, wet fingers, or poor scanning, with training accuracy of 98.75 % and validation accuracy of 99.02%.

articleTitle: Realization of a 16x16 Barrel Shifter with 16-Bit Bin. to Gr. Converter for Encryption Using FinFET Technology
abstract: Our research paper introduces a generative im-plementation of a 16x16 Barrel Shifter combined with a 16-bit Binary to Gray Converter specifically designed for encryption applications using FinFET technology within the cadence tool. Barrel shifters are pivotal in digital circuitry for data manipulation, whereas Bin. to Gr. converters are indispensable elements in data processing and encryption protocols. Harnessing the distinctive traits of FinFET technology, our design strives to deliver superior performance, efficiency, and security for encryption operations. We introduce an innovative blueprint for the 16x16 barrel shifter and offer comprehensive insights into the design and execution of the Bin. to Gr. converter. Our strategy leverages the benefits of FinFET technology, including lower power consumption, enhanced speed, and increased reliability, to tackle the encryption challenges in contemporary computer systems. The results of our experiments validate the effectiveness and feasibility of our proposed solution, opening avenues for progress in encryption methodologies leveraging cutting-edge semiconductor technolozies.[1],

articleTitle: Evaluating the Impact of Radiated Emissions from Wireless Devices on EMC in Healthcare Facilities
abstract: This technical abstract evaluates the capacity effect of radiated emissions from wireless devices on electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) in healthcare centers. It examines the regulations in place for restricting radiated emissions, the methods for measuring the emissions, and the ability outcomes of EMC impacts on affected person care. It attracts from instructional literature, technical research, and requirements files to analyze the present frame of evidence on this topic. The results of this review suggest that radiated emissions from Wi-Fi devices can cause large interference in medical gadgets. Pointers are made for healthcare centers to reduce the threat of EMC impacts by way of identifying and reducing sources of interference according to safety rules, the usage of suitable mitigation strategies, and tracking regularly to ensure compliance.

articleTitle: IOT- Based Multilingual and Multicolored Scrolling Display
abstract: Technological advancements have accompanied the development of innovations in information display, marketing, and advertising. We introduce the construction and implementation of the unique IoT scroller system, which is developed using the Arduino technology. The system has a voice control capability and comes in colorful and multilingual versions offering users an interactive, flexible, and user- friendly interface. Our system, which makes use of the Internet of Things, links all smart devices to provide up-to-date information and personalization. We offer a platform that is easy to use and flexible in terms of different types of content. Our project is to meet the growing demand for the dynamic and flexible displays, both in advertising, public transit, and in the information flow. We walk through the design, implementation details and the performance evaluation of the system while boosting its effectiveness, reliability, and addressing the areas of improvement. Eventually, our work creates a novel gateway to communication and participation in the digital age by promoting advancement of internet of things (IoT) based displays.

articleTitle: A Low-Power CLA Adder Using a 1-Bit Hybrid Full-Adder on the 45nm Technology
abstract: In logic circuits, typically perform add, subtract, division, and multiply operations. In today's digital era, adders are useful circuits with several applications. Our design focuses on generating minimal power. Compared the 1-bit hybrid FA circuit to other adder designs, it is preferred because it has low-power dissipation, delay, and power product delay. Developed the CLA adder by using a 1-bit hybrid FA. The carry-out identification and time shortening in the adder circuit contribute to its fastest operation. determines the position of every digit to determine if it will propagate or produce a carry bit with a supply voltage of 1.0 volts.

articleTitle: Design of Arithmetic Logic Unit Using Reversible Logic Gates
abstract: The most crucial component of any microprocessor., computer., and digital signal processor (DSP) is the ALU. The processor's arithmetical and logic unit handles all logical and arithmetic operations. The complexity of the internal logic determines the CPU's processing speed. Analysing the error point gets more difficult while implementing ALU using irreversible gates. Using reversible gates for Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) is a potentially useful method for reducing energy dissipation in computer architecture. Traditional ALU s., constructed with irreversible logic gates, face challenges related to energy efficiency, particularly in power-constrained environments. Reversible computing offers a solution by ensuring that computational steps are reversible, thus theoretically conserving energy. Since the input and output vectors in reversible logic gates are mapped one to one, input state vectors may always be rebuilt from output state vectors. Reversible logic circuits are capable of operating in both forward and backward directions. The ALU gives the computer the ability to add, subtract, and carry out logical operations like AND, OR., and so on. The proposed ALU is made up from Universal Reversible Gate(URG), Feynman, Fredkin & HNG reversible gates. Initially a 1-bit ALU is designed by using these gates, then the 1 bit ALU's are integrated to form the 4-bit ALU. Our proposed ALU can do operations like AND, OR, NOR, NAND, XOR, XNOR, ADDITION, SUBTRACTION.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Automatic Video Segmentation with Sentence Transformer Embeddings and KeyBERT-Based Subtopic Extraction
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-modal automatic video segmentation strategy by incorporating the audio tran-scripts along with the OCR output from video frames. Initially, the audio is segmented into smaller chunks based on the silence duration. Each chunk is subsequently transcribed using Whisper ASR. We also extract the textual content from the video frames using Tesseract OCR. The audio transcript and the OCR output are then embedded using sentence transformer. The resultant embeddings are then clustered using a hierarchical agglomerative clustering approach. To extract the relevant subtopic in each cluster, KeyBERT model is employed. The proposed architecture was tested on the publicly available LPM dataset and NMI, IOU, MOF and Fl score were used for evaluation. It was observed that the proposed method fared relatively better for long duration videos with average MOF, IOU and Fl scores of 0.78, 0.72 and 0.54 respectively.

articleTitle: Design of $(1+\alpha)$ Order Butterworth Filter Using Curve Fitting Approximation
abstract: The objective of this paper is to design <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(1+\alpha)$</tex> order Butterworth filter. The novel curve fitting approximation method is used to achieve the rational transfer function in s-domain for low pass, high pass filters and the frequency response of these filters has been obtained with the help of MATLAB simulation software. The main advantage of this method is that the cut of frequencies of the filters are fully controllable, where the flexible and reconfigurable analog filter capabilities are indispensable. The magnitude response of 1.1, 1.3 and 1.5 order filters are compared with the integer order ones.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Music Recommendation System Based on User Interest
abstract: Recommendation Systems are trending data science application today. It mainly provides thoughtful recommendations derived from their previous preferences towards those items. Selecting from millions of songs can be a challenging task for individuals at times. There is need of such a system which can give suggestions according to their taste. The highly used recommendation algorithms i.e. content-based filtering, collaborative filtering and hybrid ensemble-based methods used in this research. It aims to eradicate less relevant results for personalized music search, which uses these methods. Content-based method recommends music according to user's data. Here, subjective features like album, sung by, genre etc. are analyzed. Dataset available on Kaggle which contains these fields. While, on the other hand collaborative Filtering method gives recommendations based on the preferences and behavior of other users. We will integrate our hybrid ensemble model using various algorithms into android application which can also recommend songs from those available locally on the user's device. The main focus is to study the users' choices, history in such a way that the next song that gets played is what the user will most probably want to listen.

articleTitle: Secured Electronic Voting Using Ethereum Blockchain Technology
abstract: This project aims to solve the problems of the existing centralized server-based voting system by implementing a blockchain-based e-voting system. The decentralized nature of the system ensures that the voting details are maintained by multiple nodes, and even if one node fails or crashes, the data can still be retrieved from other working nodes. The use of cryptography in this system ensures the security of the voting details. Each user's voting data is encrypted and stored in the blockchain, which is secured by a hash code. The hash code acts as a digital signature and helps to ensure the integrity of the data. This makes it very difficult for anyone to alter the data or hack into the system. The immutability of the blockchain is another important feature of this system. Once the data is stored in the blockchain, it cannot be altered or deleted. This ensures that the voting details are tamper-proof and cannot be manipulated by anyone. Overall, the use of decentralization, cryptography, and blockchain technology makes this e-voting system more secure, transparent, and reliable than the traditional centralized server-based voting systems. It eliminates the risk of data loss, hacking, or manipulation, and ensures that each vote is counted accurately

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Classification of Horticultural Maladies: Leveraging Pre-Trained Models for Disease Detection in Crop Plants
abstract: Despite deep learning's impressive track record in image categorization, obtaining the massive volumes of labeled data needed to train neural networks from the ground up may be a daunting and expensive undertaking, particularly in highly specialized fields like horticulture. By drawing on the expertise of models that have already been trained on massive data sets, such as ImageN et, transfer learning provides a potent method for getting around this restriction. This study evaluates transfer learning for horticulture disease classification using MobileNetV2, ResNet50, EfficientNetB2, DenseNet121, and VGG16. Images of healthy and diseased plants from various species were used to fine-tune models. MobileNetV2, with 96.57% training accuracy and 86.05% validation accuracy, outperformed all other approaches. This shows the great potential of transfer learning to build data-efficient models for horticulture disease monitoring and diagnosis. Maximum yields, early crop disease detection, and automation may benefit from the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Navigating the Interplay of Privacy, Security and Ethics on Social Media
abstract: Social media has changed the way people interact with the digital world, communicate, and exchange information. It has also brought privacy, security, and ethics into sharper relief. A fundamental concern is privacy, which includes people's rights to manage their personal data. Social networking sites are repositories of user data, which gives rise to worries about illegal access and privacy violations. Furthermore, complex algorithms make it more difficult to maintain privacy by obfuscating the distinction between invasive surveillance and individualized experiences. To protect user data and retain confidence, security is important. Social media users are vulnerable to online risks like phishing and identity theft, though, because of their interconnectedness. It's always difficult to strike a balance between security precautions and consumer comfort. The ethical implications of data monetization, algorithmic biases, and disinformation are particularly significant. Platforms face societal challenges such as digital harassment and political manipulation in addition to problems with data ownership, transparency, and responsibility. To overcome all of these, we have come forward with a solution that has 3 features. With the help of machine learning algorithms and python libraries, we made a solution that helps the users with these three concerns of social media.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of 6T And 9T SRAM Using 90 nm Technology
abstract: In microprocessors, computers, and portable devices, the SRAM cell—which consists of latches—preserves data without the need for a refresh. Its speed, low power consumption, and lack of refresh requirement make it a popular choice. For memory to be dependable, each SRAM cell must have a sizable Static Noise Margin (SNM). Voltage fluctuations and scaling cause poor read/write performance and SNM reduction in typical 6T-cell SRAM under sub-threshold settings. To overcome these constraints and improve SNM in read, hold, and write operations, we provide a 9T SRAM. In order to provide insights on overcoming traditional SRAM constraints, Cadence Virtuoso examines the performance of 6T and 9T SRAM.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Approach for the Prediction of Team Potential and Result During Cricket Match
abstract: This is an insightful exploration of data science in the domain of cricket. The paper delves into the complications of any cricket league and demonstrates how data and statistics from cricket can be leveraged to calculate team potential. The paper investigates the team potential as per the team performance in the past which is useful to rank teams without ongoing performances. This paper introduces a unique way of analyzing team potential that leads to an investment strategy on any team, along with an innovative analysis of different hyperparameters of the game. It also considers crucial factors like team required run rate, run-making rate, toss, place, and exact location of the games in predicting match outcomes. In this paper, the previous year (2008 - 2022) data of the IPL (Indian Premier League) has been quantified. The Artificial Neural Network, & Random Forest algorithm has been used to execute the above-mentioned predictions. A maximum of 99.81% accuracy for match-winning prediction has been achieved.

articleTitle: Power Quality Issues in Power System & Load Voltage Compensation for Boosting Performance
abstract: Electrical power system performance is often evaluated through the lens of power quality, which encompasses a wide array of factors. This term encapsulates the reliability and effectiveness of the system in delivering electricity while meeting specified standards. Electric power is one of the most efficient and indispensable forms of energy across the globe. Its ubiquitous presence underscores its critical role in modern life, as many aspects of daily living is dependent on a consistent supply of electricity. In today's advancing society, the focus extends beyond merely providing electricity; ensuring a consistent and high-quality power supply is paramount. With human reliance on electricity being so profound, the reliability and quality of the power system are crucial. The various components of the electrical network within a power system work together to generate, transmit, distribute, and utilize energy according to the needs of diverse consumers. Simultaneously, maintaining the excellence and continuity of electrical energy is vital for the optimal functioning of consumer appliances and equipment. The power system connects hundreds of generators to load centers like cities. Issues like voltage fluctuations or interruptions can affect consumers. These problems can damage electronics, disrupt services, and pose safety risks. Improving power quality requires maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, and advanced monitoring to ensure efficient and reliable electricity supply. Indeed, maintaining high-quality power is crucial for ensuring reliable and efficient electricity supply.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Indium with Group V Based Semiconductor in JLTFET Device
abstract: This work presents a numerical analysis to compare the performance of compound semiconductor material where indium (group III) material with group V materials i.e., antimony, phosphide, and nitride on junctionless tunnel field-effect-transistor (JLTFET). The compound semiconductor material that has been employed while performing the comparative analysis are InSb, InP, and InN. The variation in the electrical performances have been carried out by considering several figures-of-merits like electric field drop, bandgap fluctuations, electron concentrations, potential distribution, and transfer characteristics of the device.

articleTitle: Impact Assessment of Optimization Algorithm on Microgrid Fault Resilience
abstract: This research explores micro grid management with a particular emphasis on improving its performance following a fault incident. Unanticipated demand spikes due to incidents or interruptions pose a challenge for micro grids, which are characterized by the integration of multiple renewable energy sources, storage options, and traditional backup systems, such as diesel generators. We compare and contrast all optimization methods in detail, looking at how well they manage load demand, keep the system reliable, and make the most of the resources available. Our goal is to shed light on the pros and cons of chosen optimization method by analyzing important performance indicators like cost reduction, load balancing, and energy efficiency improvement.

articleTitle: A Novel Harmonic Filter to Enhance Power Quality through THD reduction and Power Factor Correction
abstract: The research paper aims to develop an advanced dynamic reactive power compensation system with active power filter for improvement in power quality. This study describes an active power filter that compensates for reactive power while also eliminating current harmonics induced by nonlinear loads. Low power factor forces the sector to satisfy high demand, making it inefficient. This paper examines power quality with and without proposed THD reduction techniques in different load condition which is then simulated in MATLAB environment and it is found that proposed techniques is useful when working with harmonic limits.

articleTitle: Utilizing CNN and RF Models for Multi-Level Classification: Understanding Beetroot Aphid Disease Severity
abstract: The management of agrarian pests facing the world's agriculture is a primary challenge, being the major factor affecting farm crops several times. Among all these pests, the beetroot aphid case is indeed an urgent issue for the farmers to handle correctly at the right time in addition to disease severity classification for efficient interventions. This research work proposes an innovative Hybrid model that consists of two elements both of which represent the competitive feature extraction qualities of convolutional neural network (CNN) and the superior classification traits of Random Forest (RF) algorithms for successfully classifying a beetroot aphid disease in five distinct levels. Through the process of a comprehensive beetroot leaf image dataset, the model is subjected to varying levels of training, testing, and validation, showing superior performance in comparison to a CNN architecture alone, the RF, and a previous state-of-the-art model. The result exhibited the ability of the hybrid artificial intelligence (AI) models to provide advanced pest detection and management tools that could alleviate the pressure of vast amounts of data collection and analysis for agriculturalists and researchers. In the sphere of agricultural technologies and pest management, this research expands the variety of working techniques used to resolve pest-driven issues and develop sustainable farming methods and elaborate crop management systems.

articleTitle: High Gain Arrow Shaped Log-Periodic Dipole Array Antenna for 5G Applications
abstract: In this paper, we present the novel arrow-shaped Log-periodic dipole array (LPDA) antenna suitable for 5G networks of operating frequencies at 3.3-3.8 GHz (n78 band) and 4.4-4.8 GHz (n77 band). This antenna is simulated on a cost-effective ArIon AD 450 substrate of 11.7×4.8×0.1524 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> size. The antenna's return loss, radiation pattern and surface current propagation are investigated. The performance of this antenna is discussed and compared to a basic reference LPDA antenna and previously reported antennas. The findings show that the proposed arrow-shaped LPDA antenna has an adequate gain of 4.377/5.031dBi at 3.6/4.5GHz with a radiation efficiency of 91.27/86.16%. The 2D polar pattern of both of these antennas shows a Dumbbell-shaped broader H-plane and a narrower E-plane, and as frequency increases, the radiation pattern becomes more compact, resulting in optimal gain and efficiency.

articleTitle: An Analytical Study of Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Protocol for Wireless Network Security
abstract: This analytical examine investigates the safety of net Key change (IKE) Protocol for wireless networks. It specializes in how IKE works and the unique additives that it involves so one can provide relaxed key trade. The paper examines the IKE protocol primarily based at the maximum current requirements and gives a complete review of ways the protocol works, its key components, the safety mechanisms it is predicated on, its blessings, and its weaknesses. thru our examine, it's miles discovered that even though IKE is considered to be one of the most relaxed protocols for Wi-Fi networks, there are nevertheless certain regions within the protocol that have ability for improvement. The paper concludes with numerous tips on a way to maximize the security furnished by using IKE while minimizing its potential for weakness.

articleTitle: OCR-Based Research on the Early Warning System for Cold-Chain Cargo
abstract: Study on the cold chain cargo early warning system Using OCR technology This research develops a set of intelligent cold chain cargo proxories that are semi-automatic. The main technology for cold chain dairy Fast Moving Consumer Goods contractors is a proximity warning system with wireless data transfer, a lightweight Optical Character Recognition identification algorithm framework, and electronic label automated warning. To achieve wireless transmission and reception of equipment, Pulse Frequency Modulation modulation and demodulation are utilised as the primary hardware technologies. Digital electronic tags are also incorporated to alert the same batch of impending items. Software-wise, an early warning system is created and picture preparation and identification techniques are researched using the Chinese-ocr algorithm. in order to achieve semi-automatic cold chain logistics product early warning.

articleTitle: Hybridization of Classification ML Algorithms to Predict Alzheimer Disease
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease primarily known as AD is a neurodegenerative disorder disease which destroys the cognitive function of the brain and also decreases brain memory. This research paper explores the growth of a hybrid Machine Learning model for the classification of AD based on demographic and clinical features. The dataset utilized in this study comprises information from individuals diagnosed as either non-demented or demented, with features, including age, gender, and various cognitive test scores. The proposed model integrates multiple classifiers, including RF (Random Forest), LR (Logistic Regression), Support Vector Machines, KNN (K-Nearest Neighbours), and Decision Trees, using a soft voting ensemble approach. The effectiveness of the hybrid model was evaluated using classification reports and accuracy metrics. The results demonstrate promising performance, achieving an accuracy of 96.88% on the test dataset. Furthermore, the classification report illustrates high recall, F1 score, and precision for both non-demented as well as demented classes, indicating the robustness and generalization capability of the proposed approach in AD classification tasks.

articleTitle: IoT Based Two-Wheelers Traffic Violation Detection System Using YOLOv7
abstract: Addressing traffic violations, particularly concerning motorcycle safety, remains a pressing issue in many urban areas. This research proposes a novel approach for automating the detection of motorcycle riders without helmets and those engaging in triple riding, and instances of overspeeding or speed violations. By leveraging state-of-the-art computer vision techniques and deep learning algorithms, the system analyzes both image and video inputs in real-time to identify and classify traffic violations accurately. The integration of the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm ensures efficient object detection, enabling prompt intervention by traffic authorities. Through the utilization of diverse datasets and advanced machine learning models, this research aims to enhance the effectiveness of traffic law enforcement and promote safer road behavior.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Land Cover Classification by Unleashing Transfer Learning in Satellite Imagery
abstract: Finding the meaning of satellite photos is crucial for remote sensing applications as more and more automated solutions are required. By applying sophisticated deep learning models, especially VGG19 and MobileNet, for the classification of satellite images, this work seeks to satisfy the need for precise and efficient interpretation techniques. The paper looks at the challenges in the benchmark datasets now in use for remote sensing image interpretation and introduces a new dataset called “Satellite Image Classification Dataset-RSI-CB256,” which is made up of four distinct classes derived from sensors and Google Maps snapshots. The approach proposed extracts fine characteristics from satellite photos by using transfer learning and the previously learned capabilities of the VGG19 and MobileNet architectures. The model's durability is increased by careful preparation of the dataset, which includes methods like data augmentation, scaling, and normalisation. Comparison studies demonstrate how well VGG19 and MobileNet capture intricate patterns in the diverse data. With an accuracy of 98.93%, MobileNet shows remarkable performance and its capacity for best use of resources in various applications.

articleTitle: HR Analytics for Talent Acquisition: Leveraging Genetic Algorithms and Neural Networks
abstract: In a world where things are heading toward a new order of human resource management, the use of sophisticated analytics seems to be a critical strategy that can be used to accelerate talent selection. The research focuses on the employment of genetic algorithms as well as neural networks in human resource (HR) analytics to heighten recruitment efficiency as well as make it more precise or have higher accuracy. Based on a combined quantitative and qualitative strategy, the research develops and verifies a model that involves leveraging AI algorithms, helping to match job candidates to the right positions, and predicting their work-related success indicators. As the resulting study shows, genetic algorithms can cut down the time-to-match and enhance the matching accuracy by organizing the matching process by using optimization methods. Bearing in mind this, neural networks as one of the attractions offer predictive insights into candidate performance which gives a possibility of better and more informed hiring choices. Organizations that adopt this dual approach to talent acquisition will not only tend to attract the best talents but as well achieve their strategic goals more efficiently. This study adds to the overall body of knowledge on human resource analytics by giving examples of the contributions of solving the challenge of talent acquisition through genetic algorithms and neural networks. It emphasizes what analytics with the advanced state provide HR systems with, and which, therefore, is their future. It is through more data-driven, efficient, and effective recruitments that the goal can be attained. The study also elucidates the operational significance for HR professionals, mentions the current study manifestations, and provides suggestions on the way forward for the implementation of HR analytics and technology.

articleTitle: Unveiling Irregular Heart Rhythms: Utilizing a Pretrained ResNet50 Convolutional Neural Network Autoencoder Strategy for Detecting Anomalies in ECG Signals
abstract: This study examines the application of ResNet50 (CNN) Autoencoders for identifying abnormalities in electrocardiogram (ECG) data using the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database. The dataset comprises 14,552 samples categorized as normal heartbeats and heartbeats affected by cardiac disorders. Utilizing Transposed Convolution has significantly improved the model's performance. The study emphasizes the vital role of immediately detecting cardiac irregularities and presents a CNN Autoencoder model designed to efficiently encode and decode ECG data, aiding in the detection of aberrant patterns. The approach involves building a robust Autoencoder with encoder and decoder components that are trained to minimize errors in reconstruction. The evaluation metrics show the model's outstanding performance with an accuracy of 76.93%, precision of 55.23%, recall of 89.81%, and Fl score of 65.40%. This work highlights the need of utilizing deep learning techniques to detect abnormalities in ECG data at an early stage. This method demonstrates significant promise in increasing diagnostic abilities and enhancing patient results.

articleTitle: Enhancing Anthracnose Severity Grading in Green Beans Through Integration of Deep Learning Models
abstract: Grading of Anthracnose disease severity in green beans must be accomplished since it stands second to no task for efficient disease control and improved agricultural performance. Conventional approaches, mainly relying on the manual work of an inspector, are unable to achieve sufficient amounts of scalability, universality, and objectivity. This work is going to propose a new hybrid model that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Random Forest (RF) for the automatic evaluation of the Anthracnose severity (from grade 0 (no infection) to grade 3 (severe infection)). The model relies on a dataset comprising images of green beans that have been collected through varying conditions. CNN is used by the model for feature extraction while the classification part is done by RF. The hybrid model was evaluated based on the metrics of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score among others, and has shown that it can classify the severity of Anthracnose better than usual techniques. The model scored an overall accuracy of 94.75% with high precision and recall equally appearing in all grades of severity; however, it greatly outperformed at detecting samples without infections and those with severe infections. This study depicts the capacity of combining deep learning and machine learning methods in the graduality of diseases enabling a scalable and reliable solution for precision agriculture. The study indicates substantial principles, like precision treatment of diseases, the optimal allocation of resources, and novel technologies for the inciting diagnosis of diseases. Future work should be aimed at the fine-tuning of the model, evaluating its potential in other diseases of plants, and extension of the tool to other crops. This will imply helping sustainable agriculture and food availability.

articleTitle: Phonocardiography (PCG) Categorization Using Deep Models
abstract: This work aimed to enhance the effectiveness of deep learning models in classifying phonocardiogram (PCG) data by utilizing spectrograms. This study presents promising results that highlight the effectiveness of deep learning approaches in the realm of medical diagnostics. Utilizing spectrograms and a CNN architecture to accurately categorize PCG signals has the potential to significantly aid in the quick identification and assessment of cardiac abnormalities, ultimately resulting in improved patient outcomes. The high precision and accuracy, together with the low error rates, demonstrate the efficacy of our strategy in integrating deep learning and data augmentation methods to create a reliable system for categorizing PCG signals. Given these settings, it seems that the model may effectively identify cardiac issues from PCG data, rendering it a valuable tool for early diagnosis and detection.

articleTitle: Liver Disease Prediction Using Bayesian Optimized Classification Algorithms
abstract: Liver disease poses a significant public health concern globally, necessitating accurate predictive models for early diagnosis. This research study uses the efficacy of Bayesian optimization in enhancing the performance of classifiers for liver disease identification. Specifically, it evaluates popular machine learning techniques, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, Adaptive Boosting, and Extreme Gradient Boosting, to determine their effectiveness. The Pearson Correlation Feature Selection algorithm is used for choosing the best features and Bayesian optimization is employed to fine-tune the hyperparameters of these algorithms. The research makes use of a Kaggle dataset from the UCI machine learning library, which includes clinical features that are utilized to train and assess the prediction models. The findings show that optimization enhances these classification systems' performance, leading to higher prediction accuracy. RF achieved the highest accuracy of 81.06% followed by SVM (80.81 %), AdaBoost (77.08%), and XGBoost (79.85%).

articleTitle: Navigating Accommodation: The Evolution of Hostel Finding Apps
abstract: In the modern era of increasing student mobility, finding suitable accommodation has become a crucial aspect of the student experience. This study introduces ‘Hostel Finder’ a mobile-based application that will serve as a comprehensive platform, offering a wide range of hostels based on location, amenities, and budget preferences. The app will match students with suitable accommodation options, ensuring a seamless and efficient search process. Real-time availability and pricing information will be integrated into the app, allowing students to make informed decisions and secure their desired hostels without any hassle. For easy navigation, maps are also integrated into the app. By leveraging advanced technologies like Flutter, Android studio, and Firebase database to develop this mobile-based application. This application was developed in such a manner so that it can provide a user-friendly interface, and users can use it more efficiently.

articleTitle: 434MHz G-Shaped Cavity Backed Hyperthermia Applicator for Breast Cancer Application
abstract: Treatment with Hyperthermia has become a viable therapeutic option for breast cancers, providing accurate and non-invasive therapy to target the cancerous tissue is crucial. This work presents a G-shaped antenna design housed inside an aluminum chamber probe with a coaxial feed that is matched at an impedance of 50 Ohms. The proposed antenna operates at an ISM frequency of 434MHz. Notably, the antenna's dimensions have been miniaturized to (3.6cm x 3.8cm x 1.6cm) to improve its suitability for applications involving hyperthermia, it is suitable for treating breast cancer patients. The Applicator is immersed in deionized water and analyzed on a phantom mimicking Breast properties. It achieves a substantial S11 parameter of -23.10 dB at exactly 434MHz and a directivity of 5.009dBi. The antenna can be referred to as a unidirectional antenna because its main lobe transmits energy mostly in one direction, boosting its performance for targeted breast cancer treatment applications. This work for a single-phased antenna can be utilized to design an array of applicators that can surround the breast and treat tumors. The proposed work has been performed in CST 2019 Software.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Hybrid Automotive Fast Charging System
abstract: The purchasing price, autonomy, charging system, and infrastructure all affect the development of electric cars (EVs). This paper addresses the final factor: EV fast-charging layout. The fast-charging station has photovoltaic power and a parking system to increase profitability and reduce grid electricity use. This study uses a detailed charging method that accounts for electrical vehicle appearance time and rate, unlike other publications. First, the EV demand and renewable generation are modelled using Monte Carlo. A genetic algorithm (GA) optimises EV fast-charging setup and operation. It shows the best answer that maximises internet gift value income. The impact of renewable energies and garage structures is examined in several cases. Results show that combining renewable energies and garage structures yields a green solution.

articleTitle: Analysis of SOC Estimation and Emission Reduction of Various Hybrid Electric vehicles
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of state-of-charge (SOC) estimation and its impact on emission reduction in various types of hybrid electric vehicles. With the increasing adoption of electric and hybrid vehicles, accurate SOC estimation plays a crucial role in optimizing battery management systems and enhancing vehicle performance. Furthermore, reducing emissions from hybrid electric vehicles remains a significant challenge, necessitating advanced control strategies and emission reduction technologies. This paper reveals about IM&PMSM-based series and parallel hybrid electric vehicles with FWD powertrain configurations and NiMH and Li-ion-based battery packs. All the designs were tested in a MATLAB/Simulink software environment, and the proposed series hybrid model with a Li-ion battery driven by a PMSM motor gave optimum results with better SOC, and NiMH-based series hybrid electric vehicles emitted less contamination to the environment.
