articleTitle: Detecting AI Generated Text
abstract: The exponential progression in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies has spearheaded the evolution towards proliferation of AI-generated text across various online platforms. This phenomenon poses significant challenges in maintaining the integrity of information dissemination and combating misinformation. In response, this project proposes a comprehensive approach to detecting AI-generated text through ML methods. By leveraging a diverse dataset of both AI-generated and human-generated text, the project aims to develop robust models capable of accurately discerning AI-generated content. The methodology involves feature engineering, model training, and validation using state-of-the-art NLP frameworks. Additionally, the project explores the ethical implications of AI-generated content detection and considers potential countermeasures against adversarial attacks. The outcomes of this project have practical implications for enhancing content moderation systems, safeguarding against malicious use of AI, and fostering trust in online information ecosystems.

articleTitle: Implementation of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure for Effective Charging
abstract: The use of internal combustion engines increases the need for imported oil and can increase green house gas emissions which can cause global warming. Electric vehicles (EV) have been proven to be an asset in eradicating air pollution and protecting the environment. Users are hesitant to switch from internal combustion engines to electric vehicles because of the unavailability of charging stations. The solution involves an on-site deployment of IOT-based Electric vehicle charging (EVC) modules in numerous locations such as public parking facilities, residential areas, workplaces, and educational institutions with the support of solar energies, which is easy and hassle-free charging of EVs. The IOT module employs the user to set the time of charging of an EV. The charging / control circuit is the used to calculate the parameters related to charging time and the cost of charging which is displayed on the charging port. Hence the proposed work offers feasibility to the EV owners by reducing the time of charging and proving to be a theft-free charging station.

articleTitle: Translation System for the Visually Impaired from English to Braille
abstract: The amount of information in the modern world is huge and is growing at a rapid speed because of new technological advancements and new researches being conducted every day. Internet has paved a pivotal role in the distribution of information easily which has enriched human knowledge. This interconnected digital landscape has significantly enhanced accessibility and the flow of information, marking a transformative shift in how knowledge is shared and updated. Various software and websites enable the translation of information into any language, providing flexibility and accessibility across diverse linguistic preferences which helps people to grow their knowledge. But the Visually Impaired have no standard means to translate information to Braille which has caused a significant information gap for them. They are unable to get updated to new information and the information is not available for them in their language. This paper proposes to use deep learning which facilitates the translation of English text to Braille that aids the visually impaired in staying updated and also get access to information in Braille language.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Approach for Malaria Parasite Detection Using Deep Learning in Blood Smears
abstract: Malaria affects public health issues significantly and is one of the most severe infectious diseases in the world. Anopheles mosquitoes attack humans who carry the virus in order to disseminate it. To manage the sickness and get the best potential treatment outcomes, accurate parasite identification is essential. A critical first step in the diagnosis and treatment of malaria is the traditional method of using a microscope to search blood samples for malarial parasites. A diagnosis made using this approach is time-consuming since it relies heavily on the examiner's expertise and experience. To improve the speed and accuracy of diagnosis, this study suggests a deep learning model for malarial parasite prediction. In this study, we report on a Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) model, also called the VGG-19 model, which detects malaria parasites with 97% accuracy using microscopic images of blood samples. Enhancing the efficacy and precision of the diagnosis is the aim of this method. This model has been trained on a set of images of blood smears and is capable of accurately distinguishing between samples that are infected and those that are not. Malaria may be less common in areas where it is endemic if this automated diagnostic method is successfully implemented and results in early diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Deciphering Emotions: Unveiling Sentiment in Comments Through A-DNN-Based Analysis
abstract: The task of conducting sentiment analysis on textual data poses significant challenges due to the intricate nature of language and the subjective aspects of basic human communication. Attention-based Deep Neural Network (A-DNN) is proposed as a solution for doing sentiment analysis on YouTube comments. The A-DNN model utilizes attention mechanisms and deep learning techniques to improve the accuracy of categorization. The extraction of exact semantic information is conducted by focusing on critical segments of the input text. To overcome the challenges of using low-quality training data and the need for cross-modal sentiment analysis, comprehensive preprocessing techniques are employed and attention mechanisms are included into the model's structure. The experimental results indicate that the A-DNN model demonstrates higher efficacy and robustness in comparison to other baseline models. The model's overall adaptability is enhanced by its structural flexibility and its ability to effectively handle various online sentiment analysis jobs. The model achieved an overall accuracy of 99.49% depicting the efficiency and reliability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Utilising Machine Learning for Modulation and Signal Processing
abstract: Device studying (ML) is an effective device that has been used in many packages, consisting of virtual sign processing, communications structures, and modulation reputation. In particular, ML has been extensively studied for modulation recognition, which is a hard hassle because of the always-changing and unpredictable nature of the sign. With the aid of leveraging ML strategies, which can be used to quantify and check specific houses of a signal, reliable modulation popularity and signal processing strategies can be evolved. For instance, ML can be used to automatically discover modulation class when the image shape of the signal is unknown. It is achieved via reading the sign with device learning techniques consisting of Fourier transform; wavelet-based totally function extraction, and convolutional neural networks. Different applications encompass channel estimation, signal detection, and optimization of verbal exchange networks. Further to recognizing modulation codecs, ML-based algorithms may be used to enhance signal processing and communique systems. It could be done with the aid of developing smarter systems that are capable of studying global data. ML can be used to robotically apprehend anomalous alerts and allow networks to quickly adapt to converting situations. ML techniques can also be used to optimize community parameters, which include power management, coding schemes, and modulation codecs, so as to maximize their performance.

articleTitle: Design Analysis of Two Stage OP-AMP and TIQ as a Comparator for Flash ADC
abstract: This paper proposes a comparative analysis of a two stage operational amplifier and a threshold inverter quantizer as comparators for the application of Flash ADC. The comparators are designed using Cadence Virtuoso with 180nm technology for two stage op-amp and TIQ respectively. The input common mode range of both the comparators ranges from 1.8V to 0.9V at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$27^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>. The simulated results for a two stage op-amp achieves a high gain of 65.49dB with a phase margin of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$58^{\circ}$</tex> and power dissipation of 279.2uW. The TIQ comparator produces a power dissipation of 1.128 nW. The total summarized noise of Two-stage Op-amp is computed as 9.300E-17v/sqrt(Hz) and that of TIQ as 9.721E-17v/sqrt(Hz).

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Malware Detection in Enterprise Networks
abstract: Malware detection is a software and technique that detects malicious activity on a host or network. The internet's rapid growth and development necessitate data verification and authentication before its use in an enterprise. Therefore, we should deploy ML techniques to identify and detect malware, thereby aiding in the protection of the enterprise network. The paper illustrates malware detection techniques by utilizing the CICIDS-2017 dataset, selecting relevant features, and grouping the dataset into different classes depending on their characteristics, such as weight. Also, we employ classification techniques such as naive Bayes models, support vector algorithms, random forests, and decision trees (C4.5). The accuracy of these systems is 72.96%, 96%, 99.67%, and 99.59%, respectively, and we compare their performance. Additionally, we employ preprocessors to identify malware patterns in the training dataset and monitor online network traffic. These systems classify the malware as either benign or malicious. Among various ML techniques, the research indicates that random forests obtain the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Unveiling AI Patterns: An Experimental Evaluation of Machine Learning Based Women's Safety Prediction Strategy
abstract: As is common knowledge, there is a long history of harassment of women all throughout the world, beginning with stalking and continuing to more serious types of abuse such as acid attacks, rape, obscenity, pornography, and other forms of abuse. In light of these worries, it has been proposed that the application of machine learning on tweets be utilized in order to do an analysis of the safety of women in urban areas of India. The Sentimental Analysis is employed as the primary idea, and it is carried out by machine learning using input from tweets. This is done to ensure that safety is taken into consideration. Increasing people's awareness can be accomplished by the use of sentiment analysis to tweets. Social media platforms such as Twitter and Instagram, which are well-known for their capacity to distribute information on a worldwide scale, provide women with the opportunity to communicate their feelings to the rest of the world. Because Twitter enables users to effortlessly connect with one another through text, audio, and video, we have listed it as a resource that is of great value. This enables our study to be more persuasive than the opinions of those who are in our immediate vicinity. In this study, a novel model that is referred to as the Artificial Intelligence based Safety Prediction Strategy (AISPS) is presented in order to provide a clear evaluation of the effectiveness of the system that has been recommended. The standard method known as Support Vector Machine (SVM) is utilized in order to do cross-validation on it.

articleTitle: A ViT Vision Transformer Model for Rose Leaf Disease Classification
abstract: All of the oldest and most common ornamental plants that are planted worldwide is the rose. One of the most beloved and well-known flowers in human history, roses are famed for their unmatched beauty and deep symbolic meaning. Because of their beautiful aroma and amazing beauty, roses are one of the most popular decorative plants in the world. A multitude of plant diseases have turned agricultural production into a living hell for all those engaged. By the use of visualization techniques, the model's interpretability is enhanced, improving the understanding of diseases and providing new perspectives on the characteristics that have been learned. A detailed analysis of rose leaf diseases has been presented in this article, with a focus on developing a classification model that accurately detects and distinguishes between different illnesses. ViT has been used for the categorization of rose diseases for this reason. The operation was halted at epoch 34 owing to an early stop, however, epoch 50 was applied initially. The accuracy is 0.9986 and the loss is 0.0209 at this point, and the accuracy is 0.9744 and the loss is 0.1141 throughout validation.

articleTitle: Anti-Clonenet: A Blockchain System for Post Supply Anti-Counterfeiting
abstract: In recent years, radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has played a pivotal role in combating counterfeiting within the supply chain. However, as counterfeiting methods evolve, there is a growing need for innovative solutions to ensure the authenticity of products even after they have entered the market. One of the significant advantages of Anti-IoneN et is its ability to counterfeiting attempts, even if the counterfeit products carries a genuine RFID tag. This is achieved by requiring sellers to prove ownership information, customers can identify and reject counterfeit products confidently. The proposed system not only enhances customer confidence but also provides a powerful tool for brand protection. By leveraging blockchain's decentralization and immutability, Anti-CloneN et offers a tamper -resistant and highly reliable method to combat counterfeiting throughout the product lifecycle. Anti-CloneN et represents a groundbreaking solution for post supply chain anti-counterfeiting. This system empowers consumers to make informed purchasing decisions and strengthens brand integrity.

articleTitle: Development of Millimeter Wave Communication Using Dielectric Resonator Antennas Using Substrate Technology
abstract: Communication systems have become an integral part through the incorporation of advanced technologies. The millimeter-wave communication systems are developed using the aid of substrate technology integrated with deep learning techniques. They represent a greater leap in the field of wireless communication. Millimeter-wave frequencies range from 30 GHz to 300 GHz that have the capacity of higher data rates. Dielectric resonator antennas are used in millimetre-wave applications due to their compact size and efficiency. The antennas are designed using dielectric materials which have the capacity to resonate at particular frequencies. The performance of these antennas is improved using the substrate technology accompanied with deep learning techniques. They provide the optimum solution for integration with communication devices. The miniaturization of antennas is implemented using higher dielectric constant substrates. The complexity of the millimeter-wave is overcome using the aid of k-means optimization techniques. Thus, adaptive communication solutions help in the development of a millimeter wave communication system. Thus, the communication reliability is attained using these optimization techniques with estimating the channel conditions in real-time environments.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Two-Port Multiple- Input Multiple-Output Antenna with Defected Ground Structure for WLAN Applications
abstract: The design and analysis of a dual-band multiple input multiple output monopole antenna with double branches is presented. The proposed antenna has an excellent impedance bandwidth at 2.4 GHz, and 5 GHz band, which is suitable for Wireless LAN applications. The return loss, port-to- port isolation, radiation pattern, and diversity gain are studied. The proposed antenna has a nearly omnidirectional radiation pattern with a gain of 2.2 dBi at 2.4 GHz, 4.5 dBi at 5.2 GHz, and 4.2 dBi at 5.5 GHz.

articleTitle: SeaBreeze Study: Exploring Air Quality Dynamics in Western Coastal Mumbai
abstract: Coastal regions, surrounded by water are frequently thought of as refuges with perfect air quality which creates an interesting paradox. In particular, areas like Juhu and Raj Bhavan in Mumbai, known for their coastal attributes, exhibit a puzzling inconsistency in air quality data. While temperature and wind speed data from local weather stations follow expected trends, air quality measurements reveal significant and unexpected variations. the work presented in this paper centers on the development of an integrated system designed to facilitate accurate weather parameter forecasting and secure data access, with an unwavering commitment to user experience and data integrity. The primary objectives of the research are to determine the factors that influence the variations in both regions and to create a cohesive framework that seamlessly combines user-friendly front-end features with a secure and efficient back-end infrastructure, granting users effortless access to a diverse range of weather parameters for analysis. The methodology entails the deployment of various essential modules, including user authentication, front-end dashboard construction, RESTful API integration, back-end database management, predictive modeling, and secure data transmission

articleTitle: Facial Recognition Using Siamese Neural Network and Data Augmentation Techniques
abstract: Our approach to one-shot classification involves training deep convolutional Siamese neural networks beforehand for verification. We present the fresh findings that contrasted our networks' performance with that of an expert classifier. It facilitates direct image pair comparisons, improving accuracy in identifying facial features under various conditions. The proposed methodology leverages a benchmark dataset in the field of facial recognition where faces vary in poses, lightening, and expressions which enhances the network's ability to generalize across different conditions. We present a detailed analysis of the Siamese network's architecture and its working. Our experiments demonstrate how data augmentation is implemented and highlight the corresponding results, and superior performance over traditional models, especially in challenging environments. The proposed methodology has accuracy of 96% on LFW dataset which is more as compared to other mainstream face recognition algorithms. This research contributes to advancing facial recognition technology, offering a concise and effective solution for identity verification.

articleTitle: Implementation of IC Segregation and Testing Using FPGA
abstract: This paper presents the development of an Integrated circuit (IC) segregation and testing system that combines mechanical models, FPGA (Field programmable gate arrays)-based image processing for segregation, and reconfigurable input/output configurations, oscillator circuit, DUT (Device under test) unit for testing. The system aims to automate the process of IC segregation, improving efficiency and accuracy. Key components of the system include orientation rectification, conveyer belt sequencing, IC identification through image capture, Sobel edge detection for text extraction, and IC classification based on testing requirements. The system is controlled by an Altera DEI FPGA board, interfacing with various peripherals and components to perform comprehensive IC testing and segregation.

articleTitle: An Experimental Study for Optimization of Cooling Efficiency of Peltier Module Using PLC
abstract: The peltier module is known to be very compact and precise control of temperature for various applications. For better cooling efficiency using peltier module, feat from the high temperature side should be efficiently managed. As peltier is known for power consumption thus a Programmable Logic Controller is utilized for optimal power management. The paper also deals with number of TEC1-12705 peltier modules utilization and the two coolants, namely water and ethylene glycol have been compared in different test cases. The water with two peltier modules proves to be a promising combination.

articleTitle: VGG19 Empowered Coral Health Assessment: A CNN- Based Model for Efficient Reef Monitoring and Conservation
abstract: This research study investigates the use of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transfer Learning in the field of coral reef conservation. It does this by introducing a dataset consisting of 923 photographs that classify corals as either healthy or bleached. The paper aims to solve the labor-intensive process of manually identifying coral reefs by providing an automated picture classification model based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). This is particularly important due to the crucial function of coral reefs and the issues they face, such as coral bleaching. The approach utilises the VGG 19 pre-trained CNN model and includes the use of training, validation, and testing datasets. Model monitoring is implemented via the use of callbacks. The hyperparameters of the model, such as batch size, epochs, and input shape, are explicitly defined. Common evaluation metrics used in machine learning include accuracy, confusion matrix, and classification report. The study highlights the advantages of the suggested paradigm in terms of efficiency, scalability, and real-time monitoring. The achieved accuracy of 74% demonstrates encouraging outcomes, highlighting the capability of CNNs in promptly identifying and tracking the well-being of coral reefs. This is vital for making well-informed decisions and undertaking conservation initiatives.

articleTitle: North Indian Ocean Tropical Cyclone Detection Using YOLOv5
abstract: This research paper focuses on the application of You Only Look Once version 5 (YOLOv5) Deep Learning (DL) architecture for cyclone detection and classification. Cyclones are one of the most devastating natural disasters that cause significant loss of lives and property damage. Accurate and timely detection and classification of cyclones can help in effective disaster management and mitigation. In this study, YOLOv5 is used for detecting and classifying cyclones in satellite images. The proposed method involves pre-processing the data, training the YOLOv5 model on the dataset, and evaluating the model's performance. The results demonstrate that the proposed method achieved high accuracy in both cyclone detection and classification tasks. This research paper provides insights into the potential of YOLOv5 in cyclone detection and classification, which can be beneficial in enhancing disaster management strategies.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Smart Indoor Substation Monitoring and Control System Based on IoT
abstract: In this modern age, everything is converting to smart systems where people want to be able to conveniently monitor and control processes. In this regard, indoor substation monitoring and control is also very important in the upcoming 4th generation automation system. In this paper, a prototype of an indoor substation system was developed that could be monitored and controlled from any location using a variety of sensors with the help of Internet of Things (IoT). In monitoring part, temperature, voltage, power factor and the load current through the relay can be remotely monitor. The system is also capable of operating automatically when any incident occurs. Additionally, how both monitoring and controlling operation can be accomplished was demonstrated through the use a mobile application. The design and implementation had been done in such a way that safety was prioritized, so that accident would not occur. By adding bunch of features, this project has been designed within a very low cost. Finally, all the initial goals have been achieved successfully.

articleTitle: Classification of Pneumonic Lungs Using EfficientNet-B5
abstract: In this research paper, the authors take a new angle: classify pneumonic lungs by utilizing up-to-date architecture such as EfficientNet-B5. Given a huge X-Ray dataset of real cases, the model is excellent at identifying pneumonia. The study aims to address a crucial need in the area of respiratory medicine-through development and application for clinical diagnosis of diseases of the lungs which are efficient, accurate and can be used on everyone. Its strong ability to learn is shown as the model demonstrates an awesome 99.43% training accuracy, checks itself out by verifying results with a validation accuracy of 92.28%, and sits tight under pressure during testing with an accuracy at 99.38%. As a matter of fact, these results serve to remind us that this model is excellent in accurately identifying normal and pneumonic lung conditions. This research not only enriches the growing literature on deep learning techniques in medical image analysis but also offers an extremely valuable tool for health care providers which can rapidly and precisely diagnose pneumonia. The method uses the EfficientNet-B5 architecture, known for its high performance in image classification. The model is built from a rich and diverse Chest X-Ray dataset, ensuring that it can be generalized to different patient populations and conditions of imaging. The study's findings hold promise for improving diagnostic accuracy, lowering human error as well as ultimately transforming patient outcomes in the realm of pneumonia detection by means automated image classification.

articleTitle: Microscopic Analysis of Light Propagation in Optical Fibers for Improved Image Quality
abstract: It has a look at examining light propagation in optical fibers to enhance photograph evaluation. To do so, we used microscopic cameras to take a look at Quantitative segment Imaging of existing mild. This technique was then used to measure the light intensity and angles of travel of the light emitted. Via these recordings, snapshots are produced that align with the transmitted beams. The ensuing photos from various light beams were analyzed to determine picture high-quality. With the usage of imaging techniques with more than a few fiber optical designs, we have been able to discover factors that correlate with a range of picture features. The effects display that optical fiber designs that have an outer surface with more reflectance value can enhance the picture fine. Our outcomes can be, in addition, used to enhance the performance of optical fiber designs and boom photograph quality for applications, which include optical sensing, medical imaging, and more.

articleTitle: Automated Multiclass Classification of Groundnut Leaf Diseases Using Fine-Tuned InceptionV3 Model
abstract: In agriculture, the specific identification and differentiation of varieties of plant disease is a very important factor in preserving the health of subsistence crops and resulting in optimal crop yields. The mentioned research paper is about an original technique for the multiclass classification of groundnut disease using fine-tuned Inception V3 model. Groundnut, a key crop for both nutrition and economic aspects, is vulnerable to multiple diseases such as Early Leaf Spot, Late Leaf Spot, Rust, and Groundnut Rosette Disease; each of which has an intense effect on crop yields. Using groundnut plant leaf images as a base for a comprehensive dataset, this study finetunes the Inception V3 model, pre-fed on ImageN et, to perform more precise differentiations between healthy and diseased leaves. The methodology that has been used includes dataset preparation, model fine-tuning, and model training by using training and validation datasets and relying on standard metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl score. Data confirms the model's accuracy in disease categorization and that it is much more efficient than routine and manual approaches. This study pragmatically points out the prospects of deep learning in improving agricultural management systems and also encourages extensive research of different forms of AI for diagnostics applications.

articleTitle: Dynamic Charging And Discharging Analysis of Lithium Ion Battery Using EKF Method
abstract: The state of charge, a portion of the electricity stored, is calculated, and used by battery management systems (BMS). However, SOC is not easily recognized because it is not directly visible and is challenging to quantify due to the nonlinear properties of batteries under complex working conditions. An increasing number of electric vehicles are using Li-ion batteries of the Lithium Ferro-Phosphate (LFP) type. Therefore, it's imperative to guarantee that the vehicle maintains a high level of autonomy while honouring the special qualities of LFP batteries and having accurate state-of-charge (SoC) monitoring. The SOC is attained by dynamically charging as well as discharging the cell. Next, the proposed model is used with the Extended Kalman Filter for accurate evaluation of SOC of LFP battery. The simulation was performed in Simulink of MATLAB.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Abnormal Early Warning System for Intermediate Joints Using Drawings and Laser Point Cloud Scanning Technology
abstract: The traditional abnormal early warning system for intermediate joints has the problems of low efficiency and poor early warning effect. The purpose of this paper is to design and implement an abnormal early warning system for intermediate joints using drawings and laser point cloud scanning technology, and to conduct research and analysis on it. First, this paper introduces the background of the abnormal early warning system for intermediate joints, emphasizing its importance and challenges in engineering projects. Second, this paper proposes a method using a combination of drawing and laser point cloud scanning techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of anomaly detection. Finally, through experiments and tests, the processing speed of the system in this paper ranges from 7.24 to 10.38 data/second. This research provides an innovative solution for the design and implementation of the abnormal early warning system for intermediate joints, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Leveraging VGG16 Deep Learning for Photovoltaic Panel Fault Classification
abstract: The work focuses on the urgent requirement for precise identification of flaws in Photovoltaic (PV) panels using deep learning, especially by utilizing the VGG16 architecture. The primary goal is to create a resilient model for classifying PV panel fault pictures into six separate categories. In order to do this, a training set consisting of 885 photos is utilized. The VGG16 model is then trained for 15 epochs, using a batch size of 32 and the default learning rate. The primary evaluation metric for assessing the model's ability to effectively diagnose PV panel problems is its accuracy performance. The findings demonstrate that the suggested VGG16 model attains a remarkable accuracy of 86% in classifying faults in PV panels. This study indicates that the model has the ability to recognize several fault types, emphasizing the potential practicality of this technology in real-life scenarios for detecting and managing defects in PV panels. The study highlights the advantages of incorporating Deep Learning methods, namely the VGG16 architecture, into the IDS sub-project of the Solar Power System, which improves efficiency, dependability, and troubleshooting skills. The research indicates that property management for renewable energy infrastructure is the logical progression, providing chances to enhance system efficiency and guarantee maximum energy output from solar arrays.

articleTitle: Automated Image Annotation with Voice Synthesis Using Machine Learning
abstract: The goal of our project is to develop automated image annotator with voice synthesis using machine learning that is developed with help of CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and LSTM architecture to generate the audio and textual captions. The framework involves several steps, incorporating the image embedding, image feature discovery and retrieval using VGG16, data preprocessing, tokenization, and LSTM-based caption generation to guarantee the production of accurate and rich captions. VGG16 architecture allows efficient separation of image features and creation of descriptive, meaningful captions. The project test results show that the proposed system produces accurate and multiple captions and sounds for the images. This machine holds the potential across various applications, such as aiding people with visual impairment, understand visual details or enhancing the multi-media content by providing more descriptive captions.

articleTitle: Fungi Classification: Enhancing Diagnosis Using Deep Learning
abstract: In the field of medical diagnostics, accurately identifying fungal infections on time is critical for effective treatment. The conventional methods rely on microscopic examination and often struggle to differentiate between fungal species due to their visual similarities. This challenge leads to the need for additional, time-consuming biochemical tests, causing further delays in treatment and increasing the patient's risk of mortality. In this framework, the study undertakes a comprehensive exploration into the classification of fungal species, utilizing the DeFungi dataset. This curated repository of microscopic fungi images, capturing infections caused by yeasts, moulds, or dermatophyte fungi, serves as the foundation of our investigation. With advanced automated algorithms for image processing, we prepare the dataset for analysis, the MobileNetV3 algorithm. Employing a traditional deep learning methodology approach, we evaluate its effectiveness in fungal classification, achieving an impressive accuracy of 92.89%. This pioneering effort not only enhances automated diagnostic capabilities but also ushers in a new era of precision medicine in medical mycology, ultimately transforming clinical practices and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Prediction of Ovarian Cancer Based on Ensemble Classifier Using Explainable AI
abstract: For women's general health and well-being, ovarian cancer detection and prevention are of paramount importance. Opposite uterine cancer, sometimes known as the “silent killer,” presents with subtle signs and symptoms in the early stages, making it difficult to detect in a timely manner. The chance of successful treatment and survival from ovarian cancer is greatly reduced when caught in its later stages. In order to catch the disease in its early, more curable phases, it is crucial to conduct screenings on a regular basis. These screenings can include pelvic exams, ultrasounds, and blood testing for specific biomarkers. This study employs the ovarian cancer dataset from Soochow University, which includes 50 features for precise cancer identification. In order to improve the accuracy and dependability of predictions, the suggested model employs a stacked ensemble-model, which combines the advantages of bagging &boosting classifiers. Better ovarian cancer prediction results are a result of this combination's use of variance reduction and enhanced generalization. With all features considered, the suggested model achieves the greatest model result to date on this dataset, with an accuracy of 96.87%. The outcomes are further explained utilizing SHAPly, an explainable-AI approach. The proposed model's superiority is proven by contrasting its results with those of another state-of-the-art model.

articleTitle: Synergy in Action: Harnessing Cloud Services and Wired Broadband for Seamless Operations
abstract: Cloud services and apps transform IT infrastructure by providing scalable, on-demand resources online. They offer flexible, cost-effective storage, computation, and software delivery using virtualization, containers, and micro services. Digital settings benefit from this paradigm shift's agility, creativity, and efficiency. Wired broadband uses DSL, cable, or fiber optics to provide high-speed internet. Video streaming, internet gaming, teleconferencing, and remote work are supported. Wired broadband allows household and business customers to communicate, amuse, and work seamlessly with stable connectivity and adequate bandwidth. Wireless broadband allows mobility and freedom with high-speed internet via radio waves. Mobile browsing, video streaming, IoT connection, and location-based services are supported. Wireless broadband lets consumers stay connected and access digital services on the go with its wide coverage and simplicity. Internet access and infrastructure deployment are regulated by broadband status and laws. They set net neutrality, spectrum, and broadband affordability regulations. To promote equitable broadband deployment and digital inclusion worldwide, regulators maintain fair competition, universal access, and quality requirements. This research articles covers four wide domains of Cloud Services and applications, Wired Broadband, Wireless Broadband and Broadband Status and Regulations which play a major role in shaping the advancement in telecom technologies.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Gastrointestinal Tract Classification Based on Endoscopic Images
abstract: This work introduces a set of pre-trained models that can accurately identify GI (gastrointestinal) diseases and disorders using endoscopic pictures. For the purpose of disease classification in the gastrointestinal system, we provide GIT- NET, a weighted average ensemble model. We used an eight- class KVASIR v2 dataset to test the model. Using individual models for categorization increases the likelihood of misclassification because they might not learn all the classes' traits sufficiently. One possible explanation is that different models may excel at learning the traits of certain classes relative to others. We provide an ensemble-model that uses the anticipations of three pre-trained models, namely DenseNet201 (94.54% accuracy), InceptionV3 (88.38% accuracy), &ResNet50 (90.58% accuracy). The two approaches used to aggregate the anticipations of the base learners are model averaging. Based on the results of the model evaluations, the weighted average ensemble achieved a 95.00% success rate, while the model averaging ensemble achieved a 92.96% success rate. Both the model average ensemble and each distinct model are surpassed in performance by the weighted average ensemble. When using an ensemble of base learners, features that were mislearned by discrete base learners can be accurately classified, according to the evaluation results.

articleTitle: Effective Resource Allocation in SEON based on Heterogeneous Traffic Demands
abstract: In survivable elastic optical Network(SEON) we can increase resource utilization by splitting the traffic demand into multiple link disjoint paths from source - destination when a single path is not available to fulfil the whole traffic demand. This further increases the connection acceptance rate and the disjointness contributes to maintaining the survivability of elastic optical network(EON). These paper proposed two models, named state-aware symmetrical traffic demand splitting(STD) and traffic demand splitting(ASTD), by combining link disjoint multipath routing, state-aware allocation strategies and traffic splitting techniques. In order to increase the connection acceptance rate of different demand sizes and to decrease the blocking probability in the network, the proposed models split the traffic demand either symmetrically or asymmetrically into multiple link disjoint paths while taking state-aware allocation strategies based on traffic demand sizes into consideration.In order to increase the connection acceptance rate while taking state-aware allocation strategies with heterogeneous demand sizes into consideration, a Mixed Integer Linear Programming(MILP) is developed. We present a heuristic for state-aware allocation techniques for traffic demands when MILP is not tractable due to scalability. Our results show that the suggested models, when compared to traditional symmetrical traffic demand splitting(STD) model or asymmetrical traffic demand splitting(ASTD) paired with link disjoint multipath routing model and single path routing(SPR) model considering different modulation formats, reduce blocking probability.

articleTitle: Online Transaction Fraud Detection: Exploring the Hybrid SSA-TCN-BiGRU Approach
abstract: The ease of online payment has lowered the geographical limits for shopping, opening up several new options for e-commerce in the past decade. Online shopping may be a great way to save money, but it has also made it easier for con artists to acquire sensitive information like credit card numbers. A new approach is proposed in this study for the purpose of detecting fraudulent online credit card transactions. The proposed approach consists of preprocessing, feature extraction and training the model. Managing Missing Data and Handling Outliers are two aspects of data preparation. PCA is used in feature extraction to reduce the number of correlated variables in a collection to a smaller number of uncorrelated variables. We used the SSA-TCN-BiGRU to increase the accuracy of the model training procedure. The suggested method outperforms the methods of its competitors, including SSA and TCN, with an accuracy of 97.50%.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Perspective on Gym Leg Builder Workouts: Using CNN-RF for Better Classification
abstract: The research concentrates on five main types of exercise regimens, pertinently utilizing up-to-date machine learning methods to enhance activity determination accuracy and facility in the gym. The algorithm has noticed that the model got high accuracy levels by using both CNN to find features and R.F. for recognition, which shows such an option in terms of efficiency. Performance measures include Accuracy in identifying phrases correctly. They range from 93.47% to 94.94 %; Recall is the ability to identify all the correct words and ranges from 91.23% to 98.13%; and F1-scores range between 92.88% and 95.88%. The results of our model are 91.2% in total Accuracy. The next step was to add the confusion matrix as a disclosure, which gave me a more concrete knowledge of the contradictions concerning the model, especially the ones where misclassification occurred, mainly during operations with similar dynamics. Such outcomes indicate that one potentiality is unconsciously distinguishing the particular kinds of objects. This research suggests the significant effect that hybrid machine learning models accomplish in fitness technologies, sending out the most effective solutions that allow for 100% active training monitoring. Continuing work on this platform, I will consider increasing the number of input data samples, implementing real-time data processing, and fine-tuning model parameters to reach maximum classification accuracy. This research is a significant take-off step in the direction of utilizing artificial intelligence through the process of maintaining safe and efficient training settings in the fitness industry.

articleTitle: Progress in DC-DC Converters: An Extensive Overview
abstract: Advancements in DC-DC converters have significantly enhanced the performance, functionality, and applicability of electronic systems across various sectors. This paper aims to provide an in-depth examination of recent innovations in DC-DC converters, encompassing their foundational principles, state-of-the-art advancements, and emerging trends. By exploring the pivotal role of DC-DC converters in diverse applications, the study seeks to elucidate the primary catalysts driving innovation in this domain and map out its evolutionary path. The comprehensive review delves into the evolution, fundamental concepts, categorizations, technological advancements, and emerging trends of DC-DC converters. Key areas of emphasis include the integration of wide bandgap semiconductors, enhanced circuit topologies, digital control techniques, high-frequency operations, and miniaturization. Furthermore, the paper evaluates prospective directions, comparative studies, and performance metrics within the DC-DC converter arena. Researchers, engineers, and industry professionals in power electronics stand to gain valuable insights from this synthesis of recent research endeavors. The scope of the review encompasses advanced circuit configurations, digital control strategies, wide bandgap semiconductor applications, performance assessment criteria, and potential avenues for future exploration. Ultimately, this comprehensive analysis aims to deepen our comprehension of DC-DC converters and their prospective impact on the future landscape of power electronics.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Meta Multi-Task Learning for Social Media Rumor Detection
abstract: Since you can't rest assured on the off chance that a post is lawful or not, the occupation of finding bits of hearsay has become more significant as web-based entertainment stages have developed rapidly and much virtual entertainment information has developed. Extensive testing on two Twitter standard databases confirms that our suggested approach provides state-of-the-art speed.

articleTitle: Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
abstract: Significant and continuous improvements in health-care technology have allowed the world to return to a quantitative and less time-consuming approach to disease exploration. The utilisation of Machine Learning for disease prediction has emerged as a transformative approach to accurately identify ailments based on user-provided symptoms. This research focuses on the implementation of a comprehensive disease prediction system employing multiple Machine Learning algorithms, with a spotlight on Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest Classifier and K-Nearest Neighbours. The system processes user input symptoms to provide a probability output indicative of potential diseases, specifically focusing on Chickenpox, Diabetes, Malaria, Jaundice, Heart Attack, Osteoarthritis, Tuberculosis and many more. This research prepares for a transformation with Machine learning-driven medical diagnostic systems that analyse symptoms in a dataset of more than 40 diseases. The predictive models act as virtual diagnosticians, ensuring fast and accurate disease predictions, enabling early detection and potentially saving lives. In a world where traditional methods are failing, this visionary approach seamlessly combines Machine Learning techniques and symptom-based analytics, promising a paradigm shift in disease prediction and eliminating healthcare inefficiencies. Everything takes place within the framework of advancing technology. The outcomes of this research signify the potential of the proposed model as a useful diagnostic tool for early detection and treatment. The integration of Machine Learning in healthcare informatics contributes to disease prevention, treatment optimization and overall enhanced patient management. As we navigate the complexities of healthcare, the adoption of Machine Learning-driven disease prediction stands as a significant stride toward improving healthcare outcomes and resource efficiency.

articleTitle: Identifying Diseased Regions on Plant Leaves and Classifying Plant Leaf Diseases with an ELM-GOA Based Model
abstract: Recently, plant diseases have become an issue due to the harm they can cause to agricultural production, both in terms of quantity and quality. The ability to improve agricultural monitoring in large fields through the early detection of disease symptoms on plant leaves makes research into autonomous plant disease detection vital. Software that can automatically detect and classify plant leaf diseases is the proposed system. Preprocessing, feature extraction, and training the model are the three steps that make up the suggested technique. The first stage in detecting and classifying leaf diseases is image pre-processing. The necessary information can be retrieved from the photographs using it. For the purpose of background removal, picture segmentation is utilized. The color co occurrence approach is employed for feature extraction. It is a technique that makes use of an image's color and texture to determine the image's distinctive characteristics. The model training method was made more accurate by utilizing the ELM-GOA. With a 97.53% accuracy rate, the proposed technique surpasses its rivals, which comprise ELM and GOA.

articleTitle: E-commerce Trading using VCG Auction Mechanism in Metaverse
abstract: The emergence of the metaverse has completely changed how people communicate, socialize, and do business. The potential for e-commerce trading within the metaverse has increased dramatically as virtual settings get more complex. In this article, we introduce a novel algorithm designed specifically for the optimization of e-commerce trading within the meta-verse. Recognizing the challenges posed by traditional auction mechanisms in virtual environments, we propose the integration of the Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction mechanism as a pivotal solution. The VCG auction, renowned for its fairness and efficiency, emerges as a cornerstone in our endeavor to enhance resource allocation in metaverse-based e-commerce platforms.

articleTitle: The Importance of a Digital Twin Strategy in the Context of Evaluating Occupants' Interaction with Smart Building
abstract: Digital transformation is playing an important role in the building industry. All indoor entities play an important role in the infrastructure of a building, and the utilization of the Digital Twin strategy in buildings makes them smarter and more robust. The rapid advancement of intertwined sensing capabilities, communication systems, and computational advancement is enabling intelligence in building systems, making them smarter, where each device in the building system is interactive and adaptive to its surrounding environment. It is evident that the recent smart building systems are being approached, not only to offer advanced functions for the occupants to support comfort in a building but also to consider effects beyond it, such as human physiological and psychological measures, by considering the research work being done in this area. Recently, the dominant focal point of research is concerning the impact of an individual's mental state on their wellness and functional working performance, while residing in a vicinity for a time frame. Concerns from the public are becoming more significant as technologies advance and change. This paper's overarching goal is to recognize how the claims of human-centric indoor effects should be evaluated to understand the optimal needs of individual occupants in a building. In order to strengthen the evaluation of the indoor building systems, the evidence has to be significant enough to support the findings. This paper proposal aims to establish the need to strengthen evidence-based practices using the Digital Twin Strategy Framework supporting value generation.

articleTitle: Abuse Detection of Cyberbullying in Tweets Data Using Ensemble DL Model with Advanced Voting Mechanisms
abstract: In social media, automatic identification of abusive online content- speech, profanity, threats, etc.-has become commonplace. Several initiatives have been devoted to identifying this issue in English. Nonetheless, it is not an easy task to identify hate speech and abuse in languages with limited resources. Transformer-based multilingual pre-trained language models for typologically varied languages are not always efficient due to insufficient labelled data in low-resource languages besides variable generalisation capacity. In order to tackle these problems, the research project compares a dynamic voting classifier in several languages with classic machine learning and deep learning classifiers as part of a hybrid ensemble method for cyberbullying detection. The modified seagull optimisation algorithm (MSOA) selects the most relevant features in the best possible way. The dataset underwent exploratory data analysis prior to implementation in order to obtain more insightful information. The study examines the offensive language detection of several publicly accessible datasets, including 6 datasets in 6 languages, in order to our approach. The studies demonstrate that in most circumstances, suggested deep learning-based representations perform better than transfer learning-based representations.

articleTitle: SEIMB-NET: A Squeeze and Excitation Driven Lightweight Model for Classification of Brain Tumors Using Magnetic Resonance Imaging
abstract: Brain tumor is one of the prevailing, degenerative, and progressive brain disease for adults and children all over the world. The conventional method of evaluating brain tumor progression through manual examination of magnetic resonance images (MRI) by a radiologist may result in errors, impacting the chances of survival of the patient. Due to the different characteristics of brain tumors, it is difficult to classify the different types of tumors. Early tumor type identification often relies on automated end-to-end frameworks, frequently employing deep neural networks to detect tumors using MR images. However, to tackle the scarcity of MR images for training Deep Learning models, transfer learning techniques utilize pre-trained models such as ResNet, VGGNet, DenseNet, and InceptionNet for classifying tumors using brain MRI scans. But deploying transfer learning models in resource-constrained medical devices is challenging due to their large size. Therefore, to address this problem various pre-trained lightweight models are proposed, though working with these models may occasionally compromise the overall network performance. To address this issue, we designed a lightweight deep neural network utilizing a fine-tuned MobileNetV1 with an optimized architecture that employs depth-wise separable convolution which reduces the size of the proposed model, and integrated it with a Squeeze and excitation (SE) attention block for effective brain tumor classification. The proposed work outperformed different state of the art models in existing literature utilizing different evaluation measures, achieving an accuracy of 98.56%, precision of 98.37%, recall of 98.36%, and F1 score of 98.38% with an optimum model size of 14MB.

articleTitle: Air Quality Analysis Using Deep Learning
abstract: The breathing and exhaling processes, which are entirely dependent on the air around us, are the foundation of the human respiratory system. Constant advancements in almost every facet of modern human civilization have had a detrimental effect on the state of the air. Dangerous contaminants are released into our environment by routine industrial, residential, and transportation operations. These days, air quality prediction and monitoring are crucial, particularly for growing nations like India. Machine learning-based prediction technologies, as opposed to more conventional methods, have shown to be the most effective instruments In the pursuit of assessing contemporary environmental hazards, this paper conducts the prediction and analysis of air quality based on a six-year dataset encompassing air pollution data from 23 cities across India. Following rigorous preparation, the dataset is examined using coordination analysis to identify important features. The purpose of exploratory data analysis is to identify contaminants that have a direct impact on the air quality index and uncover hidden patterns within the dataset. Nearly all pollutants show a noticeable decline in 2020, the epidemic year. Five ML models are used to assess air quality after the issue of data imbalance is resolved through resampling. We compare these models' outcomes using industry-standard measures. Among these models, the Support Vector Machine achieves the lowest performance, whereas the Gaussian Naive Bayes model demonstrates the highest accuracy. To assess and compare the performance of these models, predefined performance metrics are applied. Notably, the XG Boost model surpasses the other models in terms of performance, exhibiting the highest degree of linearity between the expected and actual data. Geographical information, pollutant concentrations, and meteorological variables collected from several monitoring stations spread over the research region comprise the large dataset used in this study. By utilising feature engineering techniques to extract relevant information and reduce dimensionality, robust prediction models can be constructed. The study concentrates on several important pollution. Modeling process elements. To start, the dataset is subjected to exploratory data analysis in order to find patterns, correlations, and any outliers. The models are subsequently trained and evaluated using a variety of machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks. Out-of-sample data is used to further evaluate the models, demonstrating their generalizability and resilience. In order to mitigate air pollution and protect public health, policymakers, urban planners, and environmental agencies can undertake targeted actions that are made possible by the study's highlights of the potential of data-driven approaches in improving air quality prediction. The research's conclusions support the development of environmentally sound management strategies and highlight the value of applying cutting-edge data science methods to solve urgent environmental issues.

articleTitle: A Novel Transfer Learning Based Method for Melanoma Detection
abstract: Skin cancer is a frequent hazardous kind of cancer that has shown a significant increase in documented occurrences worldwide. If it is not diagnosed early, the disease may spread to other parts of the body, which can significantly increase the chances of death. Early discovery, on the other hand, offers the possibility of a complete cure. Therefore, the fast and accurate identification of skin malignancies continues to be a primary emphasis in contemporary research. A plethora of Deep learning (DL) approaches have been smoothly integrated into the captivating realm of automated skin cancer diagnostics, enabling the identification of whether a flaw poses a significant threat. The system incorporates intelligent models and algorithms that not only absorb information but also demonstrate insight by making predictions on completely unfamiliar material. DL algorithms provide a feasible alternative to the standard biopsy procedure, which is both time-consuming and expensive. Thus, this paper proposes a novel method based on a transfer learning approach to use pretrained models like ResNet50 and EfficientNet B5 to detect skin cancer. The transfer learning models are fine-tuned to optimize the hyperparameters for the classification layers, and the initial layers are frozen. The experimental findings suggest that both models perform well on training, validation, and test datasets. Still, a 1% difference in test accuracy is observed. EfficientNet B5 achieves better performance than the ResNet50 by achieving an accuracy of 94%. Implementing the proposed approach in real-time reduces the workload for experts and improves the accuracy of diagnosing skin lesions at an early stage.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Exploration of Machine Learning and Explainable AI Techniques for Malware Classification
abstract: The rapid evolution of malware presents a significant challenge to cybersecurity, necessitating more effective detection and classification methods. Malware attack is a vulnerable and prevalent threat in cyber security. Awareness about these threats and regular updation of security measures are critical. There are various techniques in which we can detect the malwares and prevent them from occurring. Identification of malware is crucial in this technological era to prevent destruction. In this work, we have used various machine learning classifiers including ensemble techniques such as boosting and bagging classifiers to classify four different types of Android Malwares. Random Forest has outperformed with a F1-score of 88%, and model Explainability has been deployed to reveal the most significant feature.

articleTitle: Enhancing QR Code Security: Authentication and Tamper Detection Using Visual Cryptography
abstract: Visual cryptography is a powerful encryption technique that splits a secret image into a meaningless image, appearing as black and white dots randomly embedded in the image. This article examines the application of visual cryptography and steganography in improving the security of QR codes. The plan is to hide the QR code in an image using an encryption algorithm and print it on transparent paper. The original image is displayed with a shared image without the need for computer decryption algorithms. Standard (k, n) aspect cryptography is adopted; where n represents the number of shares created and k represents the minimum number of shares required for decryption. Under dispersion below the k threshold does not reveal any information about the original image. This study also analyzed changes in entropy. The proposed model combines cryptography and steganography, providing two security layers: cryptography as the outer layer and steganography as the inner layer. Comparing steganography algorithms called Least Significant Bit (LSB) and Random Data Hiding (RDH) strengthens security. The results and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of the design in improving QR code security while maintaining image quality. This research contributes to the field by providing a way to transmit information securely through QR codes, with applications in various fields.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Beamforming and Antenna Selection in MIMO Systems Using Deep Learning and Machine Learning Techniques with Future Research Directions
abstract: In recent times, the research community has shown significant interest in “Millimeter Wave (mmWave)” communication. Specifically, within the context of “Fifth Generation (5G) wireless networks”, mmWave “Massive Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO)” communications are implemented using hybrid transceivers. In this survey, machine structure algorithms have been raised as trustable solutions over the past decennary. These algorithms offer the potential to tackle complex optimization problems within MIMO systems effectively. This review explains the recent modern deep structure and machine learning applications in the broad field of beamforming. The efficiency of wireless transmission is done by modifying the strength of the signal. Here, the brief introduction to the vector quantity of Beamforming and the selection of antenna in the MIMO sector and its existing literature works are presented elaborately. This review helps readers to understand the latest deep learning and machine learning technologies used for beamforming in MIMO systems. A detailed description from various perspectives on the antenna structures like “phased array antennas” and diversity antennas and several Beamforming learning methodologies are analyzed. Further, it offers better future research guidance to fulfill the development requirements of flexible antennas for upcoming wireless fidelity.

articleTitle: Lightweight, Secure and Authenticated Blockchain-Optimized Network Routing Protocol for Wireless Body Area Networks
abstract: Security in wireless body area networks is one of the top concerns; like other networks, several approaches based on cryptography were designed to secure the data from attackers, but security still lacks and raises the burden on the network. Blockchain-based security approaches are nowadays popular among different networks, improving the level of security but reducing the network performance in terms of delay and other performance parameters. So, the primary aim of this work is to propose a lightweight security protocol that provides a higher level of security and improves network performance. In order to attain this, a lightweight blockchain-optimized network (BON) protocol is proposed that utilizes the blockchain for security and soft computing approaches for dynamic clustering and rule-based optimized path. In this, dragonfly optimization forms dynamic clusters, and the fuzzy-based gray wolf selects the optimized path. Moreover, with blockchain technology, the data transmission will be secure, and transmission will occur via the optimized path to provide overall data transmission security. The performance of the proposed solution is analyzed by configuring two different network scenarios using the NS-2 simulator and computing different performance metrics. The results ensure the performance of the proposed protocol over other existing approaches.

articleTitle: Secure Decentralization: Examining the Role of Blockchain in Network Security
abstract: Blockchain generation has emerged as a novel answer for securing decentralized networks. This technology, which was first created for use in crypto currencies, has received enormous interest in recent years because of its capability for boosting protection in various industries and community protection. The essential precept at the back of block chain technology is the decentralization of statistics garage and control. In a decentralized network, no central authority may control the statistics. Rather, the facts are shipped amongst multiple nodes, making it immune to tampering and single factors of failure. One of the most important advantages of blockchain in community protection is its capacity to offer cozy and transparent communication amongst community customers. Through cryptographic techniques, block chain can affirm the identities of network participants and ensure the authenticity of records trade. This feature is extraordinarily valuable in preventing unauthorized access and facts manipulation

articleTitle: Unleashing Creativity: The Business Potential of Generative AI
abstract: As the digital landscape continues to evolve., Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) stands at the forefront., revolutionizing the way businesses operate and innovate. This research paper delves into the multifaceted impact of Generative AI on businesses., exploring its applications., case studies., challenges., and ethical considerations. Beginning with an overview of Generative AI., including its historical development and key models., the paper highlights the diverse applications of Generative AI in content generation., creative processes., personalization., automation., and decision support systems. Real-world case studies demonstrate the tangible benefits experienced by businesses leveraging Generative AI., from enhanced efficiency and productivity to fostering innovation. However., the paper does not shy away from addressing challenges and ethical concerns., such as bias and privacy issues., providing a balanced perspective on the technology's implications. Looking forward., the paper examines future trends in Generative AI., offering insights into its potential evolution and the emergence of new technologies. The abstract concludes with practical recommendations for businesses seeking to adopt and integrate Generative AI successfully., navigating both the opportunities and challenges presented by this transformative technology. Through this comprehensive exploration., the research aims to contribute to a deeper understanding of Generative AI's role in shaping the future of businesses.

articleTitle: INNS: A Novel Identification of Machine Learning Based Dental Disease Identification Scheme Using Improved Neural Network Strategy
abstract: Under the current circumstances, the most significant oral health problems that men face are an important topic of research. In the field of biomedical research, the use of data mining methods, image processing techniques, and computational intelligence approaches is becoming increasingly important. Utilizing dental image processing can assist in the improvement of early detection and classification throughout the diagnostic process, which ultimately leads to more correct conclusions. Images obtained from dental X-rays are essential and helpful for dentists in the process of diagnosing dental disorders. The application of deep learning to dental X-ray pictures can provide dentists with the ability to recognize prevalent dental disorders such as periodontist and cavities in a more timely and appropriate manner. The purpose of this research is to offer a method for simultaneously recognizing periodontitis and dental caries by using the application of image processing along with deep learning technologies to dental X-ray pictures. This article provides a detailed account of the procedures that were carried out, including the categorization and segmentation of dental pictures, as well as the pre-processing techniques that were utilized. During the pre-processing stage, a histogram that is based on an adaptive technique is utilized to extend the contrast and equalize the level of illumination throughout the whole radiographic X-ray two-dimensional dental image. Using this technique, it is possible to differentiate between the teeth in the front and the areas of the bones in the background. One of the most important steps in the segmentation process is the separation of dental two-dimensional pictures into sections that correspond to the items. The mouth cavity and the tissues that make up the oral cavity are segmented using the hybrid segmentation technique. The dental picture was processed using deep learning-based techniques known as Improved Neural Network Strategy (INNS) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) in this research. The results of this research suggest that these approaches have the potential to produce promising results with greater accuracy rates.

articleTitle: Random Pixel Embedding: A Novel Approach to Image Steganography
abstract: This project presents a novel approach to image steganography titled “Random Pixel Embedding: A Novel Approach to Image Steganography.” Steganography, the art of concealing information within an innocuous carrier, finds widespread applications in secure communication and data protection. Our method employs a combination of LSB (Least Significant Bit) steganography, random pixel selection and AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) encryption to embed secret messages into digital images securely. The Tkinter library was used to create the system's user-friendly graphical user interface, which makes encoding and decoding processes easier. Additionally, it enhances the security of message encryption by incorporating PBKDF2 (Password-Based Key Derivation Function 2) for deriving cryptographic keys. By using this method, the project hopes to advance the fields of secure communication and data security by providing a reliable and effective way to conceal important information from view. The experimental results show that the suggested algorithm is reliable and effective, underscoring its potential for practical uses in data security and secure communication channels.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification of Coconut Trees Based on Tree Parameters
abstract: The coconut tree, known as the 'Kalpavriksha,’ holds a significant relationship with nature and people in India. For many, it serves as a source of livelihood, either directly or indirectly. The health status of coconut trees is crucial for agricultural productivity and ecosystem conservation. Tree parameters play a vital role in identifying the health conditions and growth of coconut trees, aiding researchers and farmers in cultivation and health prediction. This paper explores various clustering and classification methods to mitigate time consumption, over fitting, and complexity in data classification. This paper proposes a machine learning algorithm for classifying coconut trees based on tree parameters such as Height, Inclination, and Diameter at breast height (DBH). The proposed approach commences with the extraction of tree parameters using an unsupervised learning algorithm. Parameters such as tree height obtained through a mobile application, inclination measured by an inclinometer, and DBH are used as a database for classifying the coconut tree into different classes. These pre-processed parameters serve as inputs to supervised learning models, including Support vector Machine, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbor, to classify trees into different categories. This paper endorses K-means clustering followed by the support vector machine (SVM) approach for classification. Evaluation of each algorithm is conducted by calculating accuracy, precision, and Fl score. The dataset comprising 60 sensor data points is utilized for clustering, parameter training, and testing. By implementing machine learning algorithms with real-time morphological data, greater accuracy is achieved for the classification of coconut tree health.

articleTitle: The Art of the Stroke: Machine Learning Insights into Cricket Shot Execution with Convolutional Neural Networks And SVM
abstract: Among these sophisticated algorithms utilized by the model to achieve automatic classifications of cricket shots, human processes would invariably be significantly alleviated, giving noticeably better results when the model is used than by humans. Using a dataset of high-definition video clips obtained from professional cricket matches, the research is expected to achieve greater accuracy in the various shot types. The model structure used two CNNs to aggregate robust and reliable features from video frames. The extracted features are then used to train Support Vector Machines (SVM), which have been pledged to complete the classification task. Throughout the model's development process, it turned out to be very accurate, as test results proved it. The precision lies between 86.38% and 96.61 %, while recall scores are between 88.65% to 97.98%. The F1 scores vary between 89.01 % and 95.97%. The model got them commendably high accuracy, knowing there are some classes where no single class accuracy exceeded 98%. An intense observation of the confusion matrix offered an idea of the model's power in precisely identifying photographs with a high level of exactness and the ability to have confidence in this scenario. Besides that, it also reported places where miscopping was mainly caused by specific visual characteristics such as bird cancer disease, half-naked or smiling person. The data showed that using this model enhanced the decisions regarding making coaching plans and players' evaluations by timing shots. Hence, the panoramic model assists in building and applying CNN and SVM simultaneously for sports analytics and opens several avenues for the following research in automated sports performance monitoring in real-time.

articleTitle: An Improved U-Shaped Network for ROI Segmentation of Skin Lesion Images
abstract: Skin cancer, a serious public health concern across the world, is a deadly disease if not diagnosed at an early stage. It is often diagnosed through dermoscopic images that usually have low contrast, irregular boundaries and contains irrelevant artifacts. Due to these factors, the segmentation of Region of Interest (ROI) for effective diagnosis of this disease becomes a challenging task. However, UNet, a U-Shaped Network has proven to be an efficient segmentation model for medical image segmentation, but the result mostly suffers discrepancies with the ground truth segmented mask. Therefore, this paper introduces an improved UNet 3+ architecture with residual block at both encoder and decoder to handle gradient degradation in this deep network, incorporates attention module to focus on relevant features and reduces redundant skip connections. The improved model has been evaluated on publicly available PH2 dataset and achieved an accuracy of 96.62%, dice score of 93.84% and jaccard index of 96.79% on test data. The model surpasses other state-of-the-art UNet models for skin lesion segmentation.

articleTitle: Smart Drug Delivery Systems Using Large Language Models for Real-Time Treatment Personalization
abstract: This research explores the use of large language models, such as BERT and GPT, in developing a smart drug delivery system utilizing real-time personalized treatments. The research aims to utilize large datasets with advanced natural language processing to recommend the appropriate drug for a patient based on their health record with enhanced accuracy and efficiency. The research, which evaluates and compares BERT and GPT, achieves the goal of predicting a drug with high accuracy, and GPT delivers the best results compared to BERT. Specifically, GPT achieved an accuracy of 97.95<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, while BERT's accuracy was 95.50%. Additionally, the research emphasizes the essential aspect of a model's time response since these are real-time clinical decision systems. GPT took 110 milliseconds to predict the drug while the BERT took 120 milliseconds. It is clear from the results of this work that LLM has the potential of changing personalized medicine's approach by recommending drugs in real-time and according to the patient's health record within no time. The proposed system for smart drug delivery is promising to improve healthcare services, patient outcomes, and reduce drug administration errors. Apart from predicting the drug, these research findings can be simulated to the health sectors and integrated with AI technologies to improve decision support systems.

articleTitle: Forgery Fighters: The CNN-SVM Edge in Currency Security
abstract: In this research, a combination of a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) model is developed for enhanced issuance and detection of counterfeit cash notes. The model uses the trendy CNNs' feature extraction capabilities and SVMs' specific classification ability to relate to 5 different classes of counterfeit strategies and, in that way, completes the drawbacks of traditional ways of detection. We (myself and my group) put money pictures into a large pool and conducted a strict check on random classes. There was a very high level of precision, accuracy, recall and Fl-score classification for all the classes. Our model produced pretty good results in its entirety. The accuracies ranged from 94% to 97%. The accuracy and sensitivity levels were between 85.68% to 96.33% and 87.83% to 97.72 %, finally calculating the Fl-scores at 88.42 % to 95.47%. The figures illustrate that the model can not be seen solely as a potential solution; it also functions effectively and ensures counterfeit coins' recognition. The model has predictive ability, which can be appreciated by the precise confusion matrix analysis showing how it can recognize more difficult counterfeit methods with no or just very few misclassifications. With this research outcome, ascertaining the hybridized CNN-SVM strategy being considerably more effective than the traditional tests suggests a versatile and functional approach that unquestionably can be applied to different real-world utilizations.
