Concerning the development of future international secure financial systems, other investigations are expected to be carried out to improve the model and to research its application to more various forms of currencies. This research lays out how a next-generation learning algorithm that can fight fraud or other financial crimes may be used to achieve significant progress in the security and robustness of economic systems worldwide.

articleTitle: Enhancing Remote Sensing Object Detection Through YOLOV5x6 Model
abstract: The CA-YOLO (Coordinate Attention- YOLO) model is designed for better object detection addressing precise remote sensing pictures challenges faced by algorithms detecting multiple objects. It improves multi-scale feature extraction and tackles the compromise between detection precision and model complexity. Built on YOLOv5x6, CA-YOLO adds a thin, lightweight coordinate attention module situated in the superficial layer for efficient feature extraction and reducing redundant data. In the deeper layer, a pyramid pooling in space-fast using a tandem construction module is implemented to enhance performance without increasing model parameters. To optimize efficiency, the model reduces parameters, improves inference speed, and refines the anchor box mechanism and loss function for detecting objects of different sizes. Results demonstrate CA-YOLO outperforming the first YOLO in multiple objects detection accuracy, achieving an impressive average inference speed of 125 fps. Importantly, these improvements maintain the same parameters and complexity, making CA-YOLO an excellent choice for various applications.

articleTitle: A Robust Appliance Of Internet Of Things Over Industrial Applications To Make An Error Free Factory Zone
abstract: The proliferation of connected devices is driving technological advancement. The Internet of Things is made up of commonplace objects that have been embedded with software, sensors, and electronics as well as linked to a network. Because of this, all of these items can communicate with one other and exchange data. This article details our efforts to create an IoT Powered Industrial Automation (IoT IA) system that can autonomously keep tabs on various industrial applications, either by sounding alerts or making smart choices based on data collected from the Internet of Things. To assess the efficacy of the suggested method, it is cross-validated with the traditional GSM-based model known as GSM-based Industrial Automation (GSMIA). We now have a potential method to construct robust industrial systems and applications through the Internet of Things, which makes use of sensors, Android, and wireless devices. This paper's primary contribution is a synopsis of the Internet of Things applications in AI-powered industry monitoring and control systems. An overview of relevant research is also provided, as is a synopsis of some of the most important Internet of Things problems raised in recent publications. We also highlight the need of improving the horizontal integration of IoT services. In the end, we show comprehensive service use-cases to show how all the protocols discussed in the article work together to provide the Internet of Things services that people want.

articleTitle: Classification of Forest Fire Using InceptionV3 Model

authors.preferredName: Gowtham V V S Sandeep Ganti

abstract: The project “Classification of Forest Fires using InceptionV3model” aims to develop deep learning models to detect forest fires using satellite images. The recommended approach makes use of the InceptionV3model to analyse the input of satellite images and find forest fires. We have used U-N et architecture which has some limitations in detecting forest fires early and effectively. Using InceptionV3 instead of U-Net will improve the Accuracy and to make comparisons among these models. The limitation of U-Net for forest fire detection lies in its focus on detailed segmentation rather than capturing broader contextual information, which is crucial for understanding complex patterns like forest fires. This constraint can be addressed by InceptionV3,which can capture more comprehensive patterns and enhance the comprehension of forest fires in satellite pictures due to its capacity to comprehend substantial context and features at many scales. By using this model, we aim to make our project more accurate and useful for predicting and managing forest fires. We'll compare the performance of this model with the U-Net to see which one is better for finding fires in different situations. This upgrade is designed to enhance our system's accuracy and effectiveness in forest fire detection and protection of the environment.

articleTitle: ReUnite AI: Harnessing Face Detection and Age Progression for Missing Person Identification
abstract: ReUnite AI is a system that has been engineered to address the extensive issue of missing individuals, by leveraging advanced face detection and age progression techniques. It offers a comprehensive solution catering to both the general public and law enforcement agencies. Deep learning algorithms are employed in the system to analyze and match facial features from input images against a database of missing individuals. ReUnite AI utilizes Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to achieve accuracy and efficiency. System is integrated with age-progression model that generates realistic images depicting how a missing person might appear after a period of time thereby enhancing the identification process. This paper introduces a robust system and provides detailed implementation strategies, showcasing significant potential in locating missing persons.

articleTitle: Sign Language Translation System to People with Hearing Disabilities in Ecuador
abstract: According to the National Council for Disability Equality (CONADIS) in Ecuador, it is estimated that approximately 66,538 Ecuadorian citizens suffer from some hearing disability. In response to this problem, a notable increase in Sign Language translation tools has been observed. This scientific article presents a web application for text translation into the Sign Language of Ecuador (LSEC). The web application's logic and the graphical user interface use the Model View Controller (MVC) architecture. The controller employs Non-Deterministic Finite Automata (AFND) and regular expressions for translation. Users can enter text using a standard keyboard and receive visual translations in animations representing LSEC signs. The performance evaluation showed an average response of 0.28 seconds per sentence translation request during high-demand hours and 6% failures per request per second. The usability and accessibility of the tool were evaluated in collaboration with the National Federation of Ecuadorians with Physical Disabilities (FENEDIF), which allowed improvement and correction of errors in the visual representation of LSEC signs and the adoption of a more appropriate color palette. In the evaluation of the web application for text translation to LSEC, 75% was obtained in the categories of “very easy” or “moderately easy” for usability and 77.77% in the categories of “good” and “excellent” for accessibility.

articleTitle: Application of Homomorphic Encryption in Machine Learning Based Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a silent but progressive illness that can lead to kidney failure if not detected early. Machine learning (ML) classifiers offer a promising avenue for early detection, but the sensitive nature of healthcare data requires stringent privacy measures. This paper proposes a novel approach that leverages homomorphic encryption to securely predict CKD using ML algorithms. We first conduct a literature review on homomorphic encryption in healthcare systems and CKD prediction using ML. We then preprocess the CKD dataset, which includes 400 samples with 24 features, and apply feature selection using mutual information. Next, we build a logistic regression model on plaintext CKD training data and use it to conduct predictive analysis on encrypted test data. We encrypt the test data using Paillier homomorphic encryption, enabling computations on the encrypted data without decryption. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Using the logistic regression model trained on plaintext data, we achieve accuracies of up to 98.75 % on encrypted test data, while preserving patient privacy. This study highlights the potential of homomorphic encryption in enhancing patient privacy and data security in healthcare applications, particularly in CKD prediction.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Classifiers and Hyperparameter Tuning to Enhance Prediction of ASD: An Automated Django Application
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) impacts social interaction, communication, and behavior as a result of variations in brain development of children. Typically, symptoms manifest around the age of 2 and encompass a decrease in eye contact during early infancy, a lack of response to one's name, indifference towards caregivers, a decline in developmental progress, loss of language abilities, and distinct behavioral patterns. The objective of this study is to assess the predictive accuracy of different machine learning algorithms, such as Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), and Extra Trees (ET), by utilizing the UCI Repository dataset. We prioritize the target variable “Class/ASD” along with twenty other attributes, such as age, gender, and AQ-10 (Child version) outcomes. Prior to hyperparameter tuning, the SVM classifier achieved the highest accuracy of 0.949. The LR and ET classifiers both achieved perfect precision and recall scores, resulting in an accuracy of 0.991. After fine-tuning, the KNN, NB, SVM, LR, ET, and DT classifiers demonstrated noteworthy enhancements, with SVM, LR, ET, and DT achieved 100% classification metrics. This demonstrates the significant influence of hyperparameter tuning on improving the performance of the model. Finally, using Django Framework a web application is developed which allows the user to enter input data, DT model will process and predict the disorder.

articleTitle: Early Avalanche Detection Using Ensemble Learning Techniques
abstract: Avalanches are caused by changes in the balance of snowpack and present significant dangers to ecosystems and human communities. This study evaluates the efficiency of machine learning algorithms in predicting avalanches, with a focus on selecting features and evaluating models. Key elements such as snow depth, precipitation, temperature, and avalanche probabilities are integrated into the modeling process and further improved through correlation analysis. Performance indicators that includes accuracy, sensitivity, precision, etc, are utilized to assess the effectiveness of classifiers. Ensemble learners such as Random Forest (RF) and Gradient Boosting (GB), together with more recent methods like eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost)), can improve the ability of prediction. Feature engineering enhances model development by employing techniques such as class balancing and grid search to optimize performance. Evaluation entails comparing models like random forest, gradient boosting, and neural networks with variables such as slab, wet, and sum. Metrics including accuracy, recall, precision, Fl-score, and ROC curve are utilized for this purpose. The XGBoost technique enhances the performance of the gradient boosting model when compared to other factors. Future research may explore various techniques for different natural hazards, alternative hyperparameter optimization methods, and comparing probabilistic ML models. This study advances avalanche prediction understanding and highlights the potential of Machine Learning algorithms in disaster risk mitigation.

articleTitle: Unity ML-Agents: Revolutionizing Gaming Through Reinforcement Learning
abstract: At the vanguard of AI, Reinforcement Learning (RL) is transforming sectors and pushing the limits of human-computer interaction. In the world of gaming, RL has become a powerful force that presents unheard-of chances to improve user experiences, have an impact on game creation, and even transform the gaming industry. Even while players are immersed in well constructed worlds and challenges through gaming, the strict and scripted style of traditional game design has its drawbacks. Gamers frequently want for dynamic, erratic, and adaptable encounters that can compete with those provided by live opponents. Here is where RL steps in, bringing with it the power to create intelligent agents that can interact with virtual surroundings to learn, adapt, and change. This study explores the relationship between RL and gaming, looking into how RL techniques are being used to revitalize this multibillion-dollar sector. The paper explores the core ideas of reinforcement learning and reveals the mechanisms underlying this paradigm. We explore the nuances of RL algorithms and techniques, with a focus on the gaming industry, enabling developers to create non-player characters (NPCs) who pose distinct and customized challenges to players.

articleTitle: Transforming Cold Chain Management: The Role of Digital Twins in Post-Harvest Logistics
abstract: Digital twins are virtual replicas of actual things, processes, or systems that are generated by integrating real-time data, modeling, and simulation. These digital copies allow for the monitoring, analysis, and optimization of their real-world counterparts. This helps to enhance decision-making and performance in areas like as manufacturing, healthcare, and urban planning. Digital twins have the capability to accurately replicate the actions and condition of their physical counterparts, allowing for the anticipation of maintenance needs, monitoring of performance, and analysis of potential scenarios. They utilize technology such as the Internet of Things (IoT), sensors, data analytics, and machine learning to consistently enhance their virtual models by incorporating real-time data from linked devices. Digital twins are utilized in several domains, such as predictive maintenance of machinery, optimization of manufacturing processes, simulation of medical operations, and even modeling of entire cities for urban planning. Digital twins improve efficiency, productivity, and creativity by offering insights into intricate systems. They also help reduce expenses and dangers involved with physical experimentation or testing. This paper covers a brief implementation of the technologies Digital Twins (DT) along with the Internet of Things (IoT) in solving the food wastage problem that happens during the post-harvest supply chain. About 30% of food gets wasted globally every year from the time it is harvested till it reaches the customer due to poor supply chain management. There is an urgent need to resolve this issue with the help of cutting-edge technologies. This depicts why it is important to reimagine the existing supply chain with detailed implementation and integration of DT. Also, there are relevant case studies and examples to strengthen the idea behind.

articleTitle: FCM Based Spectrum Sensing For NOMA Cognitive Radio Networks
abstract: In this article, we propose a fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering-based technique for spectrum sensing (SS) in power-domain non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) cognitive radio (CR) network. Though, techniques based on supervised and unsupervised machine learning (ML) for cooperative spectrum sensing (CSS) techniques in NOMA exist in literature, they are relatively more computationally complex and have poor accuracy. Proposed method considers NOMA spectrum sensing as a multiple-hypothesis problem and classifies the signal received through multiple secondary users (SU) using the FCM algorithm. Our results show that proposed technique is superior to the existing techniques in terms of accuracy and is significantly less complex for same performance.

articleTitle: Data Science for E-Commerce Buyer Segmentation and Personalization of Ads
abstract: These days, age of modern e-commerce, the utilization of data science techniques has emerged as an essential means of more effectively categorizing clients into groups and simplifying the process of targeted marketing. It provides an explanation of the significance of data science in the realm of e-commerce and how it plays a crucial part in identifying intricate patterns within extremely big databases. Complex algorithms and statistical methodologies can be utilized by companies that offer products or services online in order to categorize their clients into distinct groups. They are able to gain a great deal of knowledge about the likes and dislikes of their customers as a result of this. E-commerce companies acquire the knowledge necessary to efficiently segment their consumer base into groups, which provides them with a wealth of information regarding the manner in which customers behave and the things that they prefer. Not only does it contribute to the existing body of knowledge on e-commerce, but it also demonstrates how data science can be utilized to enhance marketing strategies and the segmentation of customers.

articleTitle: Action Assurance: Federated CNN Architectures Decoding Cricket Umpire Signals
abstract: This article shows a federated learning framework based on CNN and will identify cricket umpire gestures. We have federated and used Federated training mechanics to train the five clients: WACA, BBL, CPL, IPL, and SMA. This way, we applied a wide range of data sources with an equal platform to maintain the anonymity of each person's data. The model accurately categorized five unique umpire signals: ‘Out,’ ‘Four,’ ‘Six,’ ‘No Ball,’ and ‘Wide Ball.’ This assessment consisted of four measures, e.g., precision, recall, Fl-score, and accuracy. The performance of the five customers' C-Ievel outcomes was between 75.63% and 87.05% regarding the overall average accuracy. Among these, datasef _ 5 is the most suitable for model training, showing the highest scores in rating all the metrics. The result is the accuracy (the weighted average), which changes between 75.64% and 87.07% Precision. The precision computed using the micro average ranged from 75.65% to 87.02 %, and it was also found that 30.36% of sentences gained improvements in terms of pyrotechnical relevance. The results confirm the model's reliability. An overall accuracy of 92% shows a high level of accurate world application adaptation. The accuracy of the ‘Out’ signal has shown the highest precision. Since this signal brings forward consequent outputs, successful implementation of the model will be associated with the highest efficiency in payouts from the system. The federated learning method was introduced to solve this issue, using a technique that makes it impossible to reconstruct client data. Individual client data is from the changes.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Facial Acne Classification: CNN-SVM Synergy
abstract: A new framework for automatically detecting and diagnosing facial acne is presented in this paper. The approach makes use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and support vector machines (SVMs). The key types of face acne that are the subject of this research include hormonal acne, pustules, papules, cysts, blackheads (open comedones), and whiteheads (closed comedones). For the purpose of determining how effectively the suggested framework functions, several metrics such as recall, accuracy, precision, and F1-score, support, and support percentage are used. The fact that the model has a total accuracy of 98% illustrates how well it can discern between the different forms of acne. For the purpose of gaining an understanding of the content of the dataset as well as the distribution of classes, support and support percentage metrics may be beneficial. In addition, weighted, macro, and micro average metrics provide overall evaluations of the effectiveness of the model across all classes and demonstrate the ability to categorize data in a reliable and consistent manner. The development of automated dermatological diagnostics is one of the possible consequences of this study, which has the potential to change clinical procedures and enhance patient outcomes in the area of skincare therapy.

articleTitle: The Skin Classifier: An Innovative CNN-SVM Methodology for Lesion Detection
abstract: “Skin Lesions Detection Using CNN-SVM Approach: “A Five-Class Analysis” study deals with hybrid machine learning model creation, which is made as a combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) to classify skin lesions. This research classifies the study by indicating a dataset of five different skin lesion categories. The precision scores for Class 1 to Class 5 are as follows: 73.71 %, 74.20%, 77.30%, 77.84%, and 86.94%. These data show that the model has made a presumption, which is kindly. The model's sensitivity is reflected in the fraction of users considered to have the corresponding symptoms classes, as seen from the lowest recall score of 71.48% for class 1 and the highest score of 83.31 % for class 2. The F1 scores presently consist of accuracy and recall and are changing from 72.58% to 81.80% while taking Class 1 to 5. This illustrates a strong performance, especially for Class 5. Therefore, the proposed model has great potential to become the tailored cancer classifier for detecting cancerous tissues. Averaged macro results on classes' accuracy are represented by 78.00%; on classes' recall, they equal 78.12%, and on F1-score, they are 77.93%. The weighted average, a statistical technique that calculates class distribution, shows accuracy, recall, and an F1 score with values of 78.20%, 77.93%, and 77.93%, respectively. The micro averages, which give the assessed indicator for all criteria, remain at the same level for this committee, which is 77.93%. This implies that the prerequisites were met.

articleTitle: Streamlined Bank Loan Approvals Using Deep Learning
abstract: The approval of bank loans has grown in importance and time commitment for the banks. The banking industry experiences a sharp rise in fraudulent activity in tandem with technological advancements. Loans serve as the main source of income for both individuals and companies; thus, banks must employ quicker, more effective, fraud-preventive loan approval processes in order to offer loans to their clients. Since loans are the primary source of income for the banking institutions, banks must exercise extreme caution when approving loans for their clients based on a variety of factors, including the client's capacity to repay the loan, annual income, credit score, home ownership etc. Proposed models in the past, such as Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Trees (DT) and Gaussian Naive Bayes (NB) methods, were limited by overfitting, underfitting, and lack of hyperparameter tuning. The accuracy of the models that forecast loan acceptance may be significantly increased by utilizing Deep Neural Network (DNN) models. These results depict that the introduction of a Bidirectional LSTM neural network model drastically increased the accuracy of the model; therefore, in the case of the results of such a model, loan approvals might probably expedite and improved.

articleTitle: Advancing Predictive Analytics in E-Learning Platform: The Dominance of Blended Models in Enrollment Forecasts
abstract: The rapid expansion of e-learning platforms has revolutionized the landscape of education, particularly highlighting the significance of online courses in contemporary learning environments. This research focuses on Udemy, a prominent online learning platform, and aims to enhance the predictability of course enrollments within its IT & Software category. The study's central purpose is to leverage advanced machine learning techniques to predict course subscriber numbers, a crucial indicator of a course's popularity and success. Employing an extensive dataset from (Kaggle DB)Udemy, encompassing various course attributes such as ratings, reviews, and pricing, the study explores multiple machine learning models. These include Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and K-Nearest Neighbors Regression. A key innovation of this research is the application of ensemble methods, particularly a blended model approach, to integrate predictions from multiple models, thereby enhancing accuracy and reliability. The findings of this study are significant. The ensemble approach, notably the blended model, outperforms individual predictive models in accuracy. Among the single models, Gradient Boosting Regression shows the highest effectiveness in forecasting enrollments. The research highlights the vital role of course characteristics, including ratings and reviews, in determining course popularity. This study contributes to the field of e-learning by introducing a novel, data-driven approach to predict course enrollments. It offers valuable insights for educators, course creators, and platform developers, emphasizing the potential of machine learning in optimizing content strategy and marketing efforts in the digital education domain. The application of ensemble machine learning methods presents a new horizon in educational analytics, paving the way for more nuanced and effective strategies in online education delivery and promotion.

articleTitle: Significance of Machine Learning in Crop Yield Prediction
abstract: Since agriculture is the foundation of all economies, accurately predicting crop yield is essential to determining farmers' financial security and managing risks. In the following research, we explore how supervised machine learning algorithms are revolutionizing forecasting of crops' yield and the ensuing implications for agriculture. Crop yield predictions enable farmers and policymakers to make data-driven, well-informed decisions that promote a more resilient and sustainable agricultural landscape. This study examines the supervised machine learning approach used in crop yield prediction, highlighting how well they capture the intricate patterns and trends present in agricultural markets. Equipped with dependable projections, farmers may maximize planting choices, effectively allocate resources, and minimize hazards, thereby augmenting their earnings. The ability to anticipate future crop prices facilitates proactive measures to address potential challenges such as food inflation and market volatility. Machine learning models offer a strong basis for forecasting by combining historical data, weather trends, and market indicators. This paper's primary contributions include research on machine learning-based crop yield prediction, as well as a critical assessment of the benefits and drawbacks of various machine learning methods.

articleTitle: FRAG-EXTRACT: Unmasking Diabetes Mellitus Through Fragmented ECG Insights Using Deep Learning Approach
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus (DM), otherwise known as Diabetes, it is noted as the endocrine disorder which is a commonest hormonal deficit and it is characterized by the High level of Blood Glucose (BG). DM may occur due to pancreas insufficiency in producing Insulin or the body's cells may become irresponsive to the insulin hormone. Decades before, Investigators suggested various models to detect the DM using Electrocardiogram (ECG). ECG signals or the patterns may affect due to the cardiac autonomic neuropathy which is caused by DM. In this paper extraction if ECG features was proposed and the DM is classified using the ECG signals. The following process are involved in the proposed Frag -Extract method a) ECG signals are preprocessed, b) following the preprocessing phase Frag-Extract method takes place, in this method the ECG signals are fragmented into F1, F2, F3. Moreover, the fragmented signals are then fused using the fusion modules, Fl and F2 fragments are fused using the Focus wave blend fusion and the F2 and F3 are fused using the Deep wave blend Fusion. Furthermore, the fused output is amalgamated using the Twin path module and the classification of the fragmented signals occur using the DL.

articleTitle: Solar Spectrum – Understanding Solar Activity Patterns Within a Solar Cycle Using Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: The Sun's overpowering impact on our planet and space behavior is undeniable. Solar cycles are characterized by variations in the number and distribution of sunspots, and other solar activities like solar flares and coronal mass ejections (CME). Solar cycle prediction involves forecasting the overall behavior and activity levels of the Sun over the course of several solar cycles. These activities play a crucial role in shaping space weather, influencing satellite communications, power systems, and Earth's climate. Consequently, accurately predicting and classifying solar phenomena using machine learning methods has garnered significant attention in astrophysics. This research compares the efficiency of Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architectures in forecasting solar activities, focusing on sunspots, solar flares, and CMEs. The study aims to identify the superior model for the Solar Activity Prediction System, by employing advanced machine learning techniques. Sunspot prediction, based on a univariate dataset, revealed minimal overfitting for both models, with LSTM showing closer alignment with validated data and GRU producing a consistent average. Multivariate solar flare prediction showcased varied accuracies, with LSTM at 72.76% and GRU at 71.43%, while combined models reached up to 83.89%. Additionally, the binary classification of CMEs using LSTM and GRU models resulted in an AUC of 55 percent and 47 percent, respectively. These findings offer significant perspectives into the efficacy of Recurrent Neural Network architectures in solar activity forecasting, useful for advancing solar activity forecasting systems.

articleTitle: Prediction of Multiple Microbes Present in Single Image Using Advanced Deep Learning Models
abstract: The need for efficient and accurate methods of identifying specific microbes within complex communities has grown due to the vast amount of microbiome data available. This study focuses on multiple microbe identification within a given sample image using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The CNNs have shown incredible capacity to extract insights from microbiome data, resulting in unique patterns and characteristic recognition for targeted microbes and accurate classification. The analysis for this study employs three CNN models, Googlenet, Resnet-50, and Efficientnet-b0, trained with different algorithms. The Efficientnet-b0 model trained with the SGDM algorithm performs the best with a smaller number of iterations(140) and better training accuracy(100%) and loss(0.0897) with testing accuracy(64.9123 %). But overall, the testing accuracy should be considered as a key metric according to that the Resnet-50 & Googlenet trained with ADAM got the highest accuracy (75.4386%) than others but among them, the Resnet-50 should be considered as the best model due to its training loss (0.0372) is lower than Googlenet and got average testing Precision, Recall & Fl Score as 0.6749, 0.7141 & 0.6617 respectively. The study emphasizes the importance of data preprocessing, model architecture selection, and training strategies tailored to the microbial identification task. Additionally, the versatility of CNN models across different microbiome datasets enhances their transferability.

articleTitle: Simplified Framework for Diagnosis Brain Disease Using Functional Connectivity
abstract: Diagnosing brain infections is another region where artificial intelligence and neuroscience research meet. Functional connectivity (FC) examination has turned into the standard method for checking out fMRI information. The quantitative investigation of functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) information might uncover significant variables that assistance in clinical assessment. Then again, the greater part of the review done in the past has zeroed in on placing mind sicknesses into bunches in light of low-request FC characteristics and has disregarded the conceivable significance of high-request utilitarian connections between cerebrum regions. To protect this issue, physicists formulated an unusual MFC a multi-level fusion classification paradigm for recognizing mental disorders. To begin, they built a model using a deep neural network (DNN) to collect and formulate vital fundamental portrayals for the depressed-request and extreme-request FC designs we fashioned. During the preparation of the DNN model, there were both uncontrolled and directed learning steps. During the managed calibrating, model learning was added to make the element portrayal more reduced inside each class and simpler to distinguish from different classes. Then, at that point, to characterize mind illnesses, we consolidated the theoretical staggered FC highlights we had learned and utilized various leveled stacking learning techniques to prepare a troupe classifier. Deliberate tests were finished with two genuine, enormous-scope fMRI datasets. The recommended MFC model worked effectively in ordering information for various preprocessing processes, different mind parcellations, and different cross-approval techniques, which shows that it works and can be utilized in a wide range of circumstances. By and large, this work gives an effective method for consolidating significant low-request and high-request FC examples to make it more straightforward to order mind sicknesses.

Author Keywords: functional connectivity analysis of the brain

articleTitle: ConvEEGNet Approach for Improving Seizure Detection Through EEG Artifact Removal
abstract: This research work proposes a comprehensive method for eliminating artifacts and identifying seizures in EEG data, with the goal of enhancing both the accuracy and reliability of epilepsy diagnosis and monitoring. The methodology consists of many fundamental stages, which include data preprocessing, artifact elimination by independent component analysis (ICA), and the construction of a convolutional neural network (CNN) model namely ConvEEGNet for the purpose of seizure detection. The dataset employed comprises electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings obtained from individuals diagnosed with epilepsy, with a specific emphasis on the Siena Scalp Epilepsy dataset. The method of removing artifacts from the EEG signals efficiently diminishes noise and artifacts, hence improving the quality and interpretability of the signals. The CNN model has outstanding performance in properly identifying seizure events, with a remarkable average accuracy of 99.93% on the Siena Scalp Epilepsy dataset. This surpasses previous research works and emphasizes the efficacy of the suggested methodology. In a nutshell this work enhances the progress of seizure detection systems that rely on EEG, providing encouraging possibilities for enhanced diagnosis and treatment of epilepsy.

articleTitle: EmotiveNet: Five-Dimensional Emotion Detection with CNN-SVM Fusion
abstract: This paper encompasses meaningful discussions of affect recognition algorithms and a heterogeneous architecture that merges SVMs with CNNs. The model was mainly created using facial expression data to recognize five primary emotions: happiness or sadness, anger or fear, anger or fear, and amazement. Emotion recognition systems aim for a rise of accuracy and efficiency as the goal of their entity. CNN s are used in these models to obtain numerical information about emotional states from high-resolution face images. We employ the SVM (support vector machine) classifier to classify these characteristics into different emotional states accurately. Representing the 234×234 pixels as standards, a dataset of 2400 face pictures was utilized to compare the presented hybrid approach. Each image was thoroughly analyzed to ensure the method's viability. Precision, recall, F1-score, and total accuracy were used to compare the performance with the hybrid model's procedures. The hybrid model assayed the accuracy rate of 81.99%-95.33% and recall in the scope of 86.18%-97.3%, indicating excellent results. What was of great significance was that Class 3, related in most cases to the specific emotions, obtained the highest accuracy (97%) and F1-score (94.66%). Moreover, batteries that hold their performance for constant time were mentioned in the work that employed confusion and sophisticated matrices as well as weighted averages of micro, macro and cheap calculations. An average micro balanced in all parameters with a mean of 91.29%, implying that the detection range could be between various emotional states. This observation proves proof that the feedforward-backpropagation method's effectiveness could have numerous benefits in revolutionizing emotion identification science. The areas most likely to do so are interactivity, healthcare, and security.

articleTitle: Detection of AI Generated Text With BERT Model
abstract: Identifying AI-generated material from human-crafted essays within a massive archive of over 28,000 compositions combining both sources is the central objective of the enormous effort. The heart of the project is a state-of-the-art machine learning model that has been painstakingly designed to distinguish between student-authored articles and those generated by LLMs. With its binary labeling system, where 0 denotes human-written pieces and 1 signifies AI-generated content, this dataset is mostly used for essay text classification tasks. This combined endeavor aims to defend written content against the growing demand for its authenticity by adding to the pool of models that can distinguish between human and AI-authored language on a subtle level. If such an innovative model is successfully put into use, it could have a huge effect on the fight against fake news by making written material more reliable in many areas, such as education and online content moderation. By actively engaging contributors in the exploration of this vast dataset, the program hopes to foster advances in text authenticity verification, accelerating the growth of sturdy systems for assessing content dependability to unparalleled heights.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring System Based on LightGBM, CatBoost and Explainable Boost Classifier
abstract: This research introduces a sophisticated health monitoring system that utilizes the vital parameters of Pulse Rate, Temperature, Blood Oxygen Saturation(SPO2), and Respiratory Rate. The system employs advanced machine learning algorithms, including CatBoost, Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM) Classifiers, with the ensemble algorithm designated as Explainable Cat Gradient Boosting Machine (X-CatGBM), for the analysis and interpretation of the collected physiological data. By employing these algorithms, the system achieves real-time and accurate assessments of an individual's health status, providing insights into overall well-being. Notably, the chosen algorithms offer a balance between predictive accuracy and interpretability, ensuring that healthcare professionals and end-users can comprehend the reasoning behind the system's health evaluations. The transparent and interpretable nature of the model outputs enhances trust and understanding, crucial elements for the successful adoption of such technology in healthcare. The study establishes a foundation for the integration of cutting-edge machine learning techniques in health monitoring, holding promise for transformative impacts on remote patient monitoring and personalized healthcare practices.

articleTitle: A Low Profile Two Port MIMO Antenna with Enhanced Isolation for V2X Communication
abstract: This paper expresses the functionality and design of a flexible MIMO antenna to meet the increasing need for efficient V2X communication systems. The antenna's structural characteristics were carefully tuned using HFSS simulation. The antenna's resonance, impedance matching, and isolation capabilities were improved by adjusting the key geometric specifications, such as length, width, and diameter values. The examination of the S-parameters yielded valuable insights into the reflection and transmission properties of the antenna, whilst the investigation of VSWR highlighted its effectiveness in impedance matching. Furthermore, the gain plot model provided a clear understanding of the antenna's directional radiation pattern, which is essential for enhancing signal coverage and reception. The results of this study highlight the effectiveness of the suggested MIMO antenna design in satisfying the rigorous demands of V2X communication. The antenna achieves improved resonance, impedance matching, and radiation efficiency by carefully adjusting its structural characteristics. This contributes to the advancement of reliable communication systems for contemporary vehicle situations.

articleTitle: Evaluating Deep Learning Models for Customer Lifetime Value Forecasting Based on Hybrid DT and Naive Bayes Model
abstract: Customer lifetime value, a core concept in direct response marketing for quite some time, is now receiving increasing attention from management at Boston University's School of Management. However, the majority of published works on the topic have mainly concentrated on lauding its usefulness as a decision-making metric, offering only one numerical example of how it is calculated or determined, incorporating it into broader discussions of profitability, and examining its function in decisions regarding customer acquisition and the tensions between acquiring and retaining customers. There are three steps to the suggested method: preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training. After archiving duplicate and missing data, data preparation is employed to eradicate missing values. The feature selection process incorporates K-means, principal component analysis (PCA), and customer lifetime value measurements. An increase in the model training procedure's accuracy was achieved by utilizing the Hybrid DT and naive bayes. The recommended approach achieves a higher accuracy rate of 96.03 % compared to its rivals, which includes naive bayes and Hybrid DT.

articleTitle: Prediction and Evaluation of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using AI-Enabled Convolutional Neural Network and Transfer Learning: An Ensemble Approach
abstract: Recent research in Artificial Intelligence (AI) in diagnosing Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD) helps autistic people to improve their social, communicational and emotional skills. Diagnosis of ASD through enhanced models provides a reality-based therapy for promising improvements in autism disorders. This research paper proposes a novel approach for autism detection using ensemble learning with AI-enabled convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The proposed approach focuses on evaluating risk factors and disorders through an ensemble approach with transfer learning schemes. Our method leverages transfer learning from pre-trained CNN models, including EfficientNet B5, MobileNet, and InceptionV3, trained on the ImageNet dataset. We fine-tune these models for autism detection by improvising their architectures, freezing convolutional layers, and adding new fully connected layers for binary classification problems. Through extensive experimentation, the demonstration was made with a keen focus on each CNN model, which then improved accuracy in identifying autistic traits from image data. Furthermore, by combining the predictions of these models using a soft voting ensemble technique, they achieve superior performance with an accuracy of about 91% respectively. Our results indicate the effectiveness of ensemble learning in improving autism detection accuracy, showcasing the potential of deep learning approaches in aiding clinical diagnosis and treatment planning for autism spectrum disorders (ASDs).

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network with Tunicate Swarm Optimization and Shift Delta Cepstrum for Automated Driver Health Monitoring System
abstract: Fatal driving accidents are primarily caused by stress and weariness. Almost 80% of drivers experience stress when operating a vehicle. Anxiety, impatience, lack of concentration, and problems paying attention are all brought on by stress. So by closely monitoring the health of the drives we can avoid major accidents. Now a days there are many inventories in the field of health monitoring of the drivers, even though the accuracy and early detection is challenging. In order to overcome the drawbacks of the existing system, a driver health monitoring system based on optimized Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is proposed. The collected ECG signal is first pre-processed by Butterworth filter and Savitizky-Golay Filter to improve the quality of the signal. After pre-processing, the features are extracted by using Fractional Fourier transform (FrFT) and Shift Delta Cepstrum (SDC). It enhance the pre-processed signal in the extraction of time and frequency domain. To classify whether the driver is fit, under stress and Cardiac Health issues the RNN algorithm is used for classification. The suggested classifier's learning rate is maximized with the application of Tunicate Swarm Optimization (TSO). To avoid the accident with other vehicle a buzzer is used to alert them in the cause of Stress and heart issues. According to the experimental approach, the techniques achieves 96.6% of accuracy, 94.6% of precision, 91% of Recall and 95% of Specificity. Thus, the driver health be accurately monitored using this proposed automated model.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Medical Imaging: Unveiling ChatGPT's Potential in Diagnostics
abstract: The integration of OpenAI's Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer (ChatGPT) into medical modalities has garnered considerable attention in recent years, yet significant research gaps persist in understanding its full potential and limitations. We evaluate its advantages—like aiding in interpretation, enhancing diagnostic accuracy, and simplifying consultations—as well as its disadvantages—like issues with precision and repeatability—by carefully examining current studies. While it has shown promise in procedures including neuroimaging, Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) and Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS), its limitations make it clear that more work needs to be done before it can be used in clinical settings. To fully realize ChatGPT's potential to enhance medical practice, more study is needed, and this analysis lays the foundation for that research.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cardiovascular Health Assessment with ANN-Enabled Hypertension Classification
abstract: Hypertension, a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease, affects millions worldwide. This work utilises an innovative approach for hypertension category classification using Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). This method utilises a comprehensive dataset comprising various demographic, clinical, and lifestyle factors. The proposed ANN model utilises the diverse features within the dataset to accurately classify hypertension into distinct categories, including Normal, Elevated, Hypertension Stage 1, and Hypertension Stage 2. The ANN learns complex patterns and relationships inherent in the data through an optimised training process, enabling improved classification performance. Comparative analyses with traditional classification methods show the ANN-based approach's superiority in classification in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. The evaluation of the ANN model demonstrates its effectiveness in accurately categorising hypertension levels, achieving an impressive accuracy of 99.60%. Moreover, the interpretability of the ANN model is explored to gain insights into the influential factors contributing to hypertension category classification. The findings of this work contribute to the advancement of automated hypertension classification systems, offering a reliable and efficient tool for healthcare professionals in hypertension diagnosis and management. This work aims to enhance the accuracy and efficacy of clinical decision-making in cardiovascular health assessment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Microbes Prediction Accuracy Through Advanced Deep Learning Models
abstract: This paper presents the identification of specific microbial species within a given sample image by employing CNN s. The learned features capture unique patterns and characteristics associated with targeted microbes, enabling accurate classification and identification. The Googlenet, Resnet-50 & Efficientnet-b0 CNN models are used for the analysis for this study because they all share common input image size and are state of the art. The Efficientnet-b0 achieved better performance in terms of training accuracy (100%) and loss (0.0897) and also required a smaller number of iterations (140). But when it comes to testing accuracy (74.2690%), precision (0.6921), recall (0.7043), & f1 score (0.6778) the Googlenet is better in all three networks. The paper also includes data preprocessing, model architecture selection, and training strategies tailored to the microbial identification. In addition, the transferability of CNN models across different microbiome Datasets enhances their versatility presented.

articleTitle: Harmonizing Detection: A Fusion Approach to Combat Adware Attacks on Android Devices
abstract: The aim of this paper is, therefore, “the detection of harmful adverts that might be used by attackers to gain unauthorized access in order to mitigate them. This follows that, to minimize this risk, intrusion detection is applied to the combination-based learning technique that is effective in identifying any form of intrusion, called RNN-SVM. Another hybrid solution, RNN-SVM is the combination of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Support Vector Machines (SVMs), capable of leveraging the power of these two methods to help outpouring toward improved modern intrusion detection system capabilities at better accuracy and efficiencies. This hybrid approach brings learning skills from Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and the robustness of Support Vector Machines (SVMs) together to enhance the identification of adware attacks over Android-based smartphones and tablets. The testing strategy uses the dataset CCCS_CIC_AndMa12022, which gives a full set of online traffic data that refers to the Adware attack cases in Android devices. Such data hence help the researchers derive effective ways of training their detection systems to test for security breaches. The research, therefore, shows that RNN-SVM technology has the capability of unmasking fraudulent advertising effectively and revealing the efforts of cybercriminals to penetrate Android devices. This further underscores the very reason that advanced machine learning (ML) techniques should be in use to further shore up the security of Android OS devices against adware attacks.

articleTitle: DrowseGuard – DeepAlert Driver Vigilance System
abstract: Driver fatigue is a major contributor to road accidents, necessitating the integration of advanced technologies for improved road safety. This research presents DrowseGuard, a DeepAlert Driver Vigilance System designed for seamless incorporation into Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) within vehicles. Utilizing a sophisticated deep learning model and mediapipe framework, DrowseGuard offers precise eye monitoring, thereby enhancing fatigue detection accuracy. The system surpasses conventional methods by analyzing dynamic factors such as sudden speed spikes and unexpected turns. Real-time alerts issued by DrowseGuard provide a comprehensive solution for enhancing road safety through ADAS infrastructure. The synergistic integration of the Deep Learning technology and ADAS enhances accuracy, enabling early identification of signs of driver fatigue. Unlike conventional development board implementations, DrowseGuard's direct integration ensures practicality, scalability, and applicability across diverse vehicle platforms. This research represents a significant advancement in driver-assistance technologies, aiming to elevate overall safety standards in modern vehicles. The motivation lies in addressing the escalating concern of road accidents attributed to driver fatigue, while the objective is to enhance road safety through the integration of DrowseGuard into ADAS systems.

articleTitle: Advancements in Quality Control: Integrating Machine Learning for Defect Prediction
abstract: The present study provides a detailed analysis of a thorough quality defect detection technique that has been used in a variety of industrial contexts. The research focuses on major defect types such as surface imperfections, dimension deviations, color discrepancies, materials defects, assembling issues, function flaws, and packaging defects. The accuracy, Recall, Fl- Score, Support, Supporting Proportion, or Accuracy are the evaluation measures used in this study, which provide a detailed knowledge of the model's performance across five crucial defect areas. The precision scores range from 93.16% can 95.75%, demonstrating the model's ability to correctly identify occurrences of flaws within each class while minimising false positives. The related recall values, which range from 92.02 % detection to 95.08%, demonstrate the model's ability to capture a significant number of true problems while 2zq minimizing false negatives. The Fl-Score, which provides a balanced assessment of recall and accuracy, continually demonstrates the resilience of the defect identification system, with values ranging from 92.59% to 94.89<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. In addition to the class-specific indicators, macro, weighted, along micro averages provide a broader assessment of the model's effectiveness. The Macro Average, which emphasizes equal contributions from all classes, produces remarkable results (94.24<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy, 94.22% recall, or 94.23% Fl-Score). The Weighted Average, which accounts for class imbalances, produces comparable powerful results (94.25% accuracy, 94.25% recall, or 94.24% Fl-Score). The Micro Average achieves a total precision of 94.25% while considering all occurrences equally. The research presented here adds useful insights into the efficacy of defect detection approaches while also providing an extensive structure for monitoring and improving quality control systems in industrial settings. The results show that the system can achieve high accuracy and recall across a variety of fault classes, indicating its dependability and applicability towards practical uses in quality control and manufacturing.

articleTitle: Advanced NLP and ML Techniques in E-Commerce: Enhancing Customer Experience with AI Chatbots
abstract: Due to the exponential growth of e-cornmerce, it has become important to come up with new concepts to improve the customer experience (CX) as well as manage the competition factors. This research aims to explore the advances made in applying AI in the area of chatbots with a specific focus on the e-commerce industry. Leaning from the principles of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML), we created a high-performance chatbot capable of performing numerous customer service functions such as product inquiries, tracking order status, and addressing concerns. To do this, the data gathered by the current study is a broad dataset, including records of 50,000 customer interactions collected from different e-commerce platforms along with customer satisfaction rating, response time, and resolution success. The chatbot was trained using a supervised learning approach and evaluated on multiple performance parameters: response time, resolution rate, customer satisfaction, engagement rate, and cost savings. The results demonstrate that the chatbot achieved an average response time of 1.5 seconds, a resolution rate of 92.3%, an average customer satisfaction rating of 4.6 out of 5, an engagement rate of 78.5%, and monthly cost savings of $45,000. These findings underscore the chatbot's effectiveness in providing rapid, accurate, and personalized responses, leading to enhanced customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. A comparison of the study with existing modern approaches for constructing and training chatbots shows the effectiveness of the developed chatbot, predominantly in terms of the resolution rate.

articleTitle: Beyond Single Bids: Serverless Combinatorial Auctions for Efficient Resource Allocation
abstract: In the world of cloud computing, serverless architecture has emerged as a disruptive paradigm, allowing developers to focus solely on code development while abstracting infrastructure management complexity. Nonetheless, optimizing resource allocation and price dynamics in serverless contexts is a continuing problem. This study investigates the creative incorporation of combinatorial auction processes into serverless computing, with the goal of streamlining resource allocation and pricing determinations. This paper elucidates the potential benefits of combinatorial auctions and their application to serverless systems by exploring the underlying concepts of resource allocation efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and overall performance improvement. Through an extensive review of existing literature and rigorous analysis, we demonstrate how the incorporation of combinatorial auctions can revolutionize resource utilization, alleviate vendor lock-in concerns, and catalyze the establishment of competitive pricing models in the domain of serverless computing. The findings given herein not only add to our theoretical understanding of combinatorial auctions in the context of serverless computing, but also lay the framework for actual implementation and future improvements in this field.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Talent Management: The Impact of Machine Learning on HR Efficiency and Effectiveness
abstract: The current business environment requires creativity in ensuring the restructuring of human resources. The conventional talent management approaches are often inadequate because most of these practices are done on benches and involve a lot of judgment. This research paper aims to review how machine learning has been adopted in various aspects of talent management such as Talent acquisition; employee performance management; employee retention; and employee development. Overall, this work applies and outlines how machine learning can be utilized as a tool to achieve effective insights, HR process contextuality, and better decision-making accuracy. Major machine learning algorithms include logistic regression, random forests, support vector machines, and neural networks. Among the models, the neural network model was the best with the highest accuracy of 98. 34%, highest AVC-ROC of 99.29%, lowest log loss of 0.015, and mean absolute error of 0. 098. The conclusion made by the study reveals how the application of machine learning can enhance talent management and make it possible for organizations to perform better. This study also casts light on issues of data privacies, and security, as well as the concerns of algorithmic unfairness, stating for ethical and explicative, approaches to ML. The results only serve to highlight the promises machine learning can deliver to revolutionize traditional HR practices in support of strategic organizational goals.

articleTitle: Adaptive Intelligent Energy Orchestration System (AIEOS)
abstract: This paper outlines Adaptive Intelligent Energy Orchestration System, a solution to the rising electric costs based on tiered pricing. In view of the constant rise of electric costs, a vital solution is considered in this paper which is Adaptive Intelligent Energy Orchestration System and the method through which it minimizes the cost. The application of decision mechanism within the three sections of single-phase metered lines is an applicable methodology with distinguishing the point of pairs or more additionally when parity is reached, the system records the minimum units consumed, and the load is shifted to the meter with the lowest consumption. This process continues until the next unit at which the next count is specified. The aim of AIEOS is to optimize the units consumed in each line and avert the financial burden of increasing energy charges because of the tiered pricing.

articleTitle: Exposing the Financial Impact of AI-Driven Data Analytics: A Cost-Benefit Analysis
abstract: This study presents a value-gain analysis of utilizing AI-pushed records analytics (AIDA) for businesses. It investigates the monetary effect of AIDA throughout marketplace sectors, studying the results of different AIDA techniques, their value shape, and related return on funding (ROI). The fee-advantage analysis is carried out by evaluating the envisioned fees of AIDA with the capability returns, economic and non-financial, predicted to be received from its use. They look at gathering AIDA-related fees and gain metrics from public information assets, including monetary documents and enterprise reports, and use them to present a proof-based assessment of the economic advantages related to AIDA. Additionally, they take a look to explore the capability of HR, managerial, and organizational demanding situations associated with enforcing AIDA in business operations. This research offers valuable insights for organizations considering the adoption of AIDA and can be used to inform control selections around fee-effective AIDA techniques.

articleTitle: Employing Opposition-Based Grey Wolf Optimization for Optimal Allocation and Sizing of Distributed Generation in a Power Distribution System
abstract: This work addresses the challenge of optimal allocation and sizing for Distributed Generation (DG) in power systems. The proposed approach leverages Opposition-Based Grey Wolf Optimization (OBGWO), a variation of the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) algorithm inspired by grey wolf pack hunting strategies. OBGWO introduces the concept of oppositional solutions, expanding the search space and potentially leading to faster convergence towards optimal DG placement and capacity. By minimizing power losses and improving voltage profiles within the distribution system, the OBGWO framework aims to achieve a balance between efficient power delivery and optimal DG integration. This research contributes to the field of power system optimization by exploring a novel application of OBGWO for effective DG planning and deployment.

articleTitle: EEUCBE And OOA Based Multi Hop Routing For Secure And Energy Efficient Data Transmission In Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are gaining a lot of attention from several domains due to its self-configuration, scalability, and ease of maintenance features. Because they are independent, the sensor nodes create an ad hoc intercommunication topology with one another. The primary limitations of sensor nodes, however, are their limited processing power, energy management, transmission, and storage capacity. Due to the limited capabilities of these battery-powered nodes, researchers have tried a variety of strategies to improve network performance. Nevertheless, maintaining network throughput and balancing energy consumption remain the primary research challenges. This work develops a safe and energy-effective routing protocol. Initially, the nodes are placed randomly in a network region. Gradient Enhanced Physics Informed Neural Network is used to identify the malicious nodes in a network. Then the cluster formation and cluster selection is done using Energy Efficient Unbalanced Clustering using Balance Energy (EEUCBE). Orca Optimization Algorithm based Multi hop routing is employed in this model to choose the optimal relay data transmission among CH and BS. This proposed approach achieves 6.6 mbps throughput and 3% of packet loss. It also has 95% accuracy and 92% precision for the proposed GEPINN for malicious node detection. Thus, this proposed approach is the best choice for secure and energy efficient data transmission in WSN.

Author Keywords: Secure and energy efficient data transmission

articleTitle: Enhanced Thyroid Cancer Classification: Leveraging Advanced Machine Learning Techniques with a Focus on Random Forest for Optimal Accuracy
abstract: One of the most critical difficulties confronting contemporary medicine is the diagnosis of thyroid cancer. Using powerful machine learning (ML) algorithms provides intriguing opportunities to increase the speed and accuracy of thyroid cancer detection. This research gives a detailed comparative analysis of the Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Tree, and Random Forest approaches for the classification of thyroid cancer using a properly chosen dataset. Important methodologies like feature engineering, training models, data preparation, and detailed assessment are all covered in the research. It offers insights on the merits and downsides of every technique. Through major discussions and detailed evaluations, this study brings new information to the area of machine learning-driven thyroid cancer detection with the objective of increasing clinical decision support systems moving forward and boosting patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Exploring the Boundaries of Real- Time Data Analysis with Machine Learning
abstract: Gadget studying (ML) is becoming more and more famous for real-time facts analysis responsibilities; however, present ML models are often no longer suitable for this form of software due to constraints on computational assets, facts distribution, or modeling complexity. In this paper, we investigate the limits of actual-time statistics evaluation for ML fashions to permit us to extract insights from massive datasets with constrained sources., we focus on key challenges: first, designing ML algorithms that require minimum pre-processing and make system information speedy; and second, locating powerful ways of calculating the accuracy of predictions made in real time. To address those troubles, we increase a framework for real-time information evaluation primarily based on current advances in extreme gaining knowledge of machines (ELM), which is a computationally efficient ML set of rules. We then examine the performance of our framework on a ramification of datasets and display that our ELM-based framework is capable of presenting correct predictions with low computational complexity and limited facts pre-processing. Our outcomes display that it's far viable to gain short, correct real-time information evaluation with ML models, and propose that, in addition, studies into ELM and other green ML algorithms could allow us to push the limits of real-time records analysis even similarly.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Wireless Network Security with Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) service
abstract: Pretty desirable privacy (PGP) is an encryption carrier used to secure facts communique over a wireless community. It uses a combination of public and private keys to ensure that the supposed recipient can decipher a message and, as a consequence, save it from being accessed by someone else. PGP also makes use of a virtual signature process, which allows the sender of a message to show their identity. It is performed through the technology of an encrypted message that is specific to the sender. The virtual signature allows the recipient to verify the sender's identity and additionally confirms that the facts have no longer been changed because it becomes dispatched. By using PGP, companies can reduce the vulnerability of their Wi-Fi networks by encrypting their records transmissions and deterring potential attackers.

articleTitle: The Future of Data Protection: Empowering Data Security with Identity-Centric Blockchain Technology
abstract: In response to the formidable challenges surrounding data security, particularly in the face of evolving threats and vulnerabilities, this study introduces the Advanced Blockchain-Enhanced Data Security Protocol (ABE-DSP) as a cutting-edge solution. Acknowledging the complexities of safeguarding sensitive information, ABE-DSP is a meticulously crafted and sophisticated framework that aims to fortify the security and integrity of data transactions through the integration of blockchain technology. This protocol addresses the pressing challenge of ensuring robust data security by placing a primary focus on enhancing overall system security and refining user authentication processes. Within the context of these challenges, the study explores the intricacies of ABE-DSP's design and implementation. Furthermore, the proposed method demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving a remarkable success rate, processing 97% of received packets with precision. This high percentage underscores the protocol's efficacy and reliability, positioning it as a robust and advanced tool for overcoming the contemporary challenges associated with data security. This study contributes valuable insights to the ongoing discourse on leveraging blockchain technology for identity-centric data security, offering a promising avenue for addressing and mitigating the challenges faced in the dynamic landscape of information protection.

articleTitle: BERT-CA Sentinels: Adapting BERT with Attention Mechanism for Satirical News Detection in Social Media Texts
abstract: The exponential proliferation of misinformation, particularly on social media platforms, has emerged as a formidable issue with far-reaching adverse consequences on a worldwide level. Satirical articles, unlike false news, are not meant to deceive or influence the reader. Instead, their purpose is to entertain by ridiculing or critiquing a prominent figure. The major challenge for detecting satire from fake news due to intentional use of subtle language to avoid the fake news detectors. This subtle language consists of casual approach and vagueness in language. To solve above issues, this proposed approach utilized the integrated technique that captures the statistical relationship between words in the text using conditional probability alongside BERT attention mechanism to generate a conditional attention (CA) to improve the contextual comprehension in satire detection task. In next stage, for enhancing lexicon-sentiment and to extract opinion expression with sequential patterns as sentinels this approach is using Bi-LSTM with Conditional Random Field (CRF) by computing simulating labels and transition scores. To determine the best overall CRF scores utilizing Viterbi Algorithm that makes this approach more accurate. To evade vagueness, next this proposed method uses Bi-Normal Separation (BNS) feature scaling in classification space by determining the strong and weak correlation with positive and negative class to yield the high performance. This methodology entails FAKENEWSDATA as dataset, which is then subjected to preprocessing techniques to eliminate noise and achieve normalization. The proposed approach outperforms as compared to other state-of-art algorithms like SVM, LR, DT, and KNN with 98.68% in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Last Mile Logistics with Machine Learning and Drone Technology in Aerial Solutions
abstract: The purpose of the present paper is going to focus on one of the most important aspects of last-mile logistics, namely drone technology. It goes further into design of UA Vs in delivery systems, analyzing the present use, the main stakeholders, issues in operation, and trends in the future. This research explores the role of key players such as leading traditional retailers like Amazon and Google as well as emerging innovative companies towards driving the advancement of drone technology for last mile delivery. Furthermore, this paper aims to discuss the new technologies, the current laws, and the customers' readiness to determine the feasibility of the use of the drones as effective, timely, and environmentally friendly last-mile delivery solutions.

articleTitle: The CNN-SVM Revolution: Dissecting Cricket Bowling Movements
abstract: The primary approach of this research to classify the technique of a cricket bowling stroke is to develop a hybrid CNN-SVM model. Given the demand for a more automatized, precise and result-oriented system of the analysis of sport, particularly cricket-the suggestion for the model created by researchers allows getting more accurate and consistent of different bowling stroke types. A dataset comprising 3,200 photographs at various angles of a bowler's delivery, with five groups (Fast Ball, Swing Ball, Spin Ball, Seam Ball, and Slow Ball), was utilized to train and test the model. The mixed CNN-SVM model succeeded in applying SVM's determining potential together with CNN's feature detection ability for classifying the given images. Two measures of precision, recall, F1measure, and total accuracy are some of the common indicators used to check the capacity of the model systematically. This neural net gave an outstanding result of 96.25% for the visual features of Slow Balls and 94.91 % for the spin curve of Speed Balls. It will be demonstrated an impressive level of accuracy. The f1 scores show that the model is balanced, and the best score was 93.56% for slow balls. These were very impressive. To present the discovery that confusion occasionally surfaces as a problem in distinguishing quite similar styles, marking the way for identifying the individual model particularity and the model's way for improvement. By demonstrating that this system is easy, accurate, and automatable and providing information such as cricket bowling shots, this study has made a massive contribution to sports analytics.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognizer Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: The objective of Sign Language Recognition (SLR) is to convert sign language into text or speech in order to enable deaf-mute individuals to communicate with non-deaf individuals. Despite its significant social implications, this endeavor remains exceedingly difficult to accomplish on account of its intricate nature and considerable variability in hand movements. Current approaches to SLR rely on manually constructed features to delineate sign language motion and construct classification models. Designing dependable functionalities that can accommodate the extensive diversity of hand gestures poses a significant challenge. In order to tackle this issue, we introduce an innovative convolutional neural network (CNN) that autonomously extracts discriminative spatial and temporal features from unprocessed video streams, devoid of any pre-existing knowledge and without the need for feature design. In order to enhance performance, the CNN is provided with inputs consisting of multi-channel video streams that contain color information, depth clues, and body joint positions. These channels integrate trajectory, depth, and color information. The efficacy of the proposed model is demonstrated by validating it on a real dataset acquired using Microsoft Kinect, surpassing the performance of conventional methods that rely on manually crafted features.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Classifying Female Alopecia: CNN-SVM Model
abstract: This study article provides a unique strategy for the automatic categorization of distinct phases of hair loss in women applying machine learning techniques. The suggested technique incorporates neural networks based on convolution (CNNs) as well as Support Vector Machines (SVMs) to properly identify hair loss stages into four distinct groups: TypeI, TypeII, TypeIII, and TypeIV. The performance of the classification model is assessed using precision, recall, F1-Score, support, support percentage, and accuracy measures. Results reveal high accuracy values ranging from 91.66% to 94.59%, suggesting the model's ability to limit false positives. Similarly, recall scores ranging from 90.90% to 95.31 % indicate the model's competence in spotting genuine positive events. Furthermore, F1-Score values, ranging from 92.21 % to 94.61 %, demonstrate the balanced performance of the model in terms of accuracy and recall. The model yields an overall accuracy range from 96% to 97%, underlining its usefulness in properly categorizing cases throughout all hair loss phases. Moreover, macro as well as weighted averages give complete insights into the model's effectiveness across all classes, whereas the micro average highlights the aggregate performance, indicating an accuracy of 98.49%. These results underline the possible benefits of the suggested strategy in helping diagnosis and therapy planning for women suffering from hair loss.

articleTitle: Integration of AI Based Chatbot in Tech Interview Prep App
abstract: The preparation for technical interviews in today's competitive job market demands innovative approaches. This paper introduces an Android-based Tech Interview Prep App designed to revolutionize interview readiness. Anchored in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Database Interview Questions, and Data Structures, the app integrates cutting-edge technologies like Java, XML, and an AI-driven Chatbot using OpenAl's ChatGPT. With curated questions and real-time assistance, it transforms the learning experience, offering personalized support and dynamic engagement.

articleTitle: Multiband PIFA Antenna for Mobile Applications
abstract: The analytical analysis on PIFA technology is implemented. Various research works done on planar inverted-F antenna (PIFA) are classified and reviewed. Nowadays fast beyond growth of mobile technology. It's highly slammed on social life. The modern antenna designs needs a single element to be used in many band systems. This paper proposed many techniques based on multiband PIFA antenna for mobile communications. The PIFA antenna inserted of two assisted arms by connecting walls fed by 50 Ω patch element and a ground element. The patch element insert with slot and another arm to create and manage the various frequency bands. The proposed antennas various methodology such as L-slots E-slots, U-slots for achieved multiple frequency bands such as L-band 1GHz-2GHz(L), 2GHz-4 GHz(S), 4GHz-8GHz (C), 8GHz-12GHz(X) bands and higher bandwidth and gain by using shorting pin dielectric substrate, taper matching, dual feed, defected ground structures, etc. proposed band suitable for mobile and wireless communications, WLAN, WiFi, WiMAX, LTE, Bluetooth, radar communication, 4G and 5G communication etc. the design of antenna using FR4 lossy substrate material, coaxial probe feed line with 50 Ω impedance

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Morse Code Security: Dual-Layer Encryption with AES and Machine Learning
abstract: Morse code is a method used in telecommunication to encode text characters as sequences of two different signal durations, called dots and dashes, or dits and dahs. It is a well-known, traditional method of communication that is frequently connected to radio transmission and telegraphy.
