In today's world, to protect sensitive data from cyber-attacks and maintain privacy and integrity in digital conversations, transactions, and storage, encryption and decryption are essential. These procedures provide security and build user confidence in this age of cybercrime by ensuring that their data is protected from unauthorized access. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is a popular encryption model which to date has been trusted for its effectiveness in safe-guarding sensitive data in digital communications and storage. AES Modern innovations also include other new mechanisms like - artificial intelligence (AI) to support pattern recognition, which later reduces the need for human decryption efforts for decryption and also improves the speed and efficiency of decryption of encrypted data. Various techniques such as artificial intelligence or machine learning are also used in decryption techniques. In the current interconnected digital environment, this integration contributes not only to enhancing the efficiency of encrypting but also allows for faster decryption of data for accurate and timely transmission of data. To make this research more realistic, data is transmitted between two systems using a wireless LAN connection. Besides this, the evaluation of these models is done based on the time taken for the encryption process and decryption process to ensure the efficiency is optimally vested in real life.

articleTitle: Investigating the Efficacy of Ensemble Machine Learning Models in Multi-Class Categorization of Web Pages for Spotlighting User Interests
abstract: Web page categorization plays a crucial role in organizing the ever-growing repository of online content, facilitating improved search functionality, enabling personalized content delivery, enhancing recommendation systems, optimizing targeted advertising, and spotlighting user interests. Utilizing the predictive capabilities of Ensemble Machine Learning (EML) models is essential for automating the web page classification process, ensuring a more efficient identification of user preferences in the dynamic landscape of online content. Towards this objective, the present research study introduces the Ensemble Machine Learning-based Webpage Categorization System (EML-WCS), concentrating on all essential stages of the classification process. The EML-WCS gathers a large and open-source dataset, ensuring a representative sample of web content across various key domains. The pre-processing phase entails a series of text processing steps, including replacing separators, removing URLs, punctuation, and numbers, eliminating stop words, and performing lemmatization to enhance the quality of the provided text data. The EML-WCS leverages the ensemble capabilities of Random Forest and XGBoost techniques for multi-class classification of webpages based on content, achieving an impressive accuracy of 99.69% and 96.04%, respectively. The outcomes of this study have implications for industries spanning from e-commerce to content recommendation systems, highlighting the pivotal role of understanding and responding to user interests for achieving optimal user satisfaction and engagement.

articleTitle: Redefining Dental Radiology Using Deep Learning
abstract: The recent times have witnessed a rise in the use of image processing, computer vision, and machine learning in the field of medical imaging, thus offering more accurate diagnoses with a reduction of the cost of labor while at the same time, minimizing the scope for human error. Dental X-ray images are often challenging and time-consuming to study consequently making diagnosis more arduous. Furthermore, only an experienced clinician can endeavor to provide an accurate diagnosis from a two-dimensional X-ray image. Manual investigation of dental diseases and abnormalities is still the most prevalent method in the field of dentistry. This article aims to introduce a novel method to automate the process of obtaining an initial diagnosis from orthopantamogram(OPG) X-rays by using state-of-the-art object detection models which are currently proving to be effective in medical image diagnosis. By providing an effective comparison between popular object detection frameworks, we aim to determine the computer vision model that provides the most promising results by accurately diagnosing dental abnormalities and identifying treatments from a dental X-ray image in an error-free and efficient manner.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Attention Mechanisms in Time Series Modeling
abstract: Deep learning may be an effective tool for time collection modeling, as it presents a manner to automatically learn robust representations of temporal facts. these days, interest-based totally deep learning fashions have emerge as an increasing number of popular, due to the fact they enable the version to examine which temporal features should be prioritized whilst making predictions. Interest-based totally fashions utilize a mechanism, which assigns special weights to exceptional components of the enter sequence consistent with their relevance for the assignment. As an end result, the model is capable of awareness extra on applicable features and disregards the less critical ones, thus growing its accuracy. To this stop, attention architectures with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) were proposed and implemented to time collection forecasting tasks. Their outcomes have shown amazing ability in diverse industrial and educational packages for predicting complex nonlinear dynamics in time series facts. Moreover, these methods can be used to discover systems inside time series data, together with seasonal and cyclical styles, as well as discover important temporal dependencies among special functions.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Integration in Teletherapy for Modernizing Mental Health Support
abstract: The present research examines the implementation of elaborate deep learning techniques such as Variational Autoencoders (VAE), Facial Expression Recognition, and Sentiment Analysis for teletherapy platforms. In a number of experimental trials, the efficiency and performance of these instruments were judged. As it is evident from the calculations, over all examined tools have shown to deliver promising results. In the case of VAEs, we observed that the average reconstruction loss values were between 0.019 and 0.028, while the average KL divergence values remained in the range of 0.003 and 0.007. Overall, nonlinear generative models such as VAEs can be expected to capture the underlying structure of the input data in a more accurate way, and this is essential when generating personalized interventions for therapy. Furthermore, the Facial Expression Recognition model demonstrated strong performance as well, while the average accuracy ranges between 0.81 and 0.89. From the results, the Facial Expression models showed a high level of accuracy with an average score of 0.78 to 0.91. This means that the models successfully detected and classified facial expressions of a client's emotions into the respective categories. It provided therapists with detailed modeling of clients' emotions during therapy sessions. Similarly, Sentiment Analysis performed well with an average accuracy of between 0.84 and 0.92. It means that the Sentiment Analysis models could effectively classify text data into sentiment categories.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for Image Forgery Detection Based on MEHO-SAE Model
abstract: Nowadays, more and more people can afford to take images, making photography a popular pastime. The wealth of information stored in images makes them indispensable in our daily lives. In order to get more information out of images, we usually have to edit them. Many methods exist to enhance photographs; however, these same techniques could also be utilized to create misleading images, resulting in the dissemination of inaccurate information. Already a major worry, image forgeries are getting even worse as a consequence of this. It is critical to follow the precise order of operations when preprocessing, extracting features, and training the model. The preprocessing includes tasks such as key point extraction and HSV conversion. Feature extraction, the process of obtaining pertinent information from an input picture, is the initial step in developing an object identification system. Using a MEHO-SAE model, the model was trained. This approach appears to be fairly novel when compared to the state-of-the-art MEHO and SAE. The results improved significantly and achieved a level of 97.23 percent accuracy.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Agricultural Finance: Simplifying Farmer Access to Financial Tools with an Innovative Fintech Platform
abstract: Agriculture stands as the cornerstone of global sustenance and economic prosperity, yet smallholder farmers face significant financial barriers. Despite advancements in agricultural technology and markets, access to financial services remains limited for smallholders. We've thoroughly examined 25 research papers in this field to assess the extent of existing research. Subsequently, we conducted a comprehensive market analysis and competitive review to shape the design of our platform. This study introduces an innovative fintech platform aimed at bridging this gap by facilitating connections between farmers and financial service providers. By leveraging precision risk analysis, inclusive microloans, comprehensive insurance coverage and democratized investment opportunities, our platform seeks to enhance sustainable farming practices and boost productivity for smallholder farmers. Our platform utilizes data analytics to assess risk factors specific to agricultural activities, thereby providing personalized financial solutions and mitigating risks inherent in farming operations.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Patterns of Preemption: Classifying Violent Incidents with CNN-SVM Intelligence
abstract: This research paper presents a comprehensive analysis of violence detection using a hybrid CNN-SVM approach across five distinct violence classes: for instance, gangs, physical assault, domestic violence, bullying, rioting, and verbal abuse. The study presents a neural network of the convolutional type that is aimed to use deep learning in feature extraction from data visualization and, next, an SVM that is meant to do classifications. Performance metrics for each class reveal the nuanced capabilities of the model: Class 1 showed precision, recall, and F1-score of 77.83%, 75.84%, and 76.82 % respectively; Class 2 exhibited higher recall with values of 78.21 % precision, 86.17% recall, and an F1-score of 82.00%; Class 3 maintained a balance with an 80.43 % precision, 78.90% recall, and a 79.66% F1-score; Class 4 demonstrated vital precision and recall at 80.54% and 85.18% respectively, with an F1-score of 82.80%; Class 5 achieved the highest precision of 88.59%, with a recall of 79.82% and an F1-score of 83.98%. The overall model performance is captured using various averaging techniques: Three different ways of computing values were explored through macro average (of 81.12% precision, 81.18% recall, and 81.05% F1-score), weighted average (of 81.21 % precision, 81.01% recall, and 81.01 % F1-score); and micro average (that shows uniform values throughout of Such outcomes clearly show significant progress of a CNN-SVM model in classifying among complexly occurring violence patterns that can be helpful for an implementing of automatic violence detection systems with substantive application. Research presented a different perspective on class classification performance that was quite sensitive but had relatively high efficiency, as shown by the precision of 90% -94% among the five classes.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection for Autonomous Driving Within Cooperative Communication System Based on CNN-ELM Approach
abstract: The ability to perceive and understand the behaviors of other road users is crucial for autonomous vehicles to accurately plan their responses. Autonomous vehicles are able to complete a lot of tasks, like identifying pedestrians, thanks to computer vision systems that are mostly based on machine learning algorithms. Furthermore, in an entirely autonomous driving setting, all vehicles need to talk to each other and exchange perceived data in order for navigation to be safe. Training the model, segmentation, and preprocessing are the three primary components of the method. Image smoothing is a part of preprocessing; there are a number of filters available for this purpose, such as the Median, Gaussian, Histogram, Dilation and Erosion, mean, and so on. The best way to blur the noisy details is with the Gaussian filter. Negative sample decorrelation is used in segmentation. For the model's training, it utilized the CNN-ELM model. Compared to more recent techniques, such as CNN and ELM, this one seems antiquated. The data shows an astoundingly high accuracy percentage of 93.70 percent.

articleTitle: InfinityMover
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of a smart wheelchair system tailored for the disabled community, focusing on gesture control as its primary feature. In addition to gesture control, the system integrates several auxiliary functionalities including obstacle avoidance, Bluetooth control, and voice commands. The system's hardware setup involves the use of servos, ultrasonic sensors, and motor controllers, while the software is programmed in Arduino using C/C++ syntax. Through this proposed system, we aim to enhance the mobility and independence of individuals with disabilities by providing them with an intuitive and versatile means of controlling their wheelchair.

articleTitle: Beyond Reality: Crafting Logical Systems for Autonomous Vehicles through Virtual Reality
abstract: The current paradigm for advancing autonomous driving functionalities on public roads predominantly operates within the tangible realm. Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are equipped with an array of sensors, including Lidar, cameras, radar, GPS, and on-board-unit (OBU) modems, each actively collecting data about the surrounding environment. This data is then processed through sophisticated algorithms, enhancing the vehicle's situational awareness. In our pursuit of refining autonomous driving capabilities, we leverage the AVTSC Simulator as our chosen Autonomous Vehicle (AV) simulation environment. Notably, this simulator stands out for its ability to replicate realistic urban settings and seamlessly integrate with widely used platforms such as Apollo and ROS. By harnessing the capabilities of this simulation environment, we aim to bridge the gap between real-world testing and simulated scenarios. This abstract encapsulates the essence of our strategy, emphasizing the integration of advanced sensor technologies and simulation environments for the development of autonomous driving features. Preliminary results indicate a promising 94% success rate for the proposed methodology, showcasing the efficacy of our approach in enhancing the robustness and reliability of autonomous systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Optimizing Third-Party Logistics Growth Through IT, Big Data, and Machine Learning for Superior Supply Chain Management
abstract: The purpose of this research is to explore proper development prospects of 3PL business, particularly focusing on the utilization of Information Technology and big data technologies for improving the solidity of supply chains. The change of the industry that started from the provision of services and then became an integrated solution implies the rising role of IT as one of the means for supply chain improvement. Based on the market study and investigation of customers' behaviors, as well as the contexts of the 3PL industry of the India, this research outlines how the IT and big data analytics can contribute to the operations improvement and innovation of the 3PL. Besides, this paper aims at finding out whether the Big Data analytics can enhance the competitiveness of third party logistics providers in a volatile market.

articleTitle: Precision Diagnostics in Neuroimaging: SVM-Based Approaches for Brain Tumor Identification
abstract: Brain Tumors are significant health concern worldwide for effective treatment planning. This research paper presents a novel approach utilizing support vector machine(SVM) algorithm for brain tumor detection, aiming to contribute to advancement of diagnostic capabilities in neuroimaging. The methodology employed in this study involves preprocessing of data and remove noise, feature extraction and classification using SVM to detect the type of tumor or no tumor. The SVM is trained on a dataset of 5000+ images classified into 4 types of tumor Glioma, No tumor, meningioma, pituitary tumor. The main findings of this research demonstrate outcomes in terms of accuracy and specificity of brain tumor detector application. This research contributes to the growing body of literature on automated brain tumor detection and underscores the potential of SVM-based approaches in clinical neuroimaging applications.

articleTitle: Innovative Defense Mechanisms: Multi-Class Weapon Detection with Hybrid CNN-SVM Intelligence
abstract: The most important aspect of the provision of public safety and law enforcement is the fast and decent identification of weapons. The present study is enthusiastically equipped to exhibit a detailed analysis of weapon detection using a hybrid strategy which combines the model of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Support Vector Machines (SVM) across five totally different types of weapons. The designed network is equipped to take into concern the complexities of conditions to identify the guns through the use of deep learning's features extraction combined with SVM's classification therapy. Working with a comprehensive dataset, the model underwent rigorous training and verification and reached the precision range of a minimum of 90.38% to a maximum of 95.83%. Among these classes, Class 5 has the highest precision. Foreshadowing the model's sensitivity, the recall metric led the way, having Class 2 the peak recall of 94.39%. The class with the highest F1-Score, which is a composite score of precision and recall, was 5, with a value of 93.95%. The support data, illustrating the number of actual occurrences in each class, were various solid Classes. For instance, 2303 examples of Class 1 were found to have the support of 0.19, while 2621 occurrences of Class 5 have the support of 0.22. Finally, macro averages of 92.23 % for precision, 92.29% for recall and 92.24% for the F1-Score were obtained because the whole classes we considered equally. This outcome suggests that a high level of accuracy and viability of weapon detection with the CNN-SVM model integration can correspond to their reality in the actual security devices used.

articleTitle: Advanced Food Delivery: Efficiency, Safety, and Satisfaction Innovations
abstract: The paper investigates a comprehensive methodology for improving food delivery operations through the design and implementation of an advanced delivery bag system. This study addresses critical aspects of efficiency, safety, customer satisfaction, material durability, and temperature maintenance in the context of modern food logistics. The methodology emphasizes optimizing delivery efficiency by enhancing space utilization and ergonomic handling, supported by a design that accommodates multiple compartments and secure closures to prevent spills and ensure order accuracy. Safety improvements include reflective strips and ergonomic features to mitigate risks for delivery personnel, resulting in a significant reduction in accident rates. Customer satisfaction is prioritized through features that maintain food quality during transit, supported by insulated compartments and effective temperature management. A high customer satisfaction rating underscores the methodology's success in meeting service expectations. Material durability is ensured through robust construction materials capable of withstanding heavy loads, ensuring longevity and reliability under operational conditions. The methodology's ability to maintain food temperature effectively preserves food quality and safety standards, further enhancing customer confidence. The delivery bag methodology presents a comprehensive approach to enhancing food delivery services and improving operational efficiency, safety, and customer satisfaction. By addressing key challenges in logistics and delivery management, this methodology sets a standard for delivering high-quality service in competitive markets while ensuring the well-being of delivery personnel and customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Investigating Novel Machine Learning Approaches to Enhance Real-Time Data Analysis
abstract: Actual-time records analysis is a critical deliverable for predictive analytics systems. It relies on green data processing strategies and gadget mastering algorithms to deliver timely actionable insights from streaming datasets. This abstract focuses on advances in system getting to know that beautify the accuracy and speed of real-time analysis. Recent advances leverage deep mastering models consisting of convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks to become aware of patterns in streaming records and to simultaneously classify and are expecting future developments. Moreover, disbursed computing architectures making use of cloud computing platforms offer the capacity to system larger datasets in a shorter time frame. Lastly, graphical representations of the information may be used to provide visualizations to better enable knowledge of records patterns and tendencies. Taking benefit of this machine studying advances and allotted computing architectures can boom the effectiveness of actual-time information analysis for advanced choice-making in enterprise scenarios.

articleTitle: Predictive Performance and Clinical Implications of Machine Learning in Early Coronary Heart Disease Detection
abstract: The identification of CHD in the early stage is crucial due to a high probability of death and ineffective treatment outcomes. This paper assesses the feasibility as well as clinical usefulness of several machine learning techniques in the early diagnosis of CHD. We employed a large set of data containing patients' features: demographic characteristics, health history, results of tests and diagnosis. The work of the study was to use Random Forest, Support Vector Machine and Neural Networks to estimate the probability of the incidence of CHD. Cohesion was performed using cross-validation for training and validation of the models with accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and ROC-AUC study parameters. The findings of this study show that through machine learning, the identification and diagnosis of CHD early stages can be significantly improved with the RF model giving the highest accuracy. Challenges and possibilities of using these predictive tools in clinical practice are examined, with the focus on possible enhancements of patients' treatment and outcomes. Thus, the research under consideration proved that machine learning-based predictive models can be considered a promising avenue for the early diagnosis of CHD, which should be further explored and implemented.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Flaw Forecasting via CNN-RF Fusion Techniques
abstract: In the abstract, this paper proposes a novel method for detecting defects in manufacturing that employs a hybrid approach that includes Convolutional Neural Networks (also known as CNNs) and Random Forests. The study addresses 10 types of defects: porosity, particles, misalignment, warpage, incomplete nuclear fusion, burr development, cracks, and fractures, the roughness of the surface, dimension inaccuracy, and delamination. The classification model's efficacy is carefully assessed using significant metrics like as Precision, Recall, or Fl-Score, which provide extensive information on its usefulness throughout an extensive variety of fault kinds. The findings regularly show exceptionally accurate values, demonstrating that the algorithm is capable of correctly identifying positive samples having scores ranging from 94.37% to 97.65%. The recall values, indicating the framework's ability to correctly identify actual positives, exceed 95% for all defect classes. The Fl-Score, which combines recall and accuracy, has a high average score of 95.83%, demonstrating the algorithm's balanced efficacy in fault spotting. Additionally, support numbers show the dataset's diversity, including 1139 to 1345 examples per fault class. The backing proportion statistic emphasizes the model's capacity to extrapolate effectively across diverse defect prevalences. In addition, the macro-average, weighted-average, and micro-average values corroborate the hypothesis's overall robustness, with Fl scores of 95.83%, 95.84 %, and 95.83 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Cricket Umpire Intelligence: A CNN-SVM Framework for Action Detection
abstract: This paper reports a novel approach that detects the umpire's actions using a combination of CNN and SVM networks. The focus is on recognizing five necessary umpire signals: The world of cricket is a world of its own. We see ‘Out,’ ‘Not Out,’ ‘Wide,’ ‘No Ball,’ and ‘Four’ among other inexplicable words. A dataset has been generated and annotated rigorously to measure the effectiveness of our approach. Afterwards, the extracted features are fed to a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify the fraud patterns, and then SVM is used to classify them. The system's evaluation is based on different quality indicators that convey each class's accuracy and recall rates, as well as other quality metrics. The precision picketing ranges from 82.52% for Class 1 to 90.42% for Class 5, while the recall shots differ from 79.81% for Class 5 to 93.29% for Class 4. These statistics represent a model's immediate ability to affirm the activities of a specific person. The F -1-scores, which measure a balance between correct identification of the relevant details and recall of all details, are also provided. Class 4 comes on top among the classes, with participating students achieving the highest score (90.26<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). As for the overall performance, the individual ratings are mixed with those averages, like macro, micro, and weighted. The macro average gives a score of 85.89%. The micro-average rating is a permanently high 85.84% for all the precision, recall, and F1-score measures. The F1 score after all the weighted adjustments is approximately 0.8579, which is led by the need to compensate for the class inequalities.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Multiple Round Auctions for Resource Allocation in Fog Computing Environments
abstract: Fog computing's decentralized nature is ideal for latency-sensitive IoT applications, but efficient resource allocation remains a critical challenge. Traditional auction mechanisms often fall short in addressing the real-time, dynamic nature of fog computing resource demands. This research introduces the Simultaneous Multiple Round Auction (SMRA) model, specifically designed for fog environments. SMRA deviates from conventional models by enabling bidding on customized resource bundles, employing multiple bidding rounds for price discovery and fairness, and incorporating fog-centric design for low-latency and scalability. The objectives of this research include enhancing resource utilization, prioritizing user satisfaction based on QoS requirements, ensuring fair allocation, and maintaining responsiveness in dynamic fog networks. Experimental evaluations will assess SMRA's performance across metrics including resource utilization, user satisfaction, auction convergence time, fairness, and scalability.

articleTitle: TRACK-GAME: Transformer-Assisted Malicious Financial Transaction Detection Framework for Meta Gaming Platform
abstract: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning, along with the onset of various technological advancements in the world, has been influential. These rapid advancements have allowed people to interact on different plat-forms. One such domain is the gaming sector. This development is associated with and transformed into multiplayer online gaming systems in the Metaverse virtual platform. Metaverse has proved to be a plausible tool for leveraging digital connectivity all over the world and making communication easier with other players across the globe. In the Metaverse gaming platform, players try to buy weapons to gain the advantage of the hidden features and to win against their opponents. During the transactions, the attackers take undue advantage of low-end security, and the player's sensitive information is captured and used for their own benefit. To address the aforementioned issue, this research article harnessed the power of the transformer model, i.e., the ALBERT model. The ALBERT model helped analyze large volumes of transactional data in Metaverse ecosystems using its memory utilization features and offering stability. The model succeeded in identifying fraudulent transactions with an accuracy of 98.45 % and a precision rate of 97.34 %. The results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed framework over the state-of-the-art model frameworks. Therefore, the integration of transformer models significantly enhances the Metaverse gaming platform.

articleTitle: Reliable Ontology Based Data Access Control Mechanism for Improved Security in Healthcare Data
abstract: Semantic web makes it easier for users to collaborate on content creation and information representation for computers to grasp. Ontologies are the fundamental building blocks behind the widespread use of semantic web technologies. It facilitates the sharing and reuse of concepts in a standardized manner., giving data gathered from diverse sources a common nomenclature and making it easier to distinguish between duplicates. To improve context ontology., a number of criteria must be met., such as expressiveness., genericity., simplicity., and flexibility. In this paper., the medical ontology-based access control protocol was built into the proposed work. The medical data is collected from the hospitals is used as the input data. For generating the secret key., the enhanced BB84 protocol has been used based on the quantum key distribution protocol. After the secret key is generated and distributed., the medical data are encrypted with the SHA256 algorithm. The encrypted data are stored in the cloud for secure data storage. Then., the reliable ontology based data access control mechanism has been used to access the medical data based on the User Role Assignment., Task Information Matching and User Permission Management. The proposed SHA256-RDACM model achieves a throughput of 369.35 Mb/s., accuracy of 97.86%., information loss of 2.14%., and delay of 0.006 seconds. Thus., the proposed model based on SHA256-RDACM performs better for data access control and security of healthcare data.

Author Keywords: reliable ontology based data access control mechanism

articleTitle: Opti Grid: AI-Based Energy Management System for Solar-Powered Microgrids
abstract: As electricity demand continues to rise, electrical engineers will turn to renewable-based energy sources like solar panels and their batteries to meet this demand efficiently. By integrating renewable energy with artificial intelligence, the aim is to create a more sustainable and eco-friendly solution. The main focus is on developing an energy-management system for solar-powered microgrids by using a modified firefly optimizer approach. This system will optimize the dispatch of energy resources in grid-connected systems by efficiently utilizing solar photovoltaic technology and energy storage systems. The proposed system will validate its performance under varying weather conditions, which include sunny and cloudy days, to account for the stochastic nature of solar energy. The Opti Grid system will represent a step towards achieving a more efficient and sustainable smart grid environment. This will reduce greenhouse gas emissions while meeting the increasing electricity demand.

articleTitle: Performance of Video Authenticity Parameters using Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: Video counterfeiting has become a major threat in today's digital environment, made worse by the widespread use of social media and sophisticated editing tools. There are dangers to one's mental health and wellbeing from this video modification. Advancements in technology, especially in artificial intelligence (AI), pose challenges to traditional techniques of video authenticity verification such digital signatures. The proposed objectives are to investigate the efficacy of cryptographic hash techniques like MD5 for validation and to identify altered videos using machine learning algorithms. The work aims to determine the best method for verifying the authenticity of digital videos through extensive experimentation and analysis.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Traditional And AI Based Fault Detection for Battery Thermal Management System
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are crucial to reduce hazards in both rural and urban regions, providing environmental protection and convenience for public and private transportation. However, their growing dependence requires long-lasting systems of batteries with high voltage and efficiency. Optimized battery monitoring algorithms are essential for ensuring the battery pack's overall life cycle. Because of its great efficiency with energy, low self-discharge rate, power-to-weight ratio, and low maintenance requirements, lithium-ion batteries are desirable. The right battery technology and efficient utilization are crucial. Cell balancing serves as a fundamental feature of battery management systems (BMS) in electric vehicles (EV s), which assist in monitoring, controlling, and safeguarding Li-ion batteries against misuse. This research explores the performance of electric vehicles (EV s) in battery thermal management, sensor fault detection, and the use of AI techniques in EV technologies. A liquid-based battery thermal management solution designed for electric vehicles operating above 40°C. Fault detection time was essential for detecting and analysing faults in battery packs for accurate diagnosis and maintenance. Machine learning and deep learning are utilized to predict the performance of electric vehicle batteries. Battery management systems' safety and reliability may be improved by 98% and their mean relative error reduced to 0.055% using the IB-DRN-based false battery data recognition and categorization system. The experimental results show that IB-DRN shows the superior accuracy when applied to lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Development and Testing of ‘TeachAR’ – A Web-Based Augmented Reality Teaching Platform
abstract: AR-based applications are gaining popularity for catering needs in many fields, including education. The need for an educational application that provides teachers a platform to instruct and aid students in comprehending complex subjects using interactive 3D objects is essential. In this study, a WebAR teaching platform - ‘TeachAR’ was developed with that perspective. The purpose of this application was to enhance teaching and learning in the educational field. Using our proposed web application, a teacher can upload class lesson materials using 3D models to convey challenging concepts. On the other hand, students can use the AR Guide to learn those uploaded concepts in an interactive AR environment. To prove the efficacy of our proposed application, usability testing was carried out by considering both teachers and students. It has been observed that the proposed automated web application increased the allure of teaching and learning for students in real contexts.

articleTitle: Cataract Prediction with VGG19 Architecture Using the Ocular Disease Dataset
abstract: Ocular diseases, particularly cataracts, pose significant challenges to global eye health, necessitating accurate and timely diagnostic approaches. This study aims to enhance the identification of eye diseases by applying deep learning techniques. It specifically focuses on predicting cataracts using the VGG19 architecture. By utilising a portion of the Ocular Disease Intelligent Recognition (ODIR) database, which consists of 588 cataract images and 1088 normal photos, we implement meticulous data pretreatment approaches to guarantee the integrity and variety of the data. The VGG19 convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture is selected because of its established effectiveness in image categorisation tasks. Additionally, the model is fine-tuned using transfer learning techniques to optimise its performance specifically for cataract prediction. Through comprehensive training and evaluation procedures, the developed model achieves an impressive accuracy of 98.62%, demonstrating its robustness and reliability in cataract detection. The findings of this study contribute significantly to advancing ocular disease recognition, with potential implications for early disease diagnosis, personalised treatment planning, and improved patient outcomes. This study underscores the importance of leveraging cutting-edge AI techniques in addressing critical healthcare challenges and underscores the potential of deep learning in revolutionising ophthalmic care.

articleTitle: Investigating Trade-Offs Between Capacity and QoS in Underwater Fiber Optic Networks Using Bandwidth Optimization
abstract: This study's paper examines the alternate-offs among capability and exceptional-of-provider (quality of service) in underwater fiber optic networks and the usage of bandwidth optimization. The authors present a brand new bandwidth optimization approach for underwater fiber-optic networks based totally on bodily layer scheduling. The central concept behind the proposed approach is to limit the ratio of user flows to the quantity of spectral resources available, even maximizing the usage of the available resources. The technique tested the usage of an actual international network that consists of site visitors from multiple websites placed within the Mediterranean Sea, and the outcomes illustrated the effectiveness of the proposed technique. It discovered that the proposed bandwidth optimization technique elevated the network ability by as much as 100% in phrases of the wide variety of flows while maintaining the quality of service parameters within the goal range. The paper also presents insight into the constraints of present bandwidth optimization strategies and the way they will be addressed in future research. In general, this study presents a complete view of present-day trade-offs among potential and quality of service in underwater fiber optic networks. It gives capability upgrades to help visitors' demands at the same time as minimizing the related change-offs.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning Technique in End System for Traffic Classification in IP Network
abstract: Network traffic prediction is crucial for efficient resource allocation and ensuring Quality of Service. Traditional methods often fail to account for memory constraints, leading to suboptimal performance. This work proposes an optimized memory-aware approach using regressors for internet traffic prediction. The proposed method involves preprocessing to handle missing data, followed by feature selection to identify relevant predictors. Multiple regressors are then trained and evaluated, with a novel memory-aware hyper parameter tuning strategy employed to account for memory limitations. The optimized model is deployed, enabling accurate traffic forecasting while respecting memory constraints. By applying the results of the experiments on real-world databases, it proposes the superiority of the proposed approach over the existing approach while considering the accuracy and memory efficiency. Network traffic analysis allows network operators to optimize resource allocation, prevent congestion, and ensure Quality of Service by predicting future traffic demands.

articleTitle: Integrating Eye Gaze Estimation with the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) for Individualized and Efficient Healthcare
abstract: Adding Eye Gaze Estimation to the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) marks a shift in healthcare diagnostic and treatment procedures. The clinical effects of merging these two breakthrough technologies in pediatric health care are examined in this study. Eye gazing statistics reveal a child's cognitive, emotional, and social development. Healthcare practitioners can remotely view and analyze these visual attention patterns in real-time using the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) infrastructure to provide timely, evidence-based interventions. This discussion focuses on how technology may improve evaluation tools, customize care regimens, and remotely monitor patients. Privacy and informed permission are also considered ethical elements that validate parents' worries and ensure proper technology use. Our study found that eye gaze estimation with the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) can improve tailored and efficient healthcare and discusses this integration's clinical uses, technological features, dataset, and ethical considerations, revealing its transformative potential for personalized and efficient treatment. The research examines this integration's clinical, technological, and moral aspects, proposing it could change pediatric healthcare. Finally, the paper emphasizes the importance of datasets in improving gaze estimate algorithms and predicting future advances.

articleTitle: Application of UAV Target Detection and Tracking System Based on Intelligent Image Recognition
abstract: Intelligent object detection and tracking technology has become an inevitable trend in the development of modern society. This paper discusses the relevant research based on the application fields of image recognition, motion model prediction and unmanned driving, including a lot of robot related content. This paper starts with the background overview and leads to the study of the vehicle flight control mode on the UAV platform. Then, this paper analyzes the current status of the design and development of mainstream video surveillance systems at home and abroad, points out the existing problems, and puts forward solutions. Based on our own knowledge and experience, this paper designs an algorithm model of automatic navigation, positioning and tracking of intelligent mobile robot which has the function of self-detection and can track the specified target. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by experiments. It is found that among the four target tracking types, the training accuracy of buildings reaches 95%, indicating that the target tracking algorithm for buildings is relatively accurate. Further analysis shows that the training accuracy of the vehicle is 90%, which also indicates that the target tracking algorithm has a good ability for vehicle recognition and tracking. However, the training accuracy of humans and trees is relatively low at 80% and 85%, respectively. This also means that further improvements are needed in target tracking algorithms to improve accuracy for these target types. Therefore, more exploration and research are needed for the tracking algorithms of the two target types, man and tree.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agri-Sustainability: Multimodal Recommendations for Demand-Supply Alignment
abstract: The objective of the research is to develop an innovative approach for supply-demand balancing for the agriculture goods for sustainability of farmers. The proposed model considers the Demand-Supply in market to determine which crop farmer should grow according to their soil profile and type to align Demand-Supply in the market. The system uses an advanced predictive analytics approach and recommends the personalized crops based on textual and image input by accounting for characteristics such as soil composition, soil type, climate data such as rainfall, temperature etc., and market trends. The developed predictive system uses the multimodal machine learning algorithm comprises with random forest, and CNN model. Using multimodal machine learning, the system recommends the top five crops to farmers for their specific field based on input parameters, allowing farmers to improve crop selection, develop sustainable farming practices, and achieve demand-supply alignment in the agriculture sector. The multimodal hybrid model achieves 95% crop forecast accuracy, ensuring the model's versatility.

articleTitle: Application of CNN-ConvLSTM Approach for Stock Market Prediction Using a Diverse Set of Variables
abstract: Forecasting stock returns and dangers is a top priority for market decision makers. The ability to predict a company's future performance is vital for stock market professionals. According to efficient market theory, one may reliably anticipate future stock prices by looking at their historical performance. More research into the novel fusion methods is needed, as many studies have concentrated on individual risk and stock return classifiers. Methods such as feature selection, preprocessing, and model training are all part of this proposed strategy. Data preprocessing includes selecting variables and transforming data. An effective stock prediction design relies on carefully selecting representative features. Using the CNN-ConvLSTM improved the accuracy of the model training process. With an accuracy rate of 97.11%, the suggested method outperforms its competitors, which include CNN and LSTM.

articleTitle: Maximizing Cloud Security: Empirical Evaluation of an Efficient Identity oriented Signature Verification Scheme for Wireless Networks
abstract: A reliable and effective way to aggregate large amounts of data is very desirable in the area of wireless networks that are helped by cloud computing. Target tracking and environmental management are only two examples of the many real-world uses of wireless sensor networks. The cloud does, however, make data vulnerable to a variety of threats, including data eavesdropping and data contamination. Elevated Identity based Signature Verification (EISV) is an identity-based aggregate signature verification scheme that is cross-validated with the conventional Attribute based Encryption (ABE) security scheme to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed scheme for data integrity security in wireless sensor networks. This technique will reduce storage and bandwidth costs in wireless sensor networks while keeping data private, according to the benefits of aggregate signatures. With online signature methods, the signer can generate an electronic signature using a pre-calculated digital signature when a document is submitted. Applications involving wireless sensor networks with limited resources benefit greatly from such approaches. Our suggested technique, Elevated Identity based Signature Verification, has been implemented, and the results show that it is practical and feasible to utilize in a cloud based wireless sensor network configuration.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Improving Recall of Image Recognition for Deep Learning Algorithm Using Densnet-169 Compared with VGG19
abstract: Aim: The goal is to enhance deep learning image recognition recall performance so that DenseNet-169 can function more effectively in recall. Through network architecture optimization and the use of skip links to facilitate information flow and feature reuse, picture classification jobs are completed more accurately and efficiently. Methods and Materials: Twenty samples were used in the study, which was split into two groups: Group 1 had ten iterations of Dense Net-169, and Group 2 had ten iterations of Alex Net. The confidence interval (CI) was set at 95% and the statistical power at 80%. Results & Discussion: Attaining a 97.80% recall rate, the new DenseNet-169 technique dramatically increased the accuracy of image identification. By contrast, only 87.70<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> recall rate was obtained with the conventional VGG19 approach. Our remarkable 98% recall rate in identifying positive and negative situations in photographs was accomplished using the suggested recognition task structure. Conclusion: Finally, the novel Dense Ne169 has performed better than the novel VGG19 in a particular algorithm for image recognition.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for Improving Lifetime Ratio in a Wireless Sensor Network for EV vehicles Using Improved Cybernated Clustering Scheme
abstract: The efficient utilization of finite energy resources is critical in establishing the capacity for transmitting data, especially in wireless sensor networks where replacing batteries to extend the lifetime of the system is impracticable. Contrary to conventional routing approaches, the Cybernated Cluster Routing (CCR) method orchestrates optimal digital clusters in a strategic manner, considering factors such as node stability, network proximity selection, and routing information fine-tuning to significantly reduce overhead. By utilizing routing table data exclusively from within the digital cluster, CCR eliminates reliance on the network head. Furthermore, CCR demonstrates extended periods of viability and reduced time required for transmission in comparison to alternative approaches.

articleTitle: On Enhancing Usability of Hindi ATM Banking with Multi-Modal UI and Explainable UX
abstract: The ATM penetration in developing nations is mainly limited by the inadequate digital literacy of users in relation to the UI/UX. There are many regional languages in India where Hindi is popular and corresponds to large demography (43.6 %) of users. Ironically, there is not much work in advancing the ATM UI for Hindi that can render it usefully towards a design which is - simple, error correcting or feedback capable and user - centric for weak users such as rural, elderly, laborers and new users. This paper proposes a novel framework referred to as explainable UI or XUI in Hindi that aims to enhance UX in terms of interpretability and inclusion of weak users. We integrate two most related and frequently performed tasks given by Cash Withdrawal and Balance Check in the XUI. The proposed Hindi XUI is implemented using HTML, CSS and Java Script and evaluated based on four UI features denoting PIN Entry, Transaction Type, Account Type and Amount Entry operations. The XUI simulated by us using touchscreen computer is tested for 34 weak and strong users. We formulate Usability - Gain as novel performance index to competitively evaluate XUI and Old UI. The experimental analysis quantifies Usability for XUI as 0.96 which is close to the upper limit of 1. Likewise, usability computed for OUI is - 0.66 which is close to lower limit of - 1. Lastly, the competitive performance of XUI vs. OUI as denoted by Usability - Gain is estimated as 1.62 and proves XUI is the winner.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Categorizing Waste Using Convolutional Neural Networks and TensorFlow
abstract: In the realm of environmental challenges, waste management emerges as a critical concern, sparking a demand for innovative solutions to boost sustain ability efforts. In this study, an innovative approach to waste classification is introduced, harnessing Convolutional Neural Networks paired with TensorFlow, a robust open-source machine learning platform known for its flexibility and efficiency in model development and deployment. The study aims to address the essential task of automating waste classification, a key step towards streamlining recycling processes and reducing environmental impacts. The methodology delves into detailed analyses of the CNN architecture, preprocessing techniques and hyperparameter optimization. The research includes a thorough evaluation of model performance across various metrics such as accuracy, block size, dropouts, loss and time required for epochs, showcasing the resilience and adaptability of CNN and TensorFlow in precisely categorizing a range of waste materials, spanning from batteries, cardboard, metal, plastics, glasses, and paper. By leveraging deep learning technologies, the proposed methodology demonstrates promising outcomes in waste classification, paving the way for advancements in waste management practices on a larger scale. This contribution to the field of environmental technology offers a dependable framework for waste classification, aligning with the overarching goal of promoting a cleaner and more sustainable planet. Furthermore, the utilization of the deep CNN model shows potential for accurate waste identification, enhancing the efficiency of garbage classification processes and potentially enabling real-time waste detection. Noteworthy is the preference for EfficientNetB0 over Transfer-Learning alternatives such as DenseNet201, ResNet50 and InceptionV3, boasting superior performance accuracy at 94.15% alongside reduced parameter complexity.

articleTitle: Milk Chain with ML and Blockchain for Ensuring Milk Purity in Dairy Industry
abstract: Global milk supply chains encounter challenges such as quality degradation and adulteration due to insufficient monitoring and traceability. Traditional methods are manual, leading to health risks and economic losses. Addressing these issues requires an advanced system integrating IoT sensors, blockchain, and machine learning to enhance transparency, efficiency, and reliability. Particularly in densely populated regions like India, milk adulteration poses significant health risks, as evidenced by recent incidents in Mathura district's Agra division. Our proposed Blockchain-enabled platform ‘Milk Chain’ aims to establish a transparent, tamper-proof, and sustainable supply chain. It focuses on preserving nutritional values, detecting adulteration, supporting dairy farmers economically, and ensuring product authenticity. This study analyzes key factors affecting milk quality-pH, temperature, taste, odor, fat content, turbidity, color, and grade-using categorical boosting (CatBoost). The findings highlight critical parameters influencing milk quality, aiding in the development of a robust supply chain system to protect public health and nutrition in dairy-dependent regions.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Image Classification for Automated Face Spoofing Detection Using Machine Learning: Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Facial recognition technology has gained widespread use in various applications, raising concerns about the weakness of frameworks to confront mocking assaults. This study presents an implementation of face spoofing detection using machine learning techniques. The exploration utilizes a far-reaching system that envelops data combination, preprocessing, incorporate extraction, and model readiness. A diverse dataset comprising genuine and spoofed facial images, representing various spoofing techniques, is utilized. Feature extraction leverages Convolutional Brain Organizations (CNNs) to catch discriminative facial elements. The selected machine learning model is trained and fine-tuned, with a focus on achieving robustness against evolving spoofing methods. The evaluation of the implemented system involves rigorous testing on a separate dataset, utilizing estimations like precision, exactness, survey, and F1-score. The study investigates post-processing techniques and considerations for real-time deployment, ensuring practical applicability is done by the method convolutional neural network (CNN). Cross-approval is performed to evaluate the model's speculation capacities, and the deployment phase explores integration into real-world scenarios. Ethical considerations, user feedback, and compliance with data privacy regulations are integral components of the study.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Data Security in the Cloud: Integrating ML-Based Intrusion Detection Systems
abstract: Technology integration, but particularly the merging of health care data systems (HCDS) with Cloud Computing, becomes crucial for the proper data management in developing healthcare system. The integration yields notable benefits including improved patient care, simplified administrative procedures and informed decision-making within healthcare organizations. Cloud computing also has scalability, flexibility and cost-effectiveness, so it becomes the best alternative for keeping and analyzing the big amounts of healthcare data. Nevertheless, the shift in paradigm leads to data security and privacy issues, which require strong security controls for sensitive health data. This research paper concerns optimizing HCDS using Cloud Computing to provide data management, accessibility, and scalability in the Healthcare industry. It studies the utilization of Technology, specifically Cloud Computing, in improving Health Care administration systems, reducing paperwork, and creating a centralized platform for efficient health care organization administration. The focus area is concerned with the security issues raised by keeping healthcare data on the cloud, which covers the creation and implementation of such as encryption, access controls and intrusion detection. The research utilizes the latest technologies such as AI and ML to enhance healthcare data on the cloud security. The NSL-KDD benchmark dataset is used to maturely apply and analyse ML models such as RF, SVM, and LR. The results show the models' capacity to distinguish Denial of Service, Probe, Remote and Local, and User to Root attacks. Compared to other ML models, in particular Random Forest is a leading one in performance in all attack types.

articleTitle: Kidney Tumor Detection and Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network Architecture
abstract: This research focuses on developing a deep-learning model for the classification of medical images to detect tumors. The study utilizes a dataset consisting of 8,400 images labeled as either “Normal” or “Tumor.” The images are preprocessed by resizing to 256x256 pixels. The dataset is split into training, testing, and validation sets with ratios of 64%, 20%, and 16%, respectively. To balance the data, each class contains an equal number of images. The model architecture is based on a Sequential Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), incorporating layers such as Batch Normalization, Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Dropout, Flatten, and Dense layers. The model is compiled with the Adam optimizer and Sparse Categorical Cross entropy loss function. Data augmentation techniques, including shear, zoom, and horizontal flip, are applied to the training set using the Image Data Generator. Training is conducted over 50 epochs, achieving a final training accuracy of 97.69% and validation accuracy of 95.31%. The model's performance is evaluated using various metrics, including accuracy, loss, and confusion matrix, which indicate high precision and recall values of 0.97 for both classes. Visualization of training and validation accuracy and loss over epochs demonstrates the model's effectiveness and stability. The research concludes that the proposed CNN model effectively classifies medical images for tumor detection, with potential applications in automated diagnostic systems. Future work could explore more advanced architectures and larger datasets to further enhance the model's performance and generalizability.

articleTitle: Enhancing Threat Recognition: The Vanguard of Weapon Detection via CNN-SVM Algorithms
abstract: The objective was to improve the detection and classification accuracy and efficiency of five different kinds of weapons: In a war, guns (machine guns, snipers and rifles), knives, explosives, pistols, and non-lethal instruments (tasers and batons). The model was intensively evaluated and trained against a large dataset to tackle different environmental circumstances well. Whether the CNN-SVM model in question was trained or not, data analysis shows that it performed well, as it achieved an accuracy of 82.09% in total. Reported measures mainly consist of an F1 score of 81%, a weighted accuracy of 82.52%, and recall. The model elicited remarkable results in some classes, achieving accuracies up to 94% for non-lethal weapons and up to 93% for explosives. This study of the confusion matrix showed that the AI, within all classes, where certain classes had a similar visual appearance, identified them incorrectly, for example, in the case of pistols and rifles. The survey results thus suggest the efficacy integration of CNN and SVM, which creates a more powerful weapons detection tool that can improve the speed and accuracy of the existing processes. As an integral part of the justification of the suggested model, its resilience and relevance for real-life scenarios will be increased, which will be achieved by improving the proposed model in its ability to distinguish between visually similar weapon classes and also adding a dataset that is both sizeable and diverse. The making of this hybrid model may well be a flagship on the road to the next generation in security technologies and the accommodation of public safety in different sensitive circumstances.

articleTitle: Digital Image Forgery Detection Using Deep Learning
abstract: Image manipulation, falsification, and deepfake production have become major concerns in the era of digital media. In order to combat false information and online fraud, this project seeks to develop a technology that can identify altered or counterfeit photos. In this work, we present a model for detecting image forgeries based on the Xception architecture, which we have combined with a Flask-based web application. The model undergoes 20 epochs of training, with accuracy and loss metrics tracked throughout. The training process reveals a consistent improvement in accuracy, starting at 55% and reaching an impressive 97.7% by the 20th epoch. Validation accuracy follows a similar trend, beginning at 52.29% and reaching 81.92% at the conclusion of training. Concurrently, both training and validation loss values decrease, indicating the model's learning capacity and ability to generalize. The integration of the model into a Flask web application allows users to interact with the forgery detection system. The TensorFlow optimization, utilizing oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) with AVX and AVX2 instructions, enhances CPU performance during model execution. The Flask web application provides a user-friendly interface for users to submit images and receive real-time predictions on their authenticity. The model's predictions on a sample set demonstrate its efficacy in distinguishing between real and fake images. The confusion matrix further validates the model's performance, highlighting its capability to make accurate classifications.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Digital Filter Design for Environmental Monitoring applications
abstract: This research work proposes the design of a latest generation digital filter, which is particularly suitable for the optimization of environment measurements. Filters are important components of signal processing that used for correct acquiring and analysis of environmental information. But in current designs various problems of accuracy, response time and power consumption are usually encountered. In this directed method, we have incorporated novel algorithms as well as optimization procedures that enhance the filter's efficiency. Experiments substantiate the superiority of the proposed approach compared to prior art in such categories as accuracy and time. Other real life environmental monitoring applications also support our observations and the efficiency of our proposed approach. Such profuse outcomes have scientific significance to progress in the Emergency and environmental monitoring systems contributing to higher reliability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Utilizing Natural Language Processing to Enhance Information Capture and Retrieval
abstract: This venture focuses on using natural Language Processing (NLP) to facilitate information capture and retrieval. NLP is a complex and fast strategy used for analyzing text and voice data. It is utilized in a ramification of applications, including machine translation, spell checking, sentiment extraction, and statistics extraction. This mission aims to broaden a gadget that could seize, shop, and retrieve information for users based totally on their herbal language queries. The gadget will use NLP algorithms to become aware of and extract applicable facts from text and voice statistics and shop them in a dependent database. A web-based user interface will be developed for searching and retrieving statistics from the database. The gadget can be utilized by businesses to allow efficient retrieval of data via herbal language queries and can also be used by individuals for obligations along with summarizing files. Standard, this task hopes to offer advanced information capture and retrieval with the assistance of NLP.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Academic Performance Among Students Using A-CNN-BiLSTM Approach
abstract: The number of possibilities to analyze educational data using data mining techniques is expanding, with the goal of improving learning outcomes. There is an explosion in data produced by online and virtual education, e-learning platforms, and institutional IT. Using these statistics, teachers could gain valuable insights into their students' learning habits. Academic performance of students and other useful information can be analyzed with the help of educational data mining. Model training consists of three primary steps: data preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model. To eliminate unwanted problems like noise and redundant attributes, data preparation is necessary. By prioritizing which features to calculate, the mRMR algorithm lowers calculation costs. Feature selection plays a crucial role in training A-CNN-BiLSTM models. The suggested approach routinely outperforms BiLSTM and CNN, two state-of-the-art algorithms. With a data accuracy percentage of 96.57%, it's clear that there was a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Task Allocation in Fog Computing
abstract: Fog computing is a decentralized infrastructure that brings computing, storage, and networking resources closer to data sources and end devices, significantly reducing latency and enhancing performance for delay-sensitive applications such as real-time video streaming and self-driving cars. A critical challenge in fog computing is task scheduling, which involves assigning tasks to fog nodes to minimize latency and optimize performance metrics. This paper reviews existing algorithms for task scheduling and resource allocation in fog computing and introduces a approach that compares performance of Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), and the Firefly Algorithm implemented in proposed framework. The proposed framework aims to enhance system efficiency by optimizing task allocation among helper nodes. Each algorithm's effectiveness is evaluated in achieving balanced task allocation within the fog network environment. Experimental results demonstrate that the PSO integrated algorithm consistently outperforms other algorithms in terms of task distribution efficiency, achieving better latency reduction and resource utilization.

articleTitle: Rhythmic Resonance: A New Era of Musical Instrument Categorization with CNN-SVM
abstract: This study investigates the efficiency of hybrid modelling that combines a Convolution Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to classify musical instrumentations in audio recordings. The categorization assignment is divided into five categories representing distinct families of musical instruments: strains, woodwinds, brass, percussions, and keyboard. The decision model's performance is rigorously measured using precision, recall, F1-score, and overall accuracy. The model value ranged between 91.26% and 95.02% concerning accuracy and 89.29% to 98.07% for recall across five class groups. We can conclude the F1 scores to be well-rounded in accuracy and recall, with values ranging from 91.20% to 95.42%, indicating excellence. Each class showed a broad variation of support with no example under or above the value 415 or 478, respectively, representing no support regions of 0.18 and 0.21. The model had the confidence of overall accuracy of up to 93.41%. Various types of averages were considered for a complete discussion of the model's performance. The macro average accuracy was 93.38%, and recall and F1 scores were 93.41% and 93.52%, respectively. The weighted average accuracy was 93.43%, the recall was 93.41%, and the F1-score was 93.39%, although considering class imbalance. The microaverage, representing all classes' net contribution to accuracy, recall, and the F1-score, remained at 93.41%. The experimental results demonstrate that the CNN-SVM model is a strong and capable instrument identification model in complex acoustics.

articleTitle: Veripass- Passport Forgery Detection Using CNN, OCR, and SIFT
abstract: The increasing occurrence of passport forgery presents a challenge to national security and the protocols used to verify identities. This research introduces a system for automated passport verification that combines Bilateral Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT). By examining the limitations of manual passport inspection methods and the growing complexity of forgery techniques this research sheds light on the need for advanced countermeasures. The proposed system revolutionizes the verification process, from document submission to approval resulting in improved efficiency and accuracy. With the use of Bilateral CNN for precise image preprocessing, OCR for text validation, and SIFT for image authentication this system provides a strong defense against passport forgery. This research addresses the requirement for automated forgery detection contributing to the advancement of passport verification systems. It emphasizes how crucial it is to maintain the integrity and security of identity verification processes in response to changing security threats. Index Terms—Passport forgery, Automated verification system, Bilateral Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT)
